raw.title: Co-Founder & CEO - AI Retail Planning Autopilot
raw.excerpt: The OpportunityFutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead Maestro, an AI-native inventory-planning intelligence venture.
raw.description:
The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead Maestro, an AI-native inventory-planning intelligence venture. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.

Maestro is an autopilot planning intelligence for SMB operators managing physical inventory complexity without a planning team. It connects across channels and ERPs, handles routine decisions silently, and surfaces exceptions with context and a recommended action before they become revenue losses. The institutional memory that today lives only in a planner's head gets externalized, structured, and queried in plain language.

We didn't just build a thesis; we validated it directly with the market. We have spoken with founders, VP E-Commerce leaders, merchandise planners, and multi-channel operators at DTC and specialty retail brands across the US. The market signal is clear:

  • Autopilot is the vision: Every named competitor generates recommendations that humans still have to act on manually. No product at this revenue tier is building toward full autonomous execution of the planning lifecycle. Maestro's product vision is full autopilot: the system owns the buy decision, allocation, and markdown trigger end-to-end. But buyers earn that trust incrementally, starting with routine decisions handled silently and exceptions surfaced with context.
  • The pain is in the dollars, not the dashboards: Documented annual losses across just five buyer accounts total $1.25–1.5M+. Buyers currently spend $0–500/month on software; the entire planning budget is tied up in headcount. The payback case is immediate, and ROI demonstration, not feature demos, will be the critical sales motion.
  • Institutional memory failure is systemic and unresolved: One SVP with 30 years of domain expertise described relying entirely on personal recall to flag which materials, colours, and styles underperformed last season. When he leaves, that knowledge disappears, and no tool captures it today. Every buyer interviewed described a version of this problem.

Market Context

We are targeting a large, structurally underserved segment: SMB operators managing multi-channel physical inventory complexity at $5M–50M revenue — importers, distributors, Amazon aggregators, and specialty retailers. The beachhead SAM is estimated at $200M–$225M across approximately 15K–16K brands in the US and Canada. Excel is the universal incumbent! 5/5 buyers in our discovery sprint were on spreadsheets, with zero dedicated planning tools in use. EBITDA across the $10–50M DTC cohort is compressed to 7.25% in 2025 with revenue declining ~4.6% YoY. Planning waste attacks the margin stack directly.

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven studio team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

The Partnership

  • Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception
  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding
  • Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one
  • Investor and advisor network across vertical AI and early-stage capital markets
  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight's cross-functional team as your partner

What You’ll Own

As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead its execution.

  • Strategy — Refine the ICP, pricing model, and product positioning
  • Customer Development — Lead pilots with VPs, operations managers, and merchandise planners at importers, distributors, and multi-channel retail brands, convert them to paid engagements, and build the go-to-market motion
  • Product — Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 and iterate on user feedback
  • Capital — Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction
  • Team — Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Previous founding experience at a venture-backed company
  • Demonstrated success in B2B SaaS go-to-market, including sales and customer engagement
  • Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital
  • Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent
  • Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company
  • Deep, operational exposure to merchandise planning, inventory management, and multi-channel retail operations

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

Become a part of our caring community

Enhance your Family Care career in this Manager, Care Coaching role. Reporting to the Associate Director, Care Coaching, you will support the work of Care Management staff. You will provide daily leadership and mentoring to staff. You will deliver services in a manner that expresses Humana values and the Family Care program values of access, choice, quality, and cost effectiveness. This position supports IDT staff that cover Jackson and Trempealeau Counties.

Main Responsibilities:

Use your skills to make an impact

  • 1 year of leadership experience in the human services field.
  • 3 years of experience working in the Family Care program.

40

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.


About us

About Inclusa: Inclusa manages the provision of a person-centered and community-focused approach to long-term care services and support to Family Care members across the state of Wisconsin. As a values-based organization devoted to building vibrant and inclusive communities, Inclusa deploys a unique approach to managed care with a trademarked model of support named Commonunity® which focuses on the belief in everyone, and from that belief, the common good for all is achieved. In 2022, Inclusa was acquired by Humana. Accountant (Accounts Receivable, Invoicing & Financial Operations) – Remote | U.S. Hours

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an Accountant to manage accounts receivable, invoicing, payment tracking, cash flow visibility, and day-to-day financial operations.

This is not a traditional bookkeeping-only role. We’re looking for someone who can combine strong accounting fundamentals with operational ownership and a process-improvement mindset.

You’ll take ownership of:

  • Accounts receivable and collections
  • Invoicing and payment tracking
  • Cash flow monitoring
  • Financial reporting
  • QuickBooks and accounting systems
  • Reconciliations and financial documentation
  • Accounting workflow automation and improvement

You’ll work closely with U.S.-based leadership to maintain accurate financial records while helping modernize and streamline accounting processes.

If you’re detail-oriented, comfortable with technology, and enjoy improving the systems behind financial operations, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Accounts Receivable & Invoicing

  • Prepare and issue accurate invoices on time
  • Manage accounts receivable and payment follow-ups
  • Monitor aging reports and outstanding balances
  • Track overdue accounts and support collection efforts
  • Confirm incoming payments and maintain accurate transaction records
  • Ensure invoices, payments, and financial records remain properly documented
  • Support healthy cash flow through proactive tracking and follow-up

Cash Flow & Financial Operations

  • Monitor cash flow activity and payment schedules
  • Track incoming and outgoing transactions
  • Maintain accurate financial trackers and operational reports
  • Support banking and treasury-related activities
  • Help leadership maintain visibility into:
    • Cash position
    • Upcoming payments
    • Outstanding receivables
    • Financial priorities
  • Identify discrepancies or unusual financial activity and escalate when necessary

Accounting Systems & Process Improvement

  • Work extensively within QuickBooks and related financial systems
  • Support migration from QuickBooks or legacy processes to modern accounting platforms when required
  • Identify inefficient or repetitive accounting workflows
  • Improve processes across:
    • Reporting
    • Reconciliations
    • Payment tracking
    • Invoicing
    • Financial documentation
  • Help build scalable accounting SOPs and processes

Financial Reporting & Documentation

  • Prepare financial summaries and operational reports
  • Maintain accurate and organized accounting records
  • Support reconciliations and financial data verification
  • Ensure financial documentation remains clean and audit-ready
  • Maintain consistency between accounting systems, payment records, and reporting
  • Support compliance and financial process accuracy

Technology, AI & Automation

  • Use automation and AI tools to improve accounting efficiency
  • Support digital workflows across:
    • Invoicing
    • Banking
    • Reporting
    • Payment tracking
    • Financial operations
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual accounting work
  • Support accounting system modernization and process optimization

Requirements

Must-Have Experience

  • 3+ years of accounting or financial operations experience
  • Strong hands-on experience with:
    • QuickBooks
    • Accounts receivable
    • Invoicing
    • Payment tracking
    • Financial reporting
  • Advanced proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets
  • Experience working with:
    • Digital banking platforms
    • Payment processing systems
    • Financial tracking workflows
  • Strong attention to detail and financial accuracy
  • Excellent organizational and problem-solving skills
  • Strong written and verbal English communication
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Comfortable collaborating directly with U.S.-based leadership
  • Availability during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience with accounting system migrations
  • Familiarity with automation or AI-assisted accounting workflows
  • Startup or high-growth company experience
  • Exposure to:
    • Treasury operations
    • Cash forecasting
    • Operational finance
  • Experience developing or improving accounting SOPs
  • Experience automating manual financial processes

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You care deeply about financial accuracy
  • You proactively follow up on outstanding receivables
  • You notice discrepancies before they become larger problems
  • You’re highly organized and comfortable managing multiple financial workflows
  • You can work independently without constant oversight
  • You enjoy improving inefficient processes
  • You’re comfortable adopting new accounting technology and automation
  • You communicate financial information clearly with leadership and stakeholders

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You might start by reviewing outstanding receivables, aging reports, incoming payments, and invoices that need to be processed.

Throughout the day, you’ll confirm payments, update financial trackers, follow up on outstanding balances, review cash flow activity, and prepare financial updates for leadership.

You’ll also maintain accounting records, support reconciliations, troubleshoot discrepancies, and identify opportunities to automate or improve existing financial workflows.

In short: you keep financial operations accurate, organized, visible, and efficient while helping the business build more scalable accounting systems.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Timely and accurate invoicing
  • Accounts receivable collection efficiency
  • Reduction in overdue balances
  • Accuracy of financial reporting and tracking
  • Cash flow visibility
  • Financial record and documentation accuracy
  • Reduction in manual accounting processes
  • Compliance and audit readiness
  • Responsiveness and operational reliability

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct collaboration with company leadership
  • Strong ownership of core financial operations
  • Opportunity to modernize accounting systems and workflows
  • Exposure to automation and AI-assisted accounting
  • Opportunity to contribute beyond transactional bookkeeping
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Accountant
    • Accounting Manager
    • Financial Operations Manager
    • Controller

Interview Process

  1. Initial Screening
  2. Recruiter Interview
  3. Client Interview
  4. Offer & Onboarding

Apply Now

If you have strong experience with QuickBooks, accounts receivable, invoicing, payment tracking, and financial operations and enjoy improving the systems behind accounting, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help build accurate, efficient, and scalable financial operations.

Important: Spark Hire Video Interview

As part of our application process, qualified candidates will be invited to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

This gives you an opportunity to introduce yourself, highlight your relevant accounting experience, and tell us why you’re a strong fit for the role.

Please complete your Spark Hire interview promptly after receiving the invitation. Candidates who do not complete the video interview may not move forward in the hiring process.

raw.description:
NVIDIA's Vulnerability Operations organization is looking for a Security Software Engineer to help operate and improve our AI-powered vulnerability operations platform. This platform uses LLM agents to scan tens of thousands of repositories and live web applications across NVIDIA, then unifies, verifies, and routes those findings to the engineers who can fix them. You'll join a small, fast-moving team and own real production responsibilities from day one — keeping the scanning fleet healthy, improving the triage experience, and making the data trustworthy.

What you'll be doing:

  • Supporting day-to-day operations of our vulnerability management hub and its two AI scanning engines: monitoring scan fleets and worker queues, investigating stuck or failed scans, and shipping fixes.

  • Building and maintaining features across the stack — Python/FastAPI backend services, React/TypeScript frontends, and Postgres data models Triaging platform feedback from security engineers and repo owners: reproducing bugs, running data reconciliations in SQL, and closing the loop with users

  • Operating our GitOps deployment pipeline (Kubernetes/OpenShift, ArgoCD, Vault) — shipping releases to staging and production, rotating secrets, and validating rollouts

  • Improving scan coverage and data quality: asset inventory across GitLab/GitHub/Gerrit/Perforce, ownership attribution, finding lifecycle and dedup logic

  • Working alongside senior engineers on the LLM agent harnesses that power scanning and verification, and learning how agentic security tooling is built and operated

What we need to see:

  • Bachelor's degree in CS/Engineering or equivalent experience

  • 1–3 years of software engineering experience (internships count), with solid Python fundamentals

  • Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases

  • Comfort in a Linux/Git environment and a willingness to debug across unfamiliar systems

  • Interest in security — you don't need to be a security expert yet, but you should want to become one

  • Strong ownership instincts: you follow problems to root cause and communicate clearly along the way

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Frontend experience with React and TypeScript

  • Exposure to containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, ArgoCD/GitOps) or job-queue/worker architectures (Redis, Celery/ARQ)

  • Hands-on experience with LLM APIs, agent frameworks, or coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, opencode, or similar)

  • Security fundamentals: CTF participation, security coursework, bug bounty writeups, or certifications like Security+ or eJPT

  • Contributions to open-source projects or a portfolio of shipped side projects

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and talented people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our elite engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you!

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 124,000 USD - 195,500 USD for Level 2, and 152,000 USD - 241,500 USD for Level 3.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until September 6, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Position Overview

Marketing's effectiveness is increasingly determined by the systems behind it — the layer that orchestrates AI agents, the data they reason over, and the workflows of every marketing team. Autodesk is investing to build that capability for Worldwide Marketing, and this role leads it.

The Director, Marketing AI Orchestration is responsible for designing and building the AI orchestration layer that makes Worldwide Marketing (WWM) measurably more effective — and, over time, the data and AI substrate that sits beneath it. This is the connective tissue between AI capabilities, marketing data, our martech stack, and the work of every WWM function — and the foundation those capabilities run on.

This is a builder role. We're hiring a platform builder who understands marketing, not a marketer who is curious about AI. Success is shipped capability that drives measurable lift in marketing effectiveness — speed, quality, scale, and revenue. The job to be done is to architect and ship the AI orchestration layer, drive adoption across WWM functions, and establish the measurement framework.

Responsibilities

  • The WWM AI orchestration layer. Architect and build the platform that orchestrates AI agents, models, knowledge, and workflows across marketing. Define what runs autonomously, what is human-in-the-loop, and what stays human-led

  • Capability roadmap. Sequence what gets built based on impact to marketing effectiveness. Make build / buy / partner calls. Own the budget

  • Cross-function integration. Embed the layer into the workflows of every WWM function — Brand & Creative, Growth & Partner Marketing, Industry Portfolio Emerging Business Marketing, Digital Ecommerce, Acquisition & Performance Marketing, Education, Communications, and the new Small Business team. Adoption is engineered as part of the build, not bolted on after

  • Measurement. Define and report the metrics that prove the layer is making marketing more effective. Own the case for continued investment

  • Governance and trust. Build guardrails for brand safety, data privacy, IP, and responsible AI into the platform — as enforced behaviors in the system, not as policy documents

  • Partnerships. Represent marketing's interests in Autodesk's enterprise AI roadmap

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years across platform engineering, AI/data product, or marketing technology — with at least one tour building and shipping a platform that other teams now depend on day-to-day

  • Deep, hands-on fluency with modern AI: agents, RAG, evals, orchestration frameworks, model selection, and MLOps. Has built, not just bought

  • Track record landing technical capability inside a non-technical organization. Adoption is something you engineer for, not hope for

  • Strong product sense and architectural judgment. Ships

  • Excellent executive communication. Can walk an ELT audience through the architecture and the business case in the same meeting

  • Bias toward shipped capability and measured impact over decks, frameworks, and pilots

  • Track record building agentic systems or AI-native platforms in a marketing, sales, or customer-facing context

The Ideal Candidate

What success looks like in 12 months

raw.description:
For more than 170 years, The Hanover has been committed to delivering on our promises and being there when it matters the most. We live our values every day, demonstrating we CARE through our values, Sustainability initiatives and inclusive corporate culture.

Our Allied Healthcare team is seeking a Sr. Underwriting Specialist to join their growing team. This is a full time, exempt role. This is a hybrid or remote opportunity. While candidates based in the South-Central region are preferred, we will consider qualified candidates based anywhere in the United States. POSITION OVERVIEW: Responsible for identifying, soliciting, underwriting and selling new and renewal Allied Healthcare accounts that drive profitable growth and align with industry segments, appetite and mix goals. Apply advanced technical, sales and analytical skills to provide insurance solutions that help Hanover’s customers manage risk. Demonstrates a thorough understanding of Hanover’s strategies and appetites and will use internal and external data to make appropriate individual and portfolio risk decisions. Operates within a broad Letter of Authority for all underwriting decisions and with limited direction while managing an assigned book of business, generally with high technical complexity and coordination.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

Technical Underwriting:

  • Present thorough knowledge and understanding of business strategy.
  • Know and apply advanced underwriting concepts including risk selection, exposure and hazard identification and control, coverage implications, and loss analysis.
  • Possess advanced knowledge of pricing components and rating methodology and correlates pricing to exposure, financial and competitive analysis.
  • Adhere to CAT guidelines and applies increased knowledge of CAT aggregation strategies to decision making.
  • Identify and explain types of coverages and gaps in coverages, correlating exposures and controls to agents to complete our value-added proposition.

Portfolio Management & Financial Acumen:

  • Manage assigned portfolio to achieve gross written premium, profitability, rate, retention, industry and LOB mix, new business and portfolio management goals.
  • Demonstrate ability to properly leverage competencies, act as a resource, and build long-term, profitable and mutually beneficial relationships with agencies, internal management, and external resources.
  • Construct and execute portfolio business plans independently through organized workflow & desk management, which may include special projects.
  • Review key metrics and uncovers trends that may lead to new business opportunities within agents while achieving profitable growth.
  • Drive the implementation of profit improvement initiatives with key agents by leveraging resources
  • Advocate and coordinate with Specialty departments to learn and share knowledge in cross sell opportunities to help manage portfolio/book of business

Sales Management:

  • Operate with a franchise perspective to identify and drive enhanced sell opportunities and create growth within other lines of business and customer segments.
  • Utilize our value proposition to enhance agency economics, partner conversion and product specialization in partnership with local management.
  • Prioritize and drive effective relationship management and producer activities to build trust, facilitate negotiation, and secure commitment in order to improve yield and retention ratios.
  • Independently implement territory business plans, monitors performance, adjusts plan to ensure a substantial pipeline for future profitable growth.
  • Makes sales presentations to agents and customers on a regular basis. Participates in more complex accounts.
  • Ability to uncover customer needs, position specific solutions, handle objections, and close deals.

WHAT YOU NEED TO APPLY:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of Allied Healthcare Underwriting experience.
  • Strong preference for wholesale and non-admitted business background.
  • 5+ years experience of driving agency relationships resulting in profitable new and renewal business.
  • Strong technical knowledge of healthcare facilities.
  • Ability to travel (by car or plane) ~25% of the time.
  • Consistently demonstrates high level of proficiency across underwriting core competencies.
  • Proficient in ability to identify, analyze and solve problems and manage and prioritize multiple concurrent projects.
  • Adaptable to change, exercise influence, and act as a change advocate being open to new and different ways of thinking.
  • Viewed as an informal leader amongst the team and is open to and proactively sharing knowledge and expertise with team.

CAREER DEVELOPMENT:

It’s not just a job, it’s a career, and we are here to support you every step of the way. We want you to be successful and fulfilled. Through on-the-job experiences, personalized coaching and our robust learning and development programs, we encourage you – at every level – to grow and develop.

raw.description:
Founded in 2013, Home Chef is the leading meal solutions company with both a retail and online presence. Available online at and in retail at more than 2,100 Kroger grocery stores, Home Chef is committed to inspiring and enabling more people to cook simple, delicious meals, no matter how busy they are.

In 2023, Home Chef introduced a new brand, Tempo! Tempo features a rotating selection of ready-to-heat meals delivered directly to your door. These meals are better-for-you versions of familiar favorites, designed to save you time and reduce stress while maintaining a healthy lifestyle. Our Tempo menu includes options that are protein-packed, fiber-rich, calorie and carb conscious, keto-friendly, and dietitian-approved.

Similar to our recipes, we recognize that variety is the spice of life, and therefore, our employees also bring their uniqueness and color to our fantastic team. We’re eager to work with humble team players and pragmatic next-level thinkers to innovate on Home Chef’s offerings.

The Customer Experience Associate Position operates Monday - Friday from 10:00am - 6:30pm CST.

Please note: the training for this role begins on Monday 10/26 and runs for 3 weeks, Monday - Friday 9:00am to 5:30p CST. It is a requirement that all new hires are available to attend for the entirety of the training.

Our Customer Experience Associate serves as the front line of communication between the company and our customers. Representatives will respond to customer issues, complaints and inquiries via phone, email and chat.

The Customer Experience Associate is primarily responsible for handling fundamental customer issues such as making account updates, assisting with the use of the platform, and documenting incidents via live support channels. You will train and learn the platform’s basics and use in-house resources, problem-solving, and people skills to support customers. We aim to live our values in every interaction and are looking for Customer Support Associates who care deeply about making everyday lives easier.

As a Customer Support Associate, you will spend your productive time working directly with customers via chat, phone, or email.

Detailed ResponsibilitiesOur shift schedules remain static (the days you work) but your activities per shift will remain fluid and may change depending on business needs. Flexibility and adaptability are required when approaching daily ticket handling responsibilities.Participate in Ticket Handling

  • Participate in Ticket Handling on Voice Channel:
    • Assist customers via incoming phone calls.
    • Spend up to 24 hours per week on the phone channel.
    • Shows up to each shift, spending the proper scheduled amount of time online.
    • Does not miss or decline phone calls unless communicated to team lead.
    • Averages around 10 calls per hour.
  • Participate in Ticket Handling on Email Channel:
    • Assist customers via inbound email and web form tickets.
    • Spend up to 10 hours per week on the email channel
    • Shows up to each shift, replying to roughly 12 email tickets per hour.
    • Cleans out personal ‘inbox’ daily, responding to all replies within 24 hours.
  • Participate in Ticket Handling on Chat Channel:
    • Assist customers via inbound AI chat (helpshift).
    • Spends up to 12 hours per week on the chat channel.
    • Responds to each chat within a defined SLA period.

Research and Understand Current Trends and Issues from Customers

    • Participate in daily/weekly team meetings and stand-ups.
    • Actively looks for trends in our customer inquiries.
    • Researches and resolves complicated issues.
    • Contributes to root-cause analysis of new bugs, operational misses, and service disruptions.

QualificationsThe requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, ability and/or other characteristics needed for this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities.

  • Prior experience in Customer Support or related positions (restaurants, retail, etc.)
  • General high school degree, or equivalent
  • Positive attitude in regards to customer communication, as well as team collaboration.
  • Solid communication skills – both verbal and written
  • Fledgling analysis skills - understands how to spot trends and research common themes
  • Can type a minimum 50 wpm

More About Us

Perks and benefits

  • Candidates can experience Home Chef as a customer - enter promo code PEOPLE30 for $30 off your first order!
  • Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance available
  • Paid holidays, sick time and vacation time
  • 401k program
  • Flexible spending accounts for qualified medical, dependent care, parking, or transit expenses


How We Work Together

We are humble team players.
We are warm and gracious with team members and customers. We seek feedback to improve ourselves - and respectfully listen to and accept input.

We are pragmatic next-level thinkers.
We come up with novel and unique ideas. We explore new strategies to avoid being constrained by conventional thinking.

We take ownership.
We approach ambiguous problems, prepared to dive in, get curious, and learn more. We are results-driven, always challenging ourselves to exceed goals.

Be at Home at Home Chef

We all show up authentically at Home Chef. Our team includes individuals with a variety of identities, backgrounds, and perspectives. You can trust that you’ll be able to bring your whole self to an inclusive and enjoyable workplace.

We welcome people of all races, colors, religions, national origin or ancestry, sex (including sexual identity), age, physical or mental disabilities, pregnancy, veteran or military status, unfavorable discharge from military service, genetic information, sexual orientation, marital status, order of protection status, citizenship status, arrest record or expunged/sealed convictions, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law.

If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact our People team at .

Job Title: Solutions Engineer – Pricing Technology & Automation

Job Location: Virtual United States New Mexico

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Who we are

We’re a global, midsize CRO that pushes boundaries, innovates and invents because the path to a cure for the world’s most persistent diseases is not paved by those who play it safe. It is built by those who take pioneering, creative approaches and implement them with quality and excellence.

We are Worldwide Clinical Trials, and we are a global team of over 3,500+ experts, bright thinkers, dreamers and doers and, together, we are changing the way the world experiences CROs – in the best possible way.

Our mission is to work with passion and purpose every day to improve lives and we are looking for others who value this same pursuit.

Why Worldwide

We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us!

SUMMARY: Implement, configure, and maintain the pricing tools and automated systems used in the management and delivery of Commercial Solutions initiatives, meeting business and technical specifications by contributing at all stages of the software development life cycle. This role delivers specialized development and integration expertise including VBA, SQL, Power Query, API, and Microsoft Power Platform to advance the REBOOT Pricing Strategy, drive pricing tool modernization, and lead process automation efforts. The position is focused on strategic delivery and future-state modernization rather than legacy operational ticket support.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Tasks may include but are not limited to:

  • Ensure pricing tools and production systems function to meet service level agreements by analyzing and resolving issues, including implementing bug fixes in alignment with SOPs and established governance processes.
  • Design and implement software solutions to meet business requirements, including data integration, automation, monitoring, and reporting across a variety of platforms, tools, and languages (VBA, SQL, Power Query, API, Power Platform).
  • Lead the technical execution of pricing tool modernization and consolidation efforts in support of the REBOOT Pricing Strategy initiative.
  • Support the Project Manager and other functions with the production and review of specifications, plans, reports, and technical documentation throughout system development and support.
  • Review and translate User Requirements Specifications into technical designs appropriate for pricing tool and automation solutions.
  • Prepare, review, and approve design and integration documentation for pricing systems and cross-functional data flows.
  • Perform coding and configuration to meet delivery timelines, fulfill business and technical requirements, and align with SOPs.
  • Perform formal code reviews and informal unit testing to meet delivery timelines and maintain solution quality.
  • Complete Traceability Matrices and maintain audit-ready documentation as required.
  • Work closely with Strategic Finance, Proposal Management, Contracts, and Commercial Operations to define and coordinate integration processes between systems and vendors (e.g., Salesforce, Certinia).
  • Interact and communicate effectively with project teams in both technical and non-technical terms to determine requirements, configuration needs, and acceptance criteria.
  • Write and execute scripts as required to meet delivery timelines.
  • Support Test Analysts and business users during formal testing and quality review.
  • Perform QC checks of manual data edits and other tasks where required to protect data integrity.
  • Assist in the investigation and resolution of issues and/or incidents affecting pricing tools and automated workflows.
  • Ensure all activities are appropriately documented and stored in accordance with relevant SOPs and client requirements.
  • Provide support and training to users of in-house pricing tool.
  • Identify and implement process improvements that reduce manual effort, increase scalability, and strengthen governance and auditability.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

The duties and responsibilities listed above are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all-inclusive.

OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

  • Ability to communicate concisely and effectively in both written and spoken English.
  • Proficient in the use of common office software, with advanced Microsoft Excel capability.
  • Able to work independently or within a multi-disciplinary team.
  • High attention to detail.
  • Able to be creative, adapt to new technologies, concepts, and processes, make improvements, and solve problems.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Educated to degree level in a relevant discipline (e.g., Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Analytics) or able to demonstrate equivalent experience.
  • Sound working knowledge of one or more of the following: the Microsoft toolset including .NET Framework, C#, Visual Studio, and advanced VBA; relational databases and SQL; Power Query and the Microsoft Power Platform; API/bus integration technologies; Java and Java Server technologies; or UNIX including C, C++.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and automating pricing, financial, or business process tools using advanced Excel, VBA, SQL, and data transformation techniques.
  • 2+ years' experience in a combination of Contract Research Organization (CRO) experience, IRT study delivery, clinical systems development, or comparable business systems / pricing technology development desired.
  • Familiarity with clinical trials, patient safety, data integrity, and associated regulations.

Promotion to the next level is not automatic based on years of experience. Personnel are evaluated on proven competency, level of responsibility, and ability to work independently.

At Worldwide Clinical Trials, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and equitable workplace by providing transparent compensation.

United States of America - $70,500.00 - $139,500.00

The salary range provided is intended to give candidates an understanding of potential earnings. Compensation will fall within the provided range, and it not a guarantee of exact salary. The final salary will be determined based on relevant experience, performance, education, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, we offer a competitive benefits package depending on location. We ensure pay equity and transparency and comply with all applicable labor laws. Salary information will be discussed during the interview process, and we encourage candidates to inquire about compensation at any stage.

We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.

raw.excerpt: At Roofr, we’re obsessed with our customers.  We constantly gather feedback to shape, prioritize, and launch the products they truly need.
raw.description:
At Roofr, we’re obsessed with our customers. We constantly gather feedback to shape, prioritize, and launch the products they truly need. That’s what makes Roofr’s CRM special. We started by building essential sales tools like aerial roof measurements and digital sales proposals. But when our customers asked for a simple, affordable way to manage and scale their entire businesses, we listened. So, we created a CRM that connects these solutions—along with payments, material ordering, and more—into a seamless, powerful platform. With a clear roadmap ahead, we’re excited to continue expanding and leading the market with innovative products.

We have an amazing culture, strong financials, and best-in-class company metrics. It’s an exciting time to be part of an extraordinary startup that is already successful, yet still early enough to offer its team significant growth, equity, and the opportunity to make a real impact.

This position is for an existing vacancy.

Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, the Head of Customer Experience will define and execute Roofr's post-sale customer strategy, leading Customer Experience team.

This leader will be responsible for building a future-focused organization that leverages AI, automation, and digital-first experiences to accelerate customer time-to-value, improve retention, and deliver world-class customer experiences at scale.

Success in this role requires an operator who can balance strategy and tactical execution to build high-performing teams, optimize processes, and partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to continuously optimize the end-to-end customer journey and create a cohesive experience across every customer touchpoint.

What you’ll get to do:

Build the Future of Customer Experience

  • Develop and execute Roofr's Customer Experience strategy aligned with our Product-Led Growth (PLG) and Product-Led Sales (PLS) models.
  • Design a scalable customer journey that enables customers to achieve value quickly while creating a seamless experience across every customer touchpoint.
  • Establish a customer-first culture focused on simplicity, speed, and measurable customer outcomes.
  • Own the holistic customer experience across the post-sale lifecycle, identifying opportunities to improve the journey from onboarding through adoption, engagement, support, and retention.
  • Create a consistent experience across digital, self-service, and human-assisted interactions.

Lead Customer Operations

Provide leadership and/or support across:

  • Customer Support
  • Onboarding & Customer Success (Interim)
  • Customer Retention (Interim)

Develop leaders, build organizational capability, establish operational rhythms, and create clear performance metrics that drive accountability and continuous improvement.

Connect these functions into a cohesive Customer Experience organization, breaking down operational silos and ensuring customers experience a consistent journey regardless of how or where they engage with Roofr.

Drive AI & Automation

Champion the use of AI and automation to transform both the customer and employee experience.

Examples include:

  • AI-enabled customer support
  • Intelligent ticket routing and case management
  • Automated onboarding workflows
  • Digital customer education
  • Self-service knowledge management
  • Customer health monitoring
  • Predictive churn identification
  • AI-enhanced productivity tools for customer-facing teams
  • Automated journeys that guide customers toward activation, adoption, and expansion

Continuously evaluate emerging technologies that improve efficiency while maintaining a high-quality customer experience.

Improve Customer Outcomes

Own and improve key customer metrics, including:

  • Customer Retention
  • Gross Revenue Retention (GRR)
  • Customer Health
  • Time to Value
  • Product Adoption
  • Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)
  • Net Promoter Score (NPS)
  • Support SLAs
  • Resolution Time

Use customer insights and data to identify friction, improve onboarding, increase product adoption, and strengthen long-term customer relationships.

Partner Cross-Functionally

Serve as the voice of the customer across the business by partnering closely with:

  • Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Finance
  • Translate customer feedback into actionable recommendations that influence product strategy, operational improvements, and customer experience initiatives.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to identify and address experience gaps within the product itself.
  • Bring a holistic view of customer behavior, needs, and friction points to cross-functional planning and prioritization.

Build for Scale

  • Develop scalable systems, processes, and operating models that support rapid company growth.
  • Create dashboards, forecasting models, workforce planning, and operational KPIs that provide visibility into customer performance and organizational health.
  • Connect customer behavior, product usage, support interactions, onboarding progress, and retention signals to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Build feedback loops that translate customer insights into improvements across people, processes, product, and technology.

Drive Holistic Customer Journey Optimization

  • Map and measure key customer journeys to understand where customers experience friction, where they derive value, and where Roofr can proactively improve the experience.
  • Prioritize journey improvements based on customer impact, business value, and scalability.
  • Establish a culture of continuous experimentation and optimization, using data and customer feedback to test, learn, and improve the customer experience over time.

What You’ll Bring to the Role:

  • 10+ years of experience leading Customer Experience, Customer Success, Customer Operations, or Support organizations within a B2B SaaS company.
  • 5+ years leading multiple customer-facing functions through managers and senior leaders.
  • Experience supporting SMB customers in a Product-Led Growth (PLG) and/or Product-Led Sales (PLS) environment.
  • Demonstrated success improving customer retention, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency.
  • Experience implementing AI and automation to improve customer outcomes and team productivity.
  • Strong understanding of onboarding, customer support, customer lifecycle management, and digital customer engagement.
  • Experience owning or optimizing end-to-end customer journeys across multiple customer-facing functions and touchpoints.
  • Proven ability to build scalable processes and high-performing teams in high-growth environments.
  • Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills.
  • Exceptional executive presence and cross-functional leadership.

Who You Are:

  • Awareness that strategic clarity comes from a deep understanding of customers, products, teams and processes. You become decisive through deliberate learning and bring a growth mindset to every role.
  • Experience scaling a Customer Experience organization and innovating to solve problems.
  • Experience partnering closely with Product and Engineering to improve customer adoption and product usability.
  • You think beyond individual functions and see the customer experience as one connected journey rather than a series of departmental handoffs.
  • You naturally look for friction across the customer lifecycle and bring teams together to solve the underlying problem.
  • You are deeply customer-centric and use a combination of qualitative feedback, behavioral data, and business metrics to understand what customers need and where the experience can improve.
  • Familiarity with platforms such as Intercom, Gainsight, Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, or similar customer technologies.
  • Experience designing digital-first customer journeys and self-service customer experiences.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS metrics including GRR, churn, customer health, adoption, and customer lifetime value.

Success in Your First 12 Months

  • Establish a unified Customer Experience strategy across Support, Onboarding, and Retention.
  • Map and establish a clear view of the end-to-end customer journey, including key moments that matter, friction points, and opportunities for optimization.
  • Reduce customer effort by implementing AI-enabled support and automation.
  • Improve onboarding efficiency and accelerate customer time-to-value.

  • Improve customer retention and satisfaction metrics.
  • Establish measurable customer journey KPIs and feedback loops that enable continuous optimization.
  • Build scalable operating processes and dashboards that support Roofr's continued growth.

Compensation Band: $200-250k CAD

About Us
BRIGHTSCOUT is a global B2B branding and development agency specializing in elevating emerging tech businesses through uniquely crafted brands and standout apps. Comprised of top-tier talent worldwide, we offer a powerful blend of exquisite design, robust development, and strategic acumen. More than a company, Brightscout is a tribe dedicated to disrupting the tech industry with bold ideas and collaborative genius.

The Role

As a Growth Strategist at BRIGHTSCOUT, you will oversee website and branding initiatives to ensure our digital experiences drive real, measurable results. You will collaborate closely with Brand Strategists, the Messaging team, Designers, and Developers to translate positioning into clear narratives, high-performing website architecture, and cohesive activation campaigns across every digital touchpoint.

You will connect strategy to performance — aligning brand expression, SEO/AEO, content structure, technical implementation, and conversion pathways to pipeline goals. Through data, experimentation, and continuous optimization, you’ll ensure our work doesn’t just look exceptional — it drives growth, improves lead quality, and strengthens market position for our clients.

Responsibilities

  • Lead website and digital experience audits to identify positioning, structural, and performance gaps
  • Translate brand strategy into clear website architecture and conversion pathways
  • Oversee the strategy and execution of brand activation campaigns, collaborating closely with Brand Strategists and the Messaging team, tying performance back to pipeline and growth metrics.
  • Own and implement SEO fundamentals (technical, on-page, structural), conducting keyword and intent research aligned to ICPs, buyer journeys, and business goals.
  • Lead AEO strategy by structuring content for AI-driven and answer-based search environments, ensuring visibility across both traditional search and emerging discovery platforms.
  • Analyze analytics and performance data to uncover friction, drop-off, and growth opportunities
  • Develop CRO roadmaps, testing hypotheses, and post-launch optimization plans
  • Ensure alignment between brand positioning, content strategy, and funnel performance
  • Support pre-sales with strategic digital POVs and performance-driven recommendations
  • Lead client presentations, workshops, and executive-level conversations with confidence and strategic clarity.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience in digital strategy, growth strategy, or integrated marketing strategy, preferably within an agency environment.
  • Strong understanding of B2B marketing ecosystems, particularly within technology or SaaS.
  • Hands-on experience with leading CRM systems (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio, Pipedrive) to manage pipeline reporting, and revenue attribution.
  • Proficiency with digital analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Amplitude) to build event tracking frameworks, analyze funnels, and drive data-informed growth decisions.
  • Experience using CRO and experimentation platforms (e.g., Optimizely, VWO, AB Tasty, Hotjar) to run A/B tests, analyze user behavior, and improve conversion performance.
  • Expertise with SEO and search optimization tools (e.g., Ahrefs, Surfer, Google Search Console) and modern AEO strategies to improve organic visibility across traditional and AI-driven search engines.
  • Proven experience aligning brand, website, content, and performance initiatives into cohesive digital systems.
  • Experience leading client workshops and presenting strategic recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical thinking combined with clear communication and structured storytelling.
  • Ability to operate independently, define frameworks from scratch, and drive clarity in complex environments.

Our Values

  • Lead with Heart: We build honest, trusting relationships and care for each other.
  • Break Convention: We seek bold ideas, we transform fearless creativity into tangible results.
  • Bring Order to the Chaos: We transform complexity into clarity.
  • Be a Champion: We strive for excellence.

Why Us

  • Unlimited PTO: Enjoy a truly flexible work-life balance with our unlimited paid time off policy. Take the time you need to recharge and perform at your best.
  • Remote Work: Work from anywhere! We embrace remote work, giving you the freedom to choose your ideal work environment.
  • Flexible Schedule Tied To Project Needs: We understand that life happens. Our flexible schedules, aligned with project milestones, allow you to manage your time effectively and achieve your best results.
  • Salary in USD: Receive competitive compensation in USD.

Ready to Elevate your Career at Brightscout?

At BRIGHTSCOUT, we value more than skills and experience; we seek individuals who embody kindness, empathy, and collaboration in their work. We believe these qualities contribute to the team and the company's overall success.

BRIGHTSCOUT is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. raw.description:
Job Posting Title:

Account Manager, OTAs (O-EMEA)

Req ID:

10158149

Job Description:

About the Role & Team

As an Account Manager specialising in OTA Partnerships, you will grow and develop Disney’s Online Travel Agency partnerships across EMEA, excluding the UK. The role focuses on improving the visibility, positioning, and booking performance of Disney Parks and Resorts on key third-party travel platforms.

In this role, you will lead commercially driven account plans and partner marketing initiatives designed to strengthen distribution, optimise channel performance, and deliver measurable revenue growth. You will translate the OTA strategy into actionable partner plans, collaborating closely with local market teams, marketing functions, central stakeholders, and external partners to deliver integrated activity across multiple markets.

Success in this role requires strong commercial acumen, effective stakeholder management, and the ability to operate with pace and agility. You will bring structure, clarity, and momentum to a growing distribution channel, balancing revenue objectives with brand integrity, market requirements, and an exceptional guest experience.

Values

You’ll join a team grounded in our Disney values, acting with Integrity, welcoming everyone through Inclusion, embracing boundless Creativity, working together through Collaboration and caring deeply for our Community. These values shape how we work and how we support one another every day.

What you will do

In this skilled, experienced role, you will lead commercially focused account plans and partner marketing activity that strengthen distribution, improve channel performance, and drive measurable revenue growth across O‑EMEA OTAs, acting as a lead, mentor, and problem‑solver for cross‑functional partners and project teams.

  • Grow Disney’s OTA partnerships across O‑EMEA by expanding distribution, improving visibility, and driving measurable revenue performance through key travel platforms.

  • Develop annual account plans for priority OTA partners, aligned to business priorities, market opportunities, and channel performance goals, acting as a subject matter expert for OTA strategy.

  • Lead partner marketing activity with clear objectives, ensuring campaigns improve visibility, conversion, and booking performance across multiple markets.

  • Work with country teams and central stakeholders to shape locally relevant, commercially focused OTA plans that remain consistent with wider Disney priorities and brand standards.

  • Build strong relationships with OTA partners, using performance insight and engagement to unlock new commercial opportunities and secure win‑win outcomes.

  • Manage a focused portfolio of priority OTA partners, potentially supporting other commercial partners or market activity, and lead cross‑functional projects with moderate complexity and resource requirements.

  • Use data, insight, and market feedback to identify opportunities, shape recommendations, and improve partner performance over time, explaining difficult concepts and influencing stakeholders to adopt new approaches.

  • Coordinate integrated OTA commercial and marketing activation plans across timing, messaging, product priorities, localisation, and partner requirements.

  • Manage internal stakeholder alignment across markets, marketing, commercial, creative, and approvals to ensure OTA activity is delivered clearly, on brand, and on time.

  • Improve how Walt Disney World Resort and Disneyland Resort products are presented across third‑party platforms, ensuring clear content, strong merchandising, and accurate product information.

  • Track performance and turn data into clear actions that improve conversion, revenue, and partner effectiveness, contributing insight to planning and forecasting processes.

  • Contribute to OTA strategy by sharing market insight, partner feedback, and recommendations from across the region, helping to shape the future of this developing growth channel.

  • Build simple, scalable ways of working that make the OTA channel easier to manage, measure, and grow, while mentoring others on best practices as a skilled team player and lead.

  • Demonstrate strong collaboration, planning, and accountability by aligning work with organizational goals, holding yourself and partners to commitments, and fostering effective teamwork across markets.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Strong commercial judgement and travel industry account management experience, with the ability to balance revenue growth, brand integrity, guest experience, and OTA or multi-market distribution priorities when shaping account plans and partner recommendations.

  • Proven ability to develop and deliver partner marketing activity, including campaign planning, promotional execution, digital activation, creative development, and performance review to improve visibility, conversion, and booking results.

  • Highly analytical, with the ability to interpret data, assess OTA distribution performance, identify trends or risks, and translate insights into clear commercial recommendations for internal teams and external partners.

  • Strong stakeholder management, communication, and relationship-building skills, with experience collaborating across multiple markets, central functions, matrix organisations, and external partners to align priorities and deliver activity effectively.

  • Excellent planning and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, lead cross-functional initiatives, and bring structure, pace, and momentum in a fast-paced or developing channel.

  • Experience working across EMEA markets, demonstrating cultural sensitivity and the ability to adapt approaches to local market nuances.

  • Strong English language skills; additional European languages are desirable.

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in a relevant field, plus a minimum of 7 years’ relevant experience in travel industry sales, account management, or commercial and marketing roles, ideally with OTA or multi-market exposure.

  • Experience in key account management across retail travel trade, OTAs, or tour operators, with a track record of delivering against annual sales targets.

The Perks

  • 25 days annual leave

  • Private medical insurance & dental care

  • Free Park Entry: You will have the opportunity to enter any of our parks with your family and friends for free

  • Disney Discounts: you are entitled to discounts on designated Disney products, resort F&B and ticketing

  • Excellent parental and guardian leave

  • Employee Resource Groups – WOMEN @ Disney, Disney Mosaic, Disney PRIDE, our disability & neurodiversity focused group - ENABLED, and our Mental Health & Wellbeing Group, TRUST.

The Walt Disney Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We strive to be a diverse workforce that is representative of our audiences, and where all can thrive and belong. Disney is committed to forming a team that includes and respects a variety of voices, identities, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

raw.description:
Overview:

Reporting to the Field Reimbursement Director, Lead, the Associate Director, Field Reimbursement will optimize access to Alnylam products in his/her region by understanding and addressing reimbursement and patient access challenges. This position requires a professional who can leverage his/her technical expertise and experience to deliver educational, reimbursement in-service programs to all sites of care (Medical Doctors Office, Alternative Infusion Centers, Hospital Outpatient Department, etc.) and manage access and reimbursement issues by initiating as well as leading action plans to resolve these issues.

A key component of this role is the ability to establish and deepen customer relationships through quality interactions with access and reimbursement focused external stakeholders at targeted strategic accounts. As such, extensive knowledge of ‘buy and bill’ products and prior experience with high-touch, specialty products are essential.

The Field Reimbursement Team is a critical part of the commercial strategy, working closely with National Account Leads (NALs), Health Systems Directors (HSDs), Regional Account Leads (RALs), Site of Care Directors, Patient Services, the broader Reimbursement team, and Sales to support Alnylam’s patient-focused vision of harnessing a revolution in biology for human health.

The successful candidate must be passionate about science and deeply motivated by the quest of delivering value to patients with the long-term success of the company in mind. He/she will work collaboratively with both internal and external stakeholders to build tactical plans to execute strategic imperatives.

This position supports the Northwest region, which includes the following states: Alaska, Washington, Oregon, Idaho, Montana, and Wyoming.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Optimizes access to the full Alnylam portfolio of products by ensuring that provider accounts understand access and reimbursement dynamics
  • Proactively identifies trends impacting barriers to access or reimbursement and creates solutions
  • Works with internal stakeholders and providers to support treatment pathways for patients
  • Proactively engages with key stakeholders in accounts, including Intake/Authorization teams, billing compliance, Finance executives (Revenue Cycle, Revenue Integrity), Infusion Center management and decision-makers and key Pharmacy Stakeholders
  • Responsible for identifying, addressing and supporting education to resolve outstanding claim payment issues
  • Provides mentorship and guidance to case managers and field reimbursement managers on case-specific complex PA/Appeal issues
  • Provides case-specific PA/Appeal support and site of care options for the rare business
  • Maintains relationships with Medicare Administrative Contractors (MACs) to optimize coverage for Alnylam therapies and monitors Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) and National Coverage Determinations (NCDs)
  • Works with Public Policy & Government Relations team on engagement strategies and tactics regarding MACs or local policy changes as well as state-level public policy initiatives
  • Utilizes reporting dashboards to track critical metrics and key performance indicators (KPIs)
  • Ensures compliance with all corporate and industry policies in collaboration with Alnylam Legal, Regulatory and Compliance

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • 5+ years prior pharma/biotech or other related and relevant healthcare experience
  • 3+ years of field reimbursement experience in “buy and bill” preferably in rare disease, oncology, specialty products and/or infusions/injectables
  • Established relationships with Medicare Administrative Contractors (MACs) highly preferred
  • Strong knowledge of the US payer landscape
  • Deep understanding of both medical benefit and pharmacy benefit across payer types (Medicare, Medicaid, commercial, VA/DoD, etc.) and sites of care (Hospital Outpatient Department, free standing centers and home infusion)
  • Proven ability to identify key access and reimbursement barriers to treatment and design effective resolution plans
  • Exceptional professional communication, interpersonal and problem-solving skills necessary to interact with decision makers (CFO and other C-suite level stakeholders)
  • Demonstrated ability to lead without authority in a highly collaborative matrix and fast-paced environment
  • Self-starter who is enthusiastic about rare disease and Alnylam’s core values: fiercely innovative, open culture, purposeful urgency, passion for excellence, and commitment to people
  • Ability to travel up to 50%
  • Must reside in geography or within 75 miles of the boundary and with reasonable proximity to a mid-size or larger airport

raw.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

The Pricing Strategy team owns the end-to-end pricing, packaging, and commercialization strategy across GitLab's product portfolio, from Premium and Ultimate tiers to GitLab Duo and our expanding artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities. As a Staff-level pricing and commercialization expert, you'll design, scale, and drive GitLab's enterprise monetization and commercial buying programs as an individual contributor at the top of our individual contributor track. You'll serve as the architect of our Enterprise Agreements, cloud marketplace and channel pricing structures, and competitive commercial programs, partnering across Product, go-to-market (GTM), Finance, Sales, Renewals, Product Marketing, Partners, and Deal Desk to turn pricing decisions into scalable programs that work for customers and the field.

What you'll do

  • Drive competitive pricing programs and tactical deal plays, including promotions, competitive replacement offers, and deal support, that help the field win and displace competitors in the DevSecOps and AI tooling market.
  • Own list-to-net price realization strategy across products, geographic regions, GTM segments, and routes to market.
  • Partner with Product Management, Product Marketing, and GTM leaders to shape new packaging and pricing proposals, evaluate monetization models as GitLab's AI and platform capabilities evolve, and bring data-backed recommendations to cross-functional and executive stakeholders.
  • Act as the go-to expert for pricing enablement by building training, playbooks, and battlecards that give the field confidence in pricing conversations and help them explain commercial value.
  • Put commercial programs into practice in partnership with Deal Desk, Revenue Operations, and Data teams, staying hands-on with execution as well as strategy.
  • Define, launch, and scale Enterprise Agreements and marketed bundling strategies that simplify transactions, encourage multi-product and GitLab Duo adoption, and maximize customer lifetime value.
  • Define channel and marketplace pricing strategy, including tiering, discounting frameworks, and margin structures, across resellers, global systems integrators, independent software vendors, and cloud marketplaces such as Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform, and Microsoft Azure.
  • Document decisions and frameworks in the GitLab handbook and default to asynchronous, written communication as part of GitLab's all-remote, globally distributed team.

What you'll bring

  • Extensive experience across strategy consulting, pricing, strategic finance, or corporate or deal strategy, ideally at a software as a service or enterprise software company.
  • Deep experience in monetization or pricing strategy, including direct ownership of pricing waterfalls, enterprise buying programs such as Enterprise License Agreements or Enterprise Agreements, or channel and marketplace pricing models.
  • A track record of operating as a go-to expert without formal authority. Other teams bring you difficult pricing questions, and your recommendations carry weight with senior stakeholders because of the thinking and evidence behind them.
  • Hands-on work with AI agents and automations that real teams used in production
  • A bias toward iteration and shipping. You're comfortable making a strategic call, documenting the reasoning, and adjusting as new data comes in instead of waiting for perfect information.
  • Strong written communication skills and the ability to work independently in an asynchronous, all-remote environment while driving cross-functional agreement.
  • Experience partnering with and influencing senior stakeholders across Product, Sales, and Finance, including vice president and senior vice president levels, as an individual contributor.

About the team

The Pricing Strategy team shapes how GitLab packages, prices, and commercializes its product portfolio. The team works across Product, GTM, Finance, Partners, Deal Desk, Renewals, and Data to create pricing frameworks and buying programs that can scale. In this role, you'll help connect product and monetization strategy with the practical programs used by customers, partners, and the field.

  • Heart–We care deeply and commit to do what matters

  • Integrity–We build trust through our words and actions

  • Community-Together, we are an unstoppable force for good

  • Belonging-We serve as allies to the mission, and to each other

  • Progress-We continually move onward and upward

Summary

    The Senior Workforce Planning Associate is responsible for optimizing workforce scheduling, forecasting, intraday monitoring, and reporting for the Crisis Intervention vertical in the US and Mexico. This role collaborates with the Director of Contact Center Technology to ensure that staffing levels are aligned with operational demands and with the CI Director in MX for analyzing and tracking operational data, identifying areas for improvement, and developing effective operational solutions to address emerging challenges. This manager plays a critical role in managing real-time adherence, forecasting, volume fluctuations, and scheduling efficiencies. This role acts as a mentor and support to other members of the workforce management team.

Roles and Responsibilities

    • Monitor real-time adherence and volume to investigate variances, taking corrective actions as necessary to ensure staffing levels align with actual needs.

    • Develop and manage efficient schedules that meet business demands while balancing employee availability and operational needs.

    • Coordinate with the training and volunteer operations teams to manage schedules for counselor role-plays and New Counselor Shifts.

    • Develop and manage staff forecasts based on historical data, trends, and projected volume to ensure optimal resource allocation.

    • Generate regular reports and conduct ad-hoc analyses at the direction of the WFM Director, providing actionable insights on performance and staffing effectiveness.

    • Responsible for long-term paid time off (PTO) bidding and planning to ensure that staffing levels are maintained.

    • Manage the shift bidding process, ensuring that all shifts are filled in accordance with business needs and employee preferences.

    • Work with leadership to approve or deny time-off requests from a staffing perspective, using established procedures, ensuring that adequate coverage is maintained at all times.

    • Respond to volume fluctuations by requesting additional shifts, offering time off, or utilizing other established levers to maintain operational stability.

    • Flexibility to work a blend of weekend and evening shifts as needed to support the Crisis Intervention team.

    • Other relevant duties and responsibilities as assigned

    • Conduct "what-if" analysis to evaluate scheduling scenarios and ensure that schedules are optimized for operational efficiency.

    • Mentor and assist other WFM staff

    • Partner with Crisis Intervention Leadership to help educate on WFM best practices.

    • Identify patterns, improvement opportunities, and areas of focus from the collected data, and collaborate with team leaders to implement solutions and adjustments based on the analyses conducted.

    • Participate in the review and update of policies and procedures to optimize operational processes.

    • Collect, process, and analyze data related to contact interactions, team performance, and trends on the support platform crossing information with the MCC funnel and performance.

    • Create reports and presentations summarizing findings and providing data-driven recommendations.

What you bring with your talent:

    • Strong knowledge and hands-on experience with Genesys Cloud WFM or similar workforce management systems.

    • Bachelor’s degree in business administration or similar role OR 4+ years experience in workforce planning, scheduling, or related roles.

    • Previous experience in contact centers or online support services.

    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for interacting with cross-functional teams and leadership.

    • Ability to work a flexible schedule, including weekends and evenings as required.

You'll investigate and evaluate PIP/MP claims and coverage while managing your own inventory of claims.   • Excited about building a tech-driven claims organization
  • Passionate about the customer experience
  • You're empathetic and patient with everyone you interact with

Additionally, we will
  • Listen to your feedback to enhance and improve upon the long-standing challenges of an adjuster and the claims role
  • Work toward reducing and eliminating all the administrative work from an adjuster role
  • Foster a culture of empathy, transparency, and empowerment in a remote-first environment

Who We Are

We are seeking a remote tech assist to provide real-time support to field technicians, resolving provisioning, facility, and inventory issues to ensure seamless service delivery.
