raw.excerpt: Role Purpose The AI Strategy role identifies, frames, validates, and prioritizes the AI opportunities that offer potential for significant enterprise revenue and margin growth.
raw.description:
Role Purpose

The AI Strategy role identifies, frames, validates, and prioritizes the AI opportunities that offer potential for significant enterprise revenue and margin growth. This individual acts as a organizational thought leader to our company's leadership in order to decide what opportunities to attack, how to attack them, how to prioritize them, and what to initiate, accelerate, or stop ahead of critical investment decisions.

This is a strategy and business-judgment role. It sits with SBU and functional leaders to turn financial, operational, and clinical problems into investment-ready theses: the problem, the customer or clinician, the first principles approach, the opportunity value, the investment required to unlock that value, the risk, and the conditions under which the work should proceed or cease.

This is not a builder role. Solution design, technical feasibility, and build execution sit with AI Business Partners, Product Builders, enterprise architecture, and technology colleagues. AI Strategy owns the quality of the question and the quality of the bet.

Key Responsibilities

Problem Framing & Opportunity Assessment

  • Partner with enterprise and SBU, finance, operations, and clinical and pharmacy leaders to identify business problems where AI could create significant, even non-linear, value unlock.

  • Frame each opportunity in business terms: who is served, what changes, what value is at stake, what risk is introduced, and what would have to be true for the work to succeed.

  • Conduct rigorous qualitative and quantitative user and market research to validate the opportunity in order to derisk the bet.

  • Distinguish problems for which AI offers non-linear advantages, (i.e. not just problems that need process, policy, data, or operating-model change), and conduct a first principles decomposition of the problem's points of leverage and AI's ability to unlock value against those points.

  • Translate enterprise and SBU challenges into opportunities with measurable financial value, outcomes, and experiential improvements, not a list of use cases.

  • Bring a clear recommendation to proceed, sequence, partner, or stop.

Portfolio Strategy & Investment Framing

  • Stack-rank opportunities on strategic alignment, customer or clinical value, feasibility (in partnership with product and technology colleagues), risk, cost, and speed to value, developing a robust and rigorous scoring methodology aligned to our organization's strategic needs.

  • Develop business cases, investment theses, value realization models, and roadmaps that a business owner have data to stand behind.

  • Assess buy, build, partner, and hybrid paths as business choices, and flag duplicate investment across teams.

  • Explore non-traditional investment routes to solving problems, such as exploration of venture investment, incubation, or even M&A discussion, alongside colleagues from these areas.

  • Define success metrics and measurement instrumentation before work is staffed, including adoption, productivity, financial impact, quality, customer experience, and clinical outcomes.

  • Revisit the AI portfolio as evidence arrives, and retire or reframe work that is not earning the next increment of investment, seeking to drive an "innovation rate of return" on the total body of work.

Progression Criteria & Value Discipline

  • Establish stage-gates and evidence expectations for concept, pilot, and broader adoption decisions.

  • Define what good enough to continue looks like in business and adoption terms, and name the owner who will be accountable if the work scales.

  • Identify the workflow, operating-model, and organizational changes required for value to show up, not only the technology change.

  • Use results from live work to refine what the enterprise should fund next.

  • Partner with the DD&AI program function and technology partners, including the AI Enablement team, on portfolio tracking and value reporting. Note that this role does not serve as the project or program manager, but facilitates key reporting around our AI IO return on invested capital and effort.

Healthcare Context & Responsible Use

  • Align recommendations with clinical and operational realities, regulatory context, and member or provider impact.

  • Partner with legal, compliance, privacy, information security, governance, and model risk management when an opportunity raises those questions.

  • Apply Responsible AI principles as decision criteria, including transparency, fairness, privacy, reliability, human oversight, and accountability.

  • Recommend where AI should automate, assist, recommend, or escalate, and name the human who remains accountable.

  • Raise risk early enough that it shapes the investment decision, not the launch review.

Stakeholder Alignment & Influence

  • Advise business, clinical, product, and operations leaders on which AI bets are worth making and why, using rigorous analyses and data.

  • Communicate recommendations clearly and compellingly through business narratives, simple decision frameworks, and financial or outcome models.

  • Align stakeholders with competing priorities and variable AI fluency.

  • Represent AI Strategy in intake, planning, and investment conversations.

  • Mentor colleagues on problem-framing quality. Note that this role does not coordinate the delivery function.

Qualifications & Experience

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Healthcare Administration, Public Health, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Typically 8+ years in strategy, product strategy, management consulting, business operations, finance, digital transformation, or a related field inside a large or regulated enterprise.

  • Demonstrated experience framing business problems, writing investment cases, and helping leaders make fund, sequence, or stop decisions.

  • Ability to evaluate value, adoption risk, implementation complexity, and total cost of ownership at a decision-quality level, in partnership with technology counterparts.

  • Working literacy in what current AI capabilities can and cannot do, sufficient to challenge weak use cases and to know when a technology partner or AI expert needs to be in the room.

  • Knowledge of what it takes to build great products, including an appreciation and intuition around the user's needs and experience expectations.

  • Experience operating in a matrix, with competing stakeholders and incomplete information.

  • Clear written and verbal communication with senior business leaders, with the ability to make a recommendation rather than only present options.

Preferred

  • Master's degree, MBA, or equivalent advanced degree.

  • Experience in healthcare payer, provider, pharmacy, clinical, benefits, or healthcare services environments.

  • Familiarity with clinical workflows, claims, utilization management, prior authorization, care management, provider operations, or member engagement.

  • Deep expertise in leveraging AI to solve problems at a root cause level.

  • Experience with Responsible AI, privacy, or regulatory considerations as they affect product and investment decisions.

  • Experience managing or advising an innovation or digital portfolio, including stopping or redirecting work.

  • Experience partnering with product, technology, and delivery teams without owning their work.

Core Competencies

  • Problem Framing: Identifies the problem worth solving and states it so a leader can act.

  • Value Orientation: Anchors recommendations in rigorous financial (e.g. revenue, cost, margin, etc.), clinical outcomes, and experiential differentiation metrics, not just as interesting opportunities.

  • Portfolio Judgment: Sequences work, stops work, and protects reuse over another isolated initiative.

  • Product-Mindedness: Fundamentally understands what it means to build great products.

  • AI Literacy: Knows enough about developing AI solutions to decompose a use case and to pull in specialists when needed.

  • Healthcare and Operating Context: Understands how clinical teams operate in a regulated healthcare enterprise.

  • Responsible Use: Treats privacy, fairness, oversight, and accountability as part of the strategy, not a later review.

  • Trusted Advisor: Earns trust through clarity and integrity. The recommendation holds when the answer is no.

What Success Looks Like

  • Business leaders treat AI Strategy as a go-to thought leader partner on what is worth doing, not as a ticket-taker or a project coordinator.

  • A prioritized set of AI opportunities is well documented with clear articulation of a compelling problem, audience, value, approach, risk, owner, and a proceed, sequence, or stop recommendation.

  • Funded work in partner areas has passed shared framing and validation criteria before teams are assigned or funds are allocated.

  • Duplicative or redundant or low-value ideas are stopped or merged, and that outcome is counted as success.

  • Handoffs to AI Business Partners, Product Builders, and Technology are clean: the bet is clear, the owner is named, and the success measures are agreed.

  • Responsible-use questions are raised before investment, not after a pilot is already underway.

  • Return on invested capital compounds as high value problems are attacked with rigor, measured, and investment decisions are made with discipline.

raw.description:
Als Content Writer:in im Education-Team bei simpleclub erstellst du Inhalte wie Zusammenfassungen, interaktive Erklärungen und Aufgaben für den Beruf “Pflegefachperson”. Diese Lernbausteine baust du gemeinsam mit unseren Designer:innen mit Bildern, Animationen, Formeln und Grafiken zusammen. Deine Begeisterung für und Erfahrung im Umgang mit Künstlicher Intelligenz ist dabei entscheidend, um unsere Inhalte noch effizienter und innovativer zu gestalten. Gemeinsam mit dir bringen wir E-Learning voran und verändern die Zukunft der Bildung!

Aufgaben

  • Du arbeitest mit dem Education-Team von simpleclub zusammen und erstellst Inhalte für den Ausbildungsberuf Pflegefachperson.
  • Du wirst für die Zusammenstellung von Inhalten mit Hilfe unserer Tools verantwortlich sein, indem du Lernbausteine erstellst und diese in Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Designer:innen mit Bildern, Animationen, Formeln und Grafiken zusammenbaust.
  • Du wirst Content für den Beruf Pflegefachperson planen.
  • Du wirst eng mit unserem Sales Team zusammenarbeiten und unseren Content Pflegeschulen und Kliniken vorstellen.

Qualifikation

  • Leidenschaft für Bildung: Du begeisterst dich für die Inhalte des Ausbildungsberufes und kannst diese somit verständlich vermitteln. Möglicherweise hast du die Ausbildung in diesem Bereich abgeschlossen oder hast Erfahrung und möchtest daher zu Innovationen im Bildungsbereich beitragen.
  • Begeisterung und Erfahrung mit Künstlicher Intelligenz
  • Kommunikations-Profi: Du hast die Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen in einfachere Konzepte herunterzubrechen, die leicht zu lesen und zu verstehen sind.
  • Teamplayer: Du arbeitest hart, aber du genießt es, mit dem Team gemeinsam zu feiern und Spaß zu haben. Bei uns geht es um die Balance.
  • Ausgezeichnetes Zeitmanagement: Du bist in der Lage, deine Arbeit und deinen Zeitplan zu organisieren, um wichtige Deadlines einzuhalten. Du bringst Zeit für einen wöchentlichen Arbeitsaufwand von ca. 15 bis 20 Stunden mit.
  • Flexibilität und Agilität: Wir sind dabei, ein vollständig agiles Unternehmen zu werden. Das bedeutet, dass du deine Zeit dort einteilen kannst, wo sie am meisten gebraucht wird, abhängig von der Priorität der Projekte. Kein Tag wird wie der andere sein.
  • Fließend Deutsch, sehr gute Englischkenntnisse (Firmenkommunikation auf Englisch)
  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Pflegefachperson

Bonuspunkte, wenn:

  • Erfahrungen als Praxisanleiter:in oder Lehrer:in in einer Pflegeschule
  • Studium in den Bereichen Medizin oder Lehramt
  • Praktische Erfahrungen z.B. durch mehrere Stationen in Krankenhäusern

Benefits

  • Arbeiten von überall
  • Team-Events
  • Eine großartige Kultur
  • Weiterbildung
  • Teilnahme an einer sinnvollen Mission
  • Offene Kommunikation

💰Deine Vergütung: Wir 💙 Transparenz. Wir haben verschiedene Vergütungsstufen, anhand derer wir ein gerechtes Gehalt für jeden Bereich festlegen. Deine Vergütung wird mindestens einmal im Jahr überprüft. Das Gehalt für unsere Werkstudierendenstellen liegt dabei bei 15€ pro Stunde. Bei umfangreicher Erfahrung in relevanten Bereichen kann das Startgehalt in Einzelfällen auch auf bis zu 17€ pro Stunde angepasst werden.

Wir haben in allen Stellenbeschreibungen Gehaltsangaben eingeführt, um sicherzustellen, dass wir alle Mitarbeiter:innen fair behandeln. Sobald wir uns besser kennengelernt haben und deine Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen während des Vorstellungsgesprächs verstanden haben, können wir einschätzen, welches Gehalt für dich passend ist.

🌍 Bei simpleclub sind alle willkommen. Ja, wirklich alle.
Wir bei simpleclub setzen uns für den Aufbau einer Arbeitsumgebung ein, die Gleichheit, Integration und Vielfalt fördert. Auf unserem Expansionskurs sind wir überzeugt, dass die Einzigartigkeit jeder:s Einzelnen gefeiert und anerkannt werden sollte. Dies ist entscheidend für unseren Erfolg und unsere Innovationen. Wir möchten ein Produkt schaffen, das von allen geliebt wird, und wir möchten, dass sich das auch in unseren Teams zeigt.

Uns ist es wichtig, dass unsere Mitarbeiter:innen sich selbst in die Arbeit einbringen, unabhängig von Alter, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Religion, Staatsbürgerschaft, sexueller Orientierung, Behinderungsstatus, Neurodiversität, Hautfarbe, Glauben, Geschlecht oder anderem.

In diesem Sinne arbeiten wir kontinuierlich daran, dass simpleclub ein vielfältiges und integratives Umfeld für alle bleibt.

About simpleclub

simpleclub was originally founded by Nicolai Schork and Alexander Giesecke as a B2C learning platform for students and soon became the most popular brand in the industry with 2m+ monthly users and 4m+ social media followers.

In 2021, simpleclub was ranked the #1 employer in the industry by Statista and Business Punk magazine.

In 2023 simpleclub expanded into B2B SaaS, led by Alexander Powell as a co-founder, which soon became the main focus of the company.

Today, simpleclub is an AI-powered B2B learning platform for up- & reskilling with a team of around 100 employees trusted by companies like Audi, Bosch, Amazon and Vodafone alongside 500+ other companies.

The platform combines an interactive learning experience for users with learning management for trainers, powered by AI.

Are you a seasoned Software Engineer seeking your next opportunity to make a significant impact? Do you bring curiosity and drive, coupled with a wealth of experience, to excel in a fast-paced and dynamic environment? Do you thrive in collaborative settings, valuing engineering as a team-driven pursuit? Are you motivated by achieving success as part of a high-performing team? If so, continue reading…
Our system is composed of a retreating monolith surrounded by a growing collection of microservices. Within this system, you and your engineering team will be responsible for building and maintaining client-facing components. The current technology stack consists of ReactJS, Java, PostgreSQL, Docker and AWS. If you’re hungry to learn, humble, and interested in winning as a team, we think you’ll do well here. What’s most important is that you love your work, respect the team and don’t lose your sense of humour along the way.

Key Responsibilities:

    Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, mentor, and support a team of engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, ownership, and collaboration.
  • Conduct 1:1s, provide coaching and feedback, and support engineers in their professional development.
  • Participate in hiring, onboarding, and team growth strategies- including performance management tasks; annual reviews, merit, feedback conversations.

    • Hands-On Development

  • Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code—setting the standard for technical excellence within the team.
  • Actively contribute to key development projects and unblock engineering challenges as needed.
  • Guide architecture, code reviews, and technical decision-making to ensure high-quality delivery.

    • Project & Stakeholder Management

  • Collaborate with Product, Design, and other stakeholders to define and deliver solutions that meet user and business needs.
  • Partner with Product to shape epics, plan sprints, and prioritize the backlog.
  • Own team-level sprint planning, delivery timelines, and status reporting.
  • Hold the team accountable to sprint commitments, ensuring timely delivery of epics and completion of tickets.
  • Identify and manage technical dependencies and risks.

    • Process & Technical Excellence

  • Champion engineering best practices in coding, testing, CI/CD, and monitoring.
  • Drive continuous improvement in tools, workflows, and team processes.
  • Help define and implement the long-term technical strategy for your team.
  • Are proficient in Java while comfortable with adopting new technologies

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with 1–2+ years in a leadership or team lead capacity.
  • You have experience with AWS Lambda, ECS, SQS, Kinesis as well as Sendgrid, Postfix and Terraform.
  • Experience designing and delivering scalable, production-ready systems and applications.
  • Comfortable contributing to both frontend and/or backend codebases, depending on the team’s needs.
  • Solid understanding of modern development practices, architecture patterns, and engineering tools.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, especially across cross-functional teams.
  • Have experience delivering reliable, high-performance REST APIs.
  • Have a strong interest in database & query performance tuning.
  • Have experience and good understanding of scrum/agile development methodologies.
  • Are experienced with code reviews, service ownership, fully automated testing, microservices, and rapid/continuous releases.

    • Preferred Skills:

  • You have technical experience with E-mail processing and tracking in large systems.
  • Experience with serverless, queuing, streaming.
  • Are comfortable with being on-call for support and interacting directly with clients if needed.
  • You have worked directly in the finance industry and/or at a SaaS startup.

BlueMatrix develops one-of-a-kind web applications for the authoring, distribution, and analysis of investment research, and for internal knowledge management and digital communications. Our mission is to streamline the publishing process on a global scale.

About Zabota

Zabota is a top-ranked global recruitment firm, recognized as a Top HR Staffing Company by Clutch in 2025. We specialize in helping high-growth U.S. brands build elite, remote-first teams. Our mission is clear: Connect world-class talent from LATAM, Europe, and beyond with the most ambitious companies in the world.

About Our Client

Our client is a fast-growing retention marketing agency focused on helping eCommerce brands increase customer lifetime value, retention, and profitability through strategic email and SMS marketing.

Unlike traditional agencies that focus only on vanity metrics, they operate with a profit-first mindset — helping brands improve contribution margin, inventory sell-through, cash conversion cycles, and long-term customer retention. Their team works closely with high-growth brands generating between $50k–$1M/month and builds systems designed to create measurable business impact.

They are now looking for a Junior Account Manager to join their growing remote team.

About the Role

As a Junior Account Manager, you'll be responsible for supporting retention marketing strategy and execution across a portfolio of eCommerce accounts. Your core focus will be helping clients grow revenue, improve retention, and execute high-performing email and SMS campaigns.

You'll work closely with copywriters, designers, and email technicians to ensure campaigns and flows are launched accurately and on time while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.

Initially, this role will be primarily internal-facing, allowing you to fully onboard into the company's systems, processes, and strategy frameworks. As you gain confidence and demonstrate strong performance, you'll gradually transition into a more client-facing role with opportunities to join strategy calls and directly manage client communication.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who understands retention marketing fundamentals and wants to develop into a high-level strategist within a fast-paced agency environment.

Responsibilities

  • Write detailed briefs for email and SMS campaigns that clearly communicate strategic direction to copywriters
  • Build campaign calendars aligned with launches, promotions, seasonal opportunities, and retention goals
  • Develop and improve lifecycle marketing flow strategies, including welcome flows, post-purchase flows, win-back campaigns, and retention automations
  • Manage internal pod operations, coordinating with copywriters, designers, and email technicians to ensure deliverables are completed on time
  • QA campaigns, automations, links, discount codes, segmentation, and creative assets before launch
  • Analyze campaign and retention performance using tools such as Triple Whale, Lifetimely, StoreHero, and Hiro
  • Participate in weekly account reviews and monthly reporting processes
  • Support onboarding of new clients by helping gather insights, organize assets, and prepare retention strategies
  • Create and improve SOPs and internal documentation to streamline workflows
  • Eventually transition into client-facing responsibilities, including participating in calls, presenting strategy, and handling communication once fully onboarded and trained

Qualifications

  • Minimum 2+ years of experience in email and SMS marketing, retention marketing, or account management
  • Strong understanding of lifecycle marketing and customer retention strategies
  • Experience building campaign calendars and analyzing marketing performance
  • Ability to write clear, actionable creative briefs
  • Familiarity with retention metrics such as LTV, retention rate, cohort analysis, and repurchase behavior
  • Intermediate to advanced experience using ClickUp or similar project management tools
  • Basic to intermediate knowledge of Figma for reviewing and providing feedback on designs
  • Working knowledge of Klaviyo, including segmentation, flows, and QA processes
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to stay calm under pressure and manage multiple deadlines simultaneously
  • Self-starter mindset with strong ownership and accountability
  • Eagerness to continuously learn and grow within retention marketing and eCommerce strategy

Offer Details

  • Full-time remote position
  • Working hours: Must maintain at least 6 hours overlap inside 6 AM to 6 PM Pacific Time Zone
  • Salary: $3,000–$3,500 USD per month
  • Long-term opportunity with growth into a client-facing Account Manager role
  • Collaborative, high-performance remote team environment

Hiring Steps

  1. Initial Zabota Screening
  2. Client Interview
  3. Practical Task or Second Stage Interview
  4. Offer

Senior Clinical Research Associate

Valencia, California – REMOTE FOR THE RIGHT CANDIDATE

Join Advanced Bionics as a Senior Clinical Research Associate and take a lead role in the operational execution of global medical device clinical studies from study start-up through close-out. You will manage complex investigative sites, drive study quality and performance, identify and mitigate operational risks, and serve as an experienced clinical operations resource to study teams while helping advance innovative hearing healthcare technologies.

Responsibilities

  • Independently lead the operational execution of assigned global clinical studies from site start-up through close-out in accordance with study protocols, ICH-GCP, ISO 14155, FDA regulations, and applicable international regulatory requirements.

  • Conduct site qualification, initiation, interim monitoring, and close-out visits (SQV, SIV, IMV, and COV) for complex or high-priority studies.

  • Lead site activation, investigator training, study device accountability, close-out planning, and other activities required to achieve study milestones.

  • Serve as the primary operational lead for assigned investigative sites, monitoring enrollment, site performance, protocol compliance, and data quality while proactively identifying and mitigating risks.

  • Independently resolve complex monitoring findings, protocol deviations, data queries, and site-performance issues while escalating significant risks with recommended solutions.

  • Maintain inspection-ready TMF/eTMF and investigator site documentation, support audits and regulatory inspections, and promote consistent application of clinical quality standards.

  • Partner with Clinical Trial Management, Data Management, Biostatistics, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Medical Affairs, and external vendors while mentoring CRAs and supporting clinical operations process improvements.

More about you

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Nursing, Biomedical Engineering, or another related scientific discipline.

  • Minimum 5 years of clinical research experience, including at least 2 years of independent site monitoring.

  • Experience managing multiple clinical sites and working with CTMS, EDC, and eTMF systems.

  • Strong knowledge of ICH-GCP, ISO 14155, FDA regulations, clinical monitoring, site management, and data quality.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex studies, multiple priorities, operational risks, and site-performance challenges.

  • Strong organizational, communication, problem-solving, and time-management skills.

  • Ability to travel approximately 30–50% to study sites, conferences, and other study-related activities.

Preferred qualifications include: a Master's degree or equivalent; ACRP-CRA, ACRP-CP, or SOCRA CCRP certification; experience in Class III medical device clinical trials, global multicenter studies, FDA IDE/PMA or EU MDR clinical studies; experience mentoring junior CRAs or leading monitoring activities; and knowledge of Risk-Based Monitoring/RbQM.

Exclusive Networks is the global cybersecurity go-to-market specialist that provides partners and end-customers with a wide range of services and product portfolios. With offices in over 45 countries and the ability to serve customers in over 170 countries, we combine deep local expertise with the scale and delivery of a single global organization.

Our best-in-class vendor portfolio is carefully curated with all leading industry players. Our services range from managed security to specialist technical accreditation and training and capitalize on rapidly evolving technologies and changing business models. For more information visit .

At Exclusive Networks, we are passionate about making a difference. That means delivering the best to our ecosystem, shaping a prosperous and trusted digital world, and helping our people to realize their full potential.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES | About the role

The Channel Sales Manager will be in charged of driving end to end process for achieving sales targets with Channel Partners. The growth from this channel segment will be delivered through three main types of activities:

1) business enablement to help partners grow and expand by cross and up selling

2) plan, design and execute quarterly programs and promote adoption and success

3) marketing and demand generation to increase sales opportunities and strengthen the Partner relationship.

The role will be measured based on successful execution of activities and initiatives resulting in increased bookings, gross margin and transactions from Channel.

This role will report to Head Of Channel Sales or HOD equivalent.

As the Channel Sales Manager, you will:

  • The Channel Account Manager is primarily responsible for assigned focused partners strategy, planning, development, implementation, operationalization and execution of GTM actions Partners.
  • Define, develop and managing the overall market GTM strategy based on assigned focused partners – including enablement, programs and offers, marketing and demand generation with support from the various functional stakeholders for eg. Marketing, Services, Operations etc.
  • Plan quarterly enablement networking event and ensure required number of attendance (new and repeated) to win mindshare and loyalty from partners.
  • Plan, execute quarter programs and offers, set targets and establish metrics, communicating and ensuring successful program awareness and adoption through qualified leads, number so transactions, closing the sales and quarterly or half yearly business update/review with key partners.
  • Ensure that the end-to-end operations process is smooth for partners and aligned with internal guidelines.
  • Working proactively to ensure programs are operationally ready, presented to all key stakeholders for buy in and ready to be executed early within the quarter to achieve quarterly results.
  • Drive healthy pipelines to include new and renewal business.
  • Track and report performance of channels results, bookings, program initiatives and provide enhancement recommendations to adjust course on programs / initiatives as required.
  • Actively engage vendor(s) together with product and marketing team to design relevant and effective programs, initiatives, training and/or enablement requirements for partners.
  • Be the focus point for potential partners. Carry out quarterly planning sessions – deciding on focused accounts, meetings and vendor introductions as well as any planning around possible marketing activities and campaigns.

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE | About you

The ideal Channel Sales Manager

  • Minimum 3 years experience and demonstrated success in the IT Industry
  • Strong preference in a sales and/or Business Development role

For more than 170 years, The Hanover has been committed to delivering on our promises and being there when it matters the most. We live our values every day, demonstrating we CARE through our values, Sustainability initiatives and inclusive corporate culture.

Our Commercial lines team is seeking a Vice President and Lead Actuary to join our growing team in Worcester, MA, Windsor, CT, or remote work location.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The VP and Lead Actuary will lead all aspects of the actuarial practice for The Hanover’s Core Commercial Lines portfolio. Help shape the business strategy of the Core Commercial businesses of the company and solve problems and initiate solutions in the face of ambiguity. Responsible for actuarial, data science, and integration teams driving enhanced pricing sophistication, portfolio management, rate development and execution, third party data integration, competitive intelligence and other activities in support of sustained profitable growth. Share ownership and accountability for the profitability of all Core Commercial lines of business and aggregate business unit performance. Responsible for providing counsel to senior management and business leaders on the appropriate course of action for Core Commercial as a member of the business leadership teams. Represents the organization to both internal and external audiences.

WHAT YOU WILL DO IN THIS ROLE:

▪ Participate in strategy development for Core Commercial businesses. ▪ Accountable for the effective implementation of business strategies. ▪ Proactive monitoring of trends in results and profitability by line of business and/or product at a granular level across the portfolio (at a minimum state/industry/business unit). ▪ Provide guidance and drives execution of filing adequate manual rates in all lines and jurisdictions, and policy/account level guidance on collected price. ▪ Drive continuous improvement and execution of actuarial and data science processes, models, and methods. ▪ Responsible for driving efficiency and effectiveness of operations, anticipating and managing unanticipated situations as appropriate. ▪ Present findings and recommendations to customers with the ability to influence and drive to decisions and partner effectively to facilitate implementation and execution. ▪ Partner with internal and external clients to establish and achieve corporate and business function priorities and goals. ▪ Collaborate with Actuarial and Analytics Leadership team members to cultivate a community that fosters actuarial development and state of the art data science expertise. ▪ Actively collaborate with technology, data science, and data partners on governance and compliance matters. ▪ Leverage AI capabilities and automation to optimize productivity and achieve optimal outcomes across the business function. ▪ Responsible for performance and compensation management for team. ▪ Accountable for financial budget and metrics for applicable function.

WHAT YOU NEED TO APPLY:

  • Experience in navigating state regulatory environments.

◦ Identifies and acts upon opportunities, motivates others during times of organizational stress, ambiguity, and change ◦ Creates an environment that encourages calculated risk-taking, sharing of best practices, and alerting groups to alternative approaches. Provides context for organizational change. ◦ Influences business leaders and models data-driven decision making.

  • Communication for Results

◦ Expresses technical and business concepts, ideas, feelings, opinions, and conclusions, so that others understand and are persuaded to act. ◦ Creates an environment that encourages and values the opinions of others and promotes sharing of information and ideas. ◦ Promotes an inclusive environment and encourages people to speak up.

  • Negotiation

◦ Knowledge of negotiating techniques, subject matter, and strategy to obtain commitment, compromise, or settlement in a way that promotes mutual goals or interests. ◦ Plan ahead to support achievement of long-term strategic goals despite short-term obstacles and organizational constraints.

  • Results Orientation

◦ Excited by challenging goals and a desire to exceed standards of excellence. ◦ Exceeding the standard can include challenging personal goals, organization's standards, or current industry standards. ◦ Exhibits a true sense of competitiveness and a drive for results. ◦ Has a strong desire to win in the most challenging of circumstances and the fortitude to take calculated risks to achieve personal objectives and goals, organization's standards, or current industry standards. ◦ Sets clear expectations and effectively monitors results to identify both successes and gaps in performance outcomes.

Encourages and rewards learning, growth, etc., in others. ◦ Supports continual development of all staff through assignments, coaching, and training.

raw.description:
Production Music Library Consultant, UK & International

Peermusic Accorder Library Ltd, a peermusic company

Part time consultancy | 1 to 2 days per week | Remote, UK based

About peermusic Accorder Library

peermusic Accorder Library (PAL) is part of the global peermusic group and represents a dedicated production music catalogue for use across television, film, advertising, digital content and other media.

The peermusic Accorder Library is a modern, technology led production music platform designed to make it simple for music users to discover, search, save, share and download music, with tools that support professional production workflows.

Explore the peermusic Accorder Library

Job Role

We are looking for an experienced Production Music Library Consultant to help us develop the reach and usage of the PAL catalogue, initially across the UK and with the potential to support international growth.

This is a flexible consultancy role for someone who understands the production music world from the inside and who combines strong industry relationships, commercial instinct, excellent music knowledge and confidence with music metadata and digital library technology.

You will help shape the growth of a modern production music library, using your existing industry expertise and network to identify and develop relationships with production companies, television producers, editors, post-production teams, music supervisors, agencies, broadcasters and other professional music users.

You will also analyse how people are searching for and using production music, feeding that knowledge back into the development, presentation and discoverability of the PAL catalogue.

Finally, you will already have good experience managing library platforms, creating releases, and handling large amounts of metadata.

Key responsibilities

The role is particularly interesting because it combines:

  • Business development / relationships
  • Music curation / creative expertise
  • Metadata / technology / catalogue management

Business development / Relationships

  • Use existing industry network to identify potential new users of the PAL catalogue across UK television, film, advertising, digital, branded content, post production and other relevant media sectors.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with existing production companies, producers, editors, and other clients.
  • Develop a structured approach to outreach and relationship building.
  • Identify opportunities for PAL within areas of the media industry where production music is increasingly being used, including for existing clients.
  • Attend relevant industry meetings, networking opportunities and events where appropriate

Music Curation / Creative Expertise

  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of production music and how music is selected and used within television, film, advertising and digital content.
  • Familiarise yourself with the music already in the library and respond to various requests and briefs, by identifying appropriate tracks and creating playlists.
  • Help users get the best from the PAL catalogue, by demonstrating AI and keyword search, playlist creation, saving and sharing functions.
  • Understand the difference between simply supplying music and providing a genuinely useful creative music service.
  • Monitor changes in the production music and sync landscape and identify emerging opportunities for the catalogue.
  • Keep a record of and provide regular feedback on gaps in the catalogue, changing user requirements, genres, moods, themes, formats and areas of demand.

Metadata / technology / catalogue management

  • Apply a strong eye for detail, a creative flair and a practical understanding of production music metadata and tagging.
  • Work confidently with SharePoint, audio files, spreadsheets, library applications and digital music platforms.
  • Understand the importance of accurate, consistent and useful metadata to both the client and to peermusic.
  • Assess whether tracks are being described and tagged in ways that reflect how real world users search for music, and make improvements based on the results.
  • Understand music data, cue sheets, rights information and the relationship between catalogue metadata and music usage.
  • Experience with platforms such as DISCO, AIMS, Harvest or similar music library and catalogue management systems would be highly advantageous

International development

Although the initial focus will be the UK, PAL sits within the international peermusic organisation and the role has the potential to contribute to developing the catalogue's international user base.

You will help identify International production companies and media organisations, editors, music supervisors as well as other potential partners, such as library sub publishers or other routes to market.

Experience of working across international territories would therefore be highly valuable.

Prior Experience

We are looking for someone who already has hands-on experience in the production music industry and a strong understanding of how professional music users work.

You will ideally have an established network within the UK media and production industry, with contacts that you feel could benefit from use of the library.

Working arrangement

This is a part time consultancy role of approximately 1 to 2 days per week, with flexibility around how those days are structured.

The role will be predominantly home based within the UK, with occasional meetings, industry events and client visits where appropriate.

The consultancy is intended to be flexible and could suit someone who already works independently within the music, television or media industries and is looking for an additional consultancy opportunity.

The successful candidate will work closely with the peermusic Accorder team to develop a clear programme of UK and international user growth.

How to apply

Please send (in one document) a CV together with a short covering note outlining your experience in production music, your current industry network and why you think you could help develop the PAL catalogue.

We are seeking a Digital Engineering Manager to serve as a key leader within Istari’s Customer Success Digital Engineering organization. This role operates under the Director of Digital Engineering and takes ownership of a portion of day-to-day execution while helping shape strategy, technical direction, and team growth.

You will manage and mentor Forward Deployed Engineers building software with the Istari Platform while remaining deeply engaged in architecture, technical decision-making, and customer-facing problem solving.

Core Responsibilities:

    Technical & Program Leadership

  • Own technical execution for a subset of Digital Engineering initiatives and programs

  • Contribute thought leadership around the Istari platform, its applications, and required capabilities

  • Help define product scope and technical approach for new digital engineering capabilities

  • Review designs, architectures, and implementations to ensure quality, scalability, and alignment with Istari’s platform vision

  • Serve as a technical escalation point for complex engineering and integration challenges

    • Team Leadership & Management

  • Manage and mentor a team of Forward Deployed Engineers

  • Drive execution across multiple concurrent efforts, including planning, prioritization, and delivery

  • Provide technical coaching, design and code feedback, and career development guidance

  • Help scale lean, effective team processes as the organization grows

    • Cross-Functional & Customer Engagement

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to translate customer needs into clear, executable technical plans

  • Support customer engagements requiring deep digital engineering expertise

  • Communicate technical tradeoffs effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

    • Strategic Support & Direction

  • Take on delegated responsibilities from the Director of Digital Engineering

  • Help define standards, best practices, and reusable technical patterns

  • Identify gaps in tooling, process, and team capabilities and propose improvements

  • Serve as a thought partner on the future of digital engineering at Istari—enabling engineers to “conduct the orchestra” of tools, not just play a single instrument

Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of experience in engineering (aerospace, systems, mechanical, electrical, or similar)

  • 3+ years of experience leading or managing technical teams

  • Understanding of software fundamentals (APIs, data pipelines, services, integrations)

  • Experience working with engineering tools and ecosystems such as:

  • MBSE (e.g., Cameo, SysML)

  • CAD/PLM (e.g., CATIA, Teamcenter, similar)

  • Document and requirements systems

  • Simulations (FEA, CFD, etc)

  • Proven ability to balance hands-on technical work with people leadership

  • Excellent communication skills—able to explain complex technical concepts clearly

    • Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in aerospace, defense, or other complex engineered systems

  • Exposure to model extraction, automation, and digital thread concepts

  • Experience working in product or platform-based environments

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and shaping roles, processes, and scope as the organization evolves

Why This Role?

    This role is critical to scaling Istari’s Digital Engineering capability. You won’t just run a team—you’ll help define how digital engineering is practiced at Istari, enabling engineers to move faster, integrate better, and solve harder problems.

    You’ll have real ownership, real influence, and a direct partnership with the Director of Digital Engineering to shape the future of the organization.

Why Istari?

    We've built a team of what we call Wizards -- people who bring depth in their domain and range across others, who are collaborative without being deferential, and who genuinely care about what we're building. We celebrate individual contributions, give feedback early and often, and argue about ideas so we can execute together.

    There's no room here for hierarchy for its own sake, or for busywork that doesn't move the mission. We are outcomes-driven, and we hold each other to a high standard — with genuine respect for each person's expertise and wellbeing.

    Focus is rewarded. Finish is remembered.

    Facts are friendly. Even when they are not fun.

    Fellowship is fundamental. Make others successful.

The Senior Splunk Engineer supports the federal client by engineering, developing, deploying and maintaining the organization’s SIEM implementation and its minor applications, integration, apps and interfaces. This position possesses mastery of the Splunk tool, with technical expertise including hands-on solution development and implementation experience, and analytical skills for evaluating and optimizing capabilities of securing application solutions. The qualified candidate will be critical team member with proven leadership, communication, organizational and interpersonal skills. This position provides technical consulting support as well as advance technical design and specifications and planning process assistance, and must have the ability to multitask and solve complex technical problems.

Chickasaw Nation Industries, Inc. serves as a holding company with multiple subsidiaries engaged in several lines of business (Business Services, Health, Infrastructure and Engineering, Mission Optimization, Technology and Transportation) for the federal government and commercial enterprises. A portion of our profits is used to support Chickasaw citizens. We are proud to support the economic development and long-term viability of the Chickasaw Nation and its people. CNI offers premium benefits eligible on the first day of hire to full time employees; (Medical - Dental – Vision), Company Life Insurance, Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance, 401(K) Immediate Vesting, Professional Development Assistance, Legal Aid Assistance Program, Family Planning / Fertility Assistance, Personal Time Off, and Observance of Federal Holidays.

As a federal contractor, CNI is a drug-free workplace and adheres to the Federal Controlled Substance Act.

ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS

The ability to obtain, maintain and access classified information at the Public Trust level.

REQUIRED Certifications: Certified Splunk Architect

Preferred Certifications: Additional Splunk certifications, CEH, CySA+, GSEC, CISM, CCNA, Security+, Server+, Linux+, Cloud+ (or equivalent higher-level certifications)

Senior level mastery of SIEM front and back-end operations and configurations in addition to the interoperability with other security tools.

Extensive knowledge of Splunk Enterprise Security and CIM compliance.

Extensive knowledge of Splunk Risk Based Alerting (RBA).

Cross functional and well-rounded. Firm understanding of data flows and interconnections between multiple system with the network environment.

Exercises multi-tasking skills and critical thinking by managing events in multiple systems, applications, and other priorities.

Extensive knowledge of system back-end engineer and administration with heavy focus on Linux.

Analytical skills for evaluating and optimizing capabilities of securing application solutions.

Systematic approach to remediate system issues/problems and making recommendations to improve the efficiency of system operations and data availability utilizing current and future technologies.

Must demonstrate capability to operate autonomously in a diverse environment with minimal supervision and provide accurate and precise documentation.

Must demonstrate excellent troubleshooting skills, and be self-motivated, results-driven, and well organized.

Must have excellent communication skills (written and verbal) with experience communicating effectively with all levels of staff and management.

Extensive experience with SIEM (Security Information and Event Management) systems, and security event correlation is required; PERL/Linux shell scripting/Regex experience is highly preferable.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Essential duties and responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

Responsible for the integration of CNI Core Competencies into daily functions, including: commitment to integrity, knowledge/quality of work, supporting financial goals of the company, initiative/motivation, cooperation/relationships, problem analysis/discretion, accomplishing goals through organization, positive oral/written communication skills, leadership abilities, commitment to Affirmative Action, reliability/dependability, flexibility and ownership/accountability of actions taken.

Implements, optimizes and maintains the SIEM infrastructure (Splunk), and deploys products, apps, reports, alerts and dashboards utilizing system development life cycle (SDLC) methodologies and business best practices.

Increases the efficiency of the infrastructure to connect more enterprise data sources to Splunk Enterprise.

Develops change management plans to be adaptable to the changing needs of the program. Leads prototyping and testing of new features and solutions.

Manages and monitors Linux based on-prem server infrastructure for configuration and software upgrades.

Develops, maintains and optimizes installation of internal and external SIEM components.

Oversees the optimization, operation and health of Splunk components and connections to data sources. (Query scheduling, Performance tuning, Apps, Dashboards, Saved Searches, Scheduled Searches, Alerts, etc.).

Provides mentoring to Tier II technicians for problem resolution and lead technical discussions with technical engineers of SIEM and SIEM data connections.

Shares and provides knowledge to junior security architects and engineers and recommends training as needed.

Brings industry best practices and innovative ideas leading to continuous improvement of the Splunk environment.

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Management of Information Systems, Cybersecurity or a related Math or Science discipline, and a minimum of six (6) years in IT infrastructure, networking, architecture, administration or security. Six (6) years of Splunk expertise, with at least three (3) years of experience in large scale enterprise-level solutions. Requires experience with Splunk premium apps, such as Enterprise Security, and with architecting, developing, deploying and configuring customized technical add-ons.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this job. Work is primarily performed in an office/warehouse setting. Regularly required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel.  Regularly required to reach with hands and arms, occasionally above head. Regularly required to twist at the waist, climb and descend stairs while carrying objects. Ability to speak and hear. Frequently required to stand, walk, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. Occasionally required to sit and climb or balance. Regularly lifts and/or moves up to twenty-five pounds and occasionally lifts and/or moves up to fifty pounds. Works near moving mechanical parts. Regularly exposed to general office and general office machinery noise. May be exposed to warehouse, truck or forklift noise.

EOE including Disability/Vet

The estimated pay range for this role is $125,000 to $150,000, with the final offer contingent on location, skillset, and experience.

raw.description:
Location: Remote (Candidates from Latin America / South America - Fixed Location Required)

Position Type: Part-time to Full-time (Starting at 30 hours/week)

I. Role Overview

We are seeking a highly dedicated and detail-oriented Virtual Medical Scribe and Assistant to support a fast-paced Gastroenterology practice in the United States. This role is critical in ensuring clinical excellence by providing real-time scribing, comprehensive pre-charting, and essential administrative support.

The ideal candidate will be a licensed nurse with a strong clinical background and a stable, high-performance home office setup.

II. About the Clinic and Physician

  • Specialization: Gastroenterology.

  • Physician Profile: Our specialist is highly demanding and operates on a word-of-mouth referral basis. His time is split equally between the surgery center and clinical patient care.

  • Culture: Fast-moving and professional. The practice relies solely on its reputation for excellence.

III. Key Responsibilities & Tasks

  • Pre-Charting: Reviewing patient schedules in advance to prepare charts; pulling lab results, imaging reports, and prior consultation notes into the EMR so the physician is prepared before each visit.

  • Real-Time Medical Scribing: Accompanying the doctor virtually during patient visits to record clinical notes and documentation accurately.

  • Patient Coordination: Handling incoming calls and scheduling appointments during non-scribing hours.

  • Clinical Communication: Relaying information between the physician and patients.

  • Workflow Integration: Assisting the doctor between back-to-back appointments to maintain a smooth clinic flow.

IV. Mandatory Requirements

Clinical & Educational Background

  • Nursing Background: A Bachelor's degree in Nursing (RN/BSN) is required to ensure a deep understanding of medical terminology, pharmacology, and drug interactions.

  • Experience: At least one year of experience as a Medical Virtual Assistant or Scribe.

  • Educational Recency: Candidates should ideally be within five years of graduation or active practice to ensure up-to-date knowledge.

  • Language Proficiency: Must be Bilingual (English and Spanish).

Technical & Security Specifications

  • Fixed Working Location: The candidate must work from one specific, consistent location only. Epic EMR access is tied to a verified IP address; changing locations or IP addresses causes significant security disruptions and requires hours of technical modification to restore access.

  • Hardware: Minimum 8 GB RAM.

  • Monitor: Minimum 21–22 inch monitor. Epic does not function well on smaller screens without 32 GB RAM.

  • Multitasking: Ability to run Epic and Zoom simultaneously on the same computer (no phone/tablet workarounds).

Compliance

  • Documentation: Must provide a valid Passport, Criminal Background Check and Professional License.

V. Nice to Haves

  • Software Proficiency: Prior experience with Epic EMR is a significant advantage.

  • Specialty Exposure: Previous experience in Gastroenterology or surgical practices.

VI. Schedule and Training

  • Training Period: Two-week intensive phase (Epic EMR and practice-specific workflows).

  • Working Hours: Starts at 30 hours per week, with the potential to move to 40 hours based on performance.

raw.title: Coach Freelance en Transition de Carrière – France
raw.excerpt: L’ENTREPRISE Careerminds est un leader des solutions de transition de carrière, de développement des talents et de coaching.
raw.description:
L’ENTREPRISE

Careerminds est un leader des solutions de transition de carrière, de développement des talents et de coaching. Nous aidons les organisations à accompagner leurs collaborateurs dans le changement tout en favorisant le développement et la mobilité des talents. Notre portefeuille de solutions comprend des services de référence en matière de Transition de Carrière et de Coaching, ainsi que Progression, notre application dédiée aux référentiels de carrière et à la planification des parcours professionnels.

LE RÔLE

Le ou la coach de transition de carrière accompagne les participants des programmes d’outplacement Careerminds, individuellement et/ou en groupe, dans leur développement de carrière et leur recherche d’emploi.

Il s’agit d’une mission freelance / en tant qu’indépendant(e), exercée à 100 % à distance. Les candidats doivent être légalement en mesure de fournir leurs services en tant qu’indépendant(e) dans leur pays de résidence.

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITÉS

  • Établir des relations solides et de confiance avec les participants et créer un environnement de coaching à la fois soutenant et motivant.
  • Accompagner les participants tout au long de leur parcours de Transition de Carrière, en les aidant à définir des objectifs clairs, à maintenir leur dynamique et à progresser vers leurs objectifs professionnels.
  • Proposer un accompagnement personnalisé sur l’orientation professionnelle, les enjeux liés à la transition, les choix de carrière et la prise de décision.
  • Guider les participants dans leur positionnement professionnel et leur marque personnelle, la préparation de leur CV, le networking, leur stratégie de recherche d’emploi, les entretiens, l’évaluation des opportunités et la négociation.
  • Renseigner avec précision les éléments relatifs à l’accompagnement dans le Career Management System (CMS) pour chaque participant, conformément à nos engagements de service.
  • Animer ou dispenser, selon les besoins, d’autres programmes liés à la transition professionnelle auprès de participants individuels ou de groupes.

RESPONSABILITÉS COMPLÉMENTAIRES

  • Apporter une expertise sur l’environnement français de l’emploi et des restructurations, notamment en matière de réduction des effectifs, de licenciements collectifs, de dispositifs de départ volontaire et de Plans de Sauvegarde de l’Emploi (PSE).
  • Soutenir l’équipe Internationale dans l’identification et l’intégration des exigences, pratiques et spécificités propres à la France dans la conception et le déploiement des programmes de Transition de Carrière.
  • Collaborer avec les parties prenantes internes afin de soutenir la mise en œuvre et l’alignement continu des exigences spécifiques à la France en matière d’outplacement.
  • La connaissance des pratiques de restructuration et de rupture du contrat de travail dans d’autres pays européens est un plus.

COMPÉTENCES ET EXPÉRIENCE REQUISES

  • Une expérience pratique en ressources humaines et une solide compréhension des processus de restructuration en France, y compris les instances représentatives du personnel (CSE – Comité Social et Économique).
  • Une expertise en développement de carrière, incluant notamment la planification de carrière, le personal branding, la préparation de CV, les entretiens, le networking, les réseaux sociaux et la recherche d’emploi en ligne.
  • Un minimum de 7 à 10 ans d’expérience professionnelle, ainsi qu’une bonne compréhension des structures organisationnelles, des cultures d’entreprise et des processus de prise de décision.
  • Une maîtrise de l’anglais est indispensable, le rôle étant en lien avec de nombreuses parties prenantes internationales.
  • Une expertise dans la réalisation de séances de coaching à distance et une bonne maîtrise des outils technologiques.
  • Une connexion Internet haut débit ainsi qu’un ordinateur personnel doté d’équipements audio et vidéo fiables sont indispensables. Une aisance avec les outils de visioconférence, de messagerie instantanée (tels que Slack) et les outils de prise de rendez-vous est requise.
  • D’excellentes compétences en communication, en relations interpersonnelles et en analyse.
  • Une excellente capacité à travailler avec des personnes aux parcours, niveaux de formation et contextes socio-économiques variés.
  • Une excellente capacité d’écoute, ainsi qu’une forte empathie et une réelle sensibilité aux réactions émotionnelles.

  • Une grande autonomie, une forte motivation et une capacité à travailler de manière indépendante.

ATOUTS SUPPLÉMENTAIRES

  • Un diplôme de niveau Master ou équivalent, des certifications spécialisées et/ou un diplôme de niveau supérieur.

Chez Careerminds, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des perspectives et des parcours culturels contribue à créer des équipes plus performantes et des entreprises plus fortes. Nous recherchons des talents qualifiés, sans distinction notamment de race, de couleur, de sexe ou de genre (y compris la grossesse, l’identité et l’expression de genre), d’origine nationale, de religion, d’orientation sexuelle, de handicap, d’âge, de situation matrimoniale, de statut de citoyenneté, de statut d’ancien combattant ou de toute autre caractéristique protégée par la législation nationale ou locale applicable. Careerminds est fier d’être un employeur garantissant l’égalité des chances.

Rejoignez notre réseau. Ensemble, nous aiderons les personnes que nous accompagnons à construire leur prochain chapitre professionnel et à atteindre leurs objectifs de carrière.

raw.description:
Requisition ID

2026-4633

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Program Manager to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Testosterone Screening and Treatment Expansion Program, a federal healthcare initiative aimed at improving Veterans' access to evidence-based testosterone screening and treatment services across an integrated health system. In this role, you will serve as the Task Order Manager responsible for planning, executing, and overseeing all programmatic activities in direct support of VA clinical and operational goals. You will work at the intersection of federal healthcare delivery and program governance, ensuring that program milestones, deliverables, and quality standards are met on time and within scope. The ideal candidate is a mission-driven, detail-oriented leader with deep experience managing complex healthcare programs within large government or corporate environments, and who thrives in a structured federal contracting context with multiple stakeholders. You are equally comfortable driving strategic planning sessions and managing day-to-day execution details, and you bring a collaborative, proactive working style that keeps cross-functional teams aligned and accountable.

Primary Responsibilities

Serve as the primary Task Order Manager for a large-scale federal health contract, acting as the central point of accountability for all program planning, execution, monitoring, and closeout activities in support of the VA Testosterone Screening and Treatment Expansion Program. Lead the development and maintenance of comprehensive program management artifacts including project plans, integrated master schedules, risk registers, communication plans, and status reports in compliance with VA and federal contracting requirements. Coordinate with VA Contracting Officer's Representatives (COR), clinical subject matter experts, and internal team leads to align program activities with targeted VA health outcomes and ensure timely achievement of task order deliverables. Identify, assess, and proactively mitigate program risks and issues, escalating critical blockers to VA leadership and contractor management with recommended corrective action plans to maintain program momentum. Oversee resource allocation, staffing plans, and subcontractor performance to ensure the right personnel and capabilities are deployed across all phases of the task order lifecycle, from initiation through closeout. Prepare and present program performance briefings, data-driven progress reports, and executive summaries to VA stakeholders and senior leadership, ensuring full transparency into program health, metrics, and strategic alignment with VA's integrated healthcare mission.

Minimum Qualifications

Minimum of 10 years of experience in healthcare program management, with demonstrated expertise in planning, initiating, managing, executing, and closing out programs within an integrated health care system. Master's Degree required in a relevant field such as Healthcare Administration, Public Health, Business Administration, or a related discipline. Minimum of 6 years of experience supporting a large corporation or government agency, with preference for direct experience supporting federal healthcare agencies such as the VA, DoD, HHS, or similar. Ability to obtain and maintain VA network access and comply with all VA security, privacy, and credentialing requirements, including completion of required VA onboarding and background investigation processes. Must be authorized to work in the United States; this position does not offer visa sponsorship. Active Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent recognized project/program management certification (e.g., PgMP, FAC-P/PM, DAWIA PM) required at time of hire.

Desired Qualifications

Prior direct experience supporting VA programs, Veterans Health Administration (VHA) initiatives, or federal health IT/clinical operations contracts; familiarity with VA-specific program governance frameworks such as the VA Acquisition Regulation (VAAR) and VHA Directives; experience managing programs related to men's health, endocrinology, preventive care, or clinical screening and treatment expansion; knowledge of federal performance-based contracting principles, earned value management (EVM), and OMB/federal reporting requirements; and experience working within or alongside VA's Office of Patient Care Services or a comparable federal clinical program office.

The National Restaurant Association and National Restaurant Association Educational Foundation are proud to be part of a highly respected industry, providing hospitality, opportunity, and quality of life. These are the core values that inspire our work, and what we are looking for in an Key Account Manager to expertly represent and drive sales strategies for our industry leading training and certification products.

The learning products offered by the National Restaurant Association, and its family of brands ServSafe, ServSuccess, National Registry of Food Safety Professionals, and American Hotel and Lodging Educational Institute, has led the way in training and certifying millions of current and future hospitality workers. We provide best-in-class food safety, risk mitigation, career development and leadership training to restauranteurs, hoteliers, food service businesses, retail operations and academic institutions across the world. We equip our global audience with innovative, engaging training utilizing multiple platforms, from textbooks to online resources, courses to mobile applications, with a focus on both compliance-driven and career-development suites.

As the Key Account Manager, you will be responsible for a portfolio of high-profile national accounts across restaurant chains with 150+ locations, developing and executing sales strategies, plans, and initiatives in support of our industry risk mitigation product lines. The role collaborates directly with corporate contacts, while supporting and navigating franchise communities to assist with program adoption and growth.

Ideal candidates bring a customer-centric, consultative sales approach with a proven track record of successfully building and sustaining long-term relationships across all levels of client accounts. Must bring experience navigating lengthy and complex sales cycles, strong command of Salesforce and highly effective time management and organizational skills, as well as experience managing multilocation customers and/or large geography.

Prior experience in strategic selling of SAAS, training, certification or e-learning products within the restaurant, retail, training market, or related fields is highly desirable. Position requires the presence, polish, and presentation skills to engage Director, VP, and C-Level executives and influence key business decisions.

This is an individual contributor role that can operate fully remote within the United States (within a company-approved territory) with approximately 25% travel anticipated for key account visits, tradeshows, and other industry events. Compensation includes a competitive base salary plus a variable sales incentive, structured at 80% base and 20% performance-based earnings.

We are proud to offer our team members comprehensive benefits, designed to support their financial, professional, and personal well-being. In addition to outstanding healthcare coverage (medical, dental and vision), competitive salaries, generous vacation and leave time, we offer a matching 401(k) plan, a unique collection of corporate discounts and memberships, as well as programs to support career and skills development, including learning and tuition assistance, and so much more.

We are designing the grid of the future!

EPE is looking to recruit a Senior Engineer with a background in Interconnection or Transmission Planning studies. In this role you will work closely with leadership to provide subject matter expertise both internally through coaching and developing staff as well as externally to our clients.

Responsibilities

How you can make an impact:

  • Perform complex interconnection studies including loadflow, short circuit and transient stability across multiple ISOs and Utilities in the Eastern Interconnect & ERCOT. Ideally focusing on SERC, ERCOT MISO or SPP
  • Develop IBR and large load models required for interconnection applications, validate their performance against ISO/Utility requirements and benchmark their response across various software platforms (e.g. PSSE/PSCAD/TSAT).
  • Review ISO and/or Utility interconnection study results, replicate findings and identify errors or alternative mitigations that could impact assigned network upgrades.
  • Support generation, large load and merchant transmission developers navigate interconnection processes across the Eastern Interconnect.
  • Collaborate with other team members on interconnection related studies and stay up to date with industry trends and regulatory changes.
  • Passionate about solving difficult technical problems, providing innovative solutions and taking ownership of the solutions provided.
  • Support the development of new products and services.
  • Experience leveraging AI and automation tools responsibly to improve quality, productivity and innovation under experience (bring your passion section.
  • Carry out additional duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Bring your passion, here's what’s needed:

Qualifications

  • Minimum 4 years of experience in the electric energy industry.
  • Experience in IBR modelling, transmission planning and/or interconnection studies and processes.
  • Strong understanding of FERC, NERC and ISO interconnection requirements and standards.
  • In-depth knowledge of at least one but preferably several of the following software packages: PSSE, TARA, PSLF, PowerWorld. ASPEN and PSCAD.

  • Experience leveraging AI and automation tools responsibly to improve quality, productivity and innovation

Beneficial Experience

  • Direct experience working at an ISO/Utility or on behalf of these entities as a consultant.
  • Experience with large-load interconnection studies and modelling.
  • Automation experience (Python, C#, SQL).

Lead the change!

Be a part of an innovative team shaping the grid of the future through advanced energy intelligence. For more than half a century, Electric Power Engineers (EPE) has partnered with power and energy clients across the globe, providing consulting expertise and energy intelligence software solutions for complex engineering and grid modeling challenges. As leaders in the renewables space, we are focused on building a modern, secure, and resilient grid. Join us in making an impact on the communities we serve and the environment in which we live.
