title: Industry Principal - Electronics & High-Tech
description: Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way.

raw.title: Industry Principal - Electronics & High-Tech
raw.excerpt: Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way.
raw.description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.

Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.

Role Summary

The Industry Principal (IP) is a highly visible, strategic role responsible for shaping PTC's growth and market strategy within the Electronics & High-Tech vertical. Acting as a trusted advisor to customers and internal stakeholders, the IA leverages deep industry expertise, executive engagement, and market insight to drive early-stage pipeline creation, strategic account expansion, and long-term growth.

This role partners closely with Sales, Product Management, Marketing, Partners, Services, and executive leadership to align PTC's solutions and go-to-market strategy with evolving industry priorities.

The ideal candidate has firsthand experience within the Electronics & High-Tech industry—including semiconductor, industrial electronics, networking, telecommunications, consumer electronics, or high-tech manufacturing—and understands how increasingly complex hardware and software products are developed and brought to market. Experience in product development, engineering, manufacturing, software development, systems engineering, PLM, digital engineering, or supply chain transformation is highly valued. Candidates may come from industry, strategic consulting, or Global Systems Integrators and possess the executive credibility to engage engineering and business leaders as a trusted advisor.

The Industry Principal helps define scalable industry go-to-market strategies, influences solution direction, strengthens executive relationships, and positions PTC as a strategic industry leader. Success in this role is measured by the ability to shape executive conversations, create early-stage opportunities, influence strategic account direction, and accelerate long-term pipeline growth—not simply support active sales pursuits.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as a trusted industry advisor to customers, sales teams, and executive leadership.
  • Engage C-level stakeholders to identify business challenges, transformation priorities, and strategic opportunities.
  • Drive early-stage pipeline creation and strategic account engagement across priority accounts.
  • Develop scalable industry go-to-market plays, messaging, and executive engagement strategies.
  • Partner with account teams on strategic account planning, stakeholder mapping, and opportunity progression.
  • Collaborate with Product, Marketing, Services, and Partners to align industry priorities and influence roadmap direction.
  • Build strategic relationships with partners and Global Systems Integrators (GSIs) to drive aligned go-to-market execution and customer outcomes.
  • Represent PTC at customer meetings, executive briefings, conferences, and industry events to elevate thought leadership and market awareness.
  • Provide industry insights, competitive intelligence, and customer feedback to strengthen solution positioning and strategy.
  • Mentor and enable GTM teams on industry trends, business value messaging, and executive engagement.

Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience within the Electronics & High-Tech industry in leadership, consulting, engineering, product development, manufacturing, digital transformation, or enterprise software, with the credibility to engage executive stakeholders as a trusted advisor.
  • Knowledge of PTC's solution portfolio and experience applying digital transformation technologies within the industry preferred.
  • Deep understanding of Electronics & High-Tech trends, including software-defined products, semiconductor supply chains, digital engineering, AI-enabled product development, model-based systems engineering, digital thread, cybersecurity, and manufacturing transformation.
  • Demonstrated ability to engage and influence executive and C-level stakeholders.
  • Proven experience supporting complex enterprise sales cycles and strategic account growth.
  • Strong executive presence with exceptional communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to translate business priorities into strategic technology and transformation discussions.
  • Established network of executive relationships across Electronics & High-Tech manufacturers, strategic partners, consulting organizations, and industry associations.
  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 25% for customer and industry engagement.

PTC carefully considers a wide range of factors when determining compensation. The anticipated annual salary range for this position is between $200,000 - $282,000. The anticipated annual salary range encompasses both the base salary and the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role. The salary range reflects a good-faith estimate of compensation at the time of posting.

Actual compensation may vary based on a candidate's skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Eligible employees also have the opportunity to become a PTC shareholder through our employee share purchase program (ESPP) which allows for the purchase of discounted PTC stock. Certain roles may also be eligible for participation in our equity programs. Employees may be eligible for medical, dental and vision insurance, paid time off and sick leave, tuition reimbursement, 401(k) contributions and employer match, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability coverage and if you are an office-assigned employee, a generous commuter subsidy. All total rewards and benefits programs are subject to plan eligibility and other terms and conditions.

For more information about PTC’s comprehensive benefits, please visit our Careers Page.

This position is not eligible for employment-based immigration sponsorship. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without requiring current or future sponsorship from PTC.At PTC, we believe in the power of diverse ideas and perspectives. As a global company that values and respects all identities, cultures, and perspectives, we strive to create an inclusive PTC for ALL through an environment where everyone feels like they belong and are empowered to bring their true, authentic selves to work. Proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and hire without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, ethnicity, ancestry, marital status, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.For more information about PTC’s comprehensive benefits and our AI usage, please visit our Careers Page ( Applications will be accepted on an on-going basis until the opportunity is filled.PTC endeavors to make ptc.com/careers accessible to all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact PTC's Talent Acquisition team at . This contact information is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you.

If you share our passion for problem-solving through innovation, you’ll likely become just as passionate about the PTC experience as we are. Are you ready to explore your next career move with us?

We respect the privacy rights of individuals and are committed to handling Personal Information responsibly and in accordance with all applicable privacy and data protection laws. Review our Privacy Policy here."

raw.title: Global Head of Business Development, Medical Devices - Business Assurance
raw.excerpt: The role reports to the Global Head of Medical Devices, Business Assurance.
raw.description:
The role reports to the Global Head of Medical Devices, Business Assurance.

Main purpose of role

  • Define and drive the global business development agenda for SGS Medical Devices, identifying growth opportunities across medical schemes, markets and customer segments.
  • Lead the Global Medical Business Development team and provide business development support, coordination and enablement to country, Delivering Office (DO) and Hub sales teams, without direct or indirect line management responsibility for those teams.
  • Translate market, client, competitor and regulatory insights into scalable service propositions, go-to-market priorities and strategic growth initiatives.
  • Act as the bridge between global business development, country sales, marketing, technical, regulatory and operational teams to support effective local execution and sustainable growth.

Defined responsibilities, authorities and accountabilities

The role encompasses a wide range of responsibilities, including but not limited to the following:

  • Define and maintain the global business development roadmap for all Medical schemes, aligned with the Medical Devices strategy and growth priorities.
  • Lead the Global Medical Business Development strategy and coordinate business development initiatives across countries, DOs and Hubs.
  • Build a structured view of market trends, client needs, competitor activity, regulatory developments and pricing dynamics to identify and prioritise growth opportunities.
  • Develop business cases and coordinate the incubation, launch and scaling of new or enhanced Medical certification schemes and service offerings.
  • Identify and develop opportunities in emerging markets, new customer segments, strategic partnerships and cross-SGS collaboration.
  • Shape clear value propositions, positioning, pricing principles and go-to-market toolkits in collaboration with Marketing, Technical, Regulatory, Operations and Finance.
  • Support country, DO and Hub sales teams in translating global priorities into local business development plans, customer ownership, pipeline conversion and delivery of sales targets.
  • Animate the international Medical sales and business development community through regular forums, best-practice sharing, targeted training, opportunity reviews and reusable commercial tools.
  • Coordinate support for strategic, complex or multi-country opportunities, connecting local sales teams with the relevant technical, regulatory, pricing and operational expertise; participate selectively in priority client engagements where global support adds value.
  • Facilitate transparent sharing of qualified opportunities and market intelligence across the network and promote consistent use of relevant CRM and reporting platforms.
  • Represent SGS in selected external forums, conferences and industry events to strengthen market insight, partnerships and brand visibility.
  • Ensure business development initiatives balance growth potential with regulatory, impartiality, integrity, capacity and delivery requirements.
  • Provide market and demand insight to support capacity modelling, subcontractor strategy and long-term workforce planning with Operations and Delivery.

Areas of accountability as member of the Global Leadership Team

  • Member of the Global Medical Leadership team for Medical Devices, where proactive input, reporting or data must be delivered on a regular basis, within area or responsibilities.
  • Drive and deliver projects proactively, without delay, within areas of responsibilities - taking full ownership from initiation through implementation.
  • Own and lead processes, ensuring regulatory, commercial, and operational alignment – within areas of responsibility.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives, within area of responsibilities, across Medical Devices.
  • Collaborate closely with relevant line managers across the business, to ensure seamless handover from contract review to delivery.
  • Support recruitment, onboarding, qualification, and competence management of personnel within area of responsibilities.
  • Ensure teams operate in full compliance with SGS integrity policies, impartiality requirements, and confidentiality obligations.
  • Maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders and contribute to regulatory and accreditation readiness activities.
  • Secure adequate resources for conformity assessment activities across all Medical schemes, within areas of responsibilities.
  • Drive standardisation and harmonisation of processes across schemes and regions – within areas of responsibilities.
  • Accountable for the activities and decisions taken by the notified body, including contractual agreements.

Skills & Knowledge

  • Demonstrated expertise in global business development, market development, portfolio growth and go-to-market coordination within medical devices or the TIC industry.
  • Understanding of MDR/IVDR and international regulatory frameworks.
  • Strong capability in market intelligence, opportunity assessment, business case development, service proposition design, positioning and pricing.
  • Ability to influence, enable and coordinate country sales teams in a matrix environment without formal authority.
  • Strong facilitation, communication, negotiation and stakeholder engagement capabilities across commercial, technical, regulatory and operational functions.
  • Demonstrated ability to work proactively and independently, taking ownership of global initiatives from concept through implementation.
  • Strong organisational, project and change management capabilities.
  • Strong commercial acumen and deep appreciation of the TIC industry.
  • Familiarity with conformity assessment procedures and Notified Body operations.
  • Multilingual proficiency and cross-cultural experience.

Experience

Essential

  • Minimum of 5 years in business development, market development, portfolio management or a comparable growth role within the medical device TIC industry or a closely related regulated B2B environment.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and implementing business development strategies across multiple countries or regions.
  • Proven success coordinating and enabling distributed sales or commercial communities in a matrix organisation without direct line authority.
  • Experience developing new markets, strategic partnerships, service propositions or complex multi-country opportunities.
  • Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder projects and balancing growth objectives with regulatory, compliance and operational constraints.
  • Experience using market intelligence, CRM and commercial performance data to prioritise initiatives and support decision-making.

Desirable

  • Experience collaborating with regulatory bodies, industry associations, or certification organisations.
  • Exposure to international business environments and experience navigating matrix organisational structures.
  • University degree in business, marketing, life sciences, engineering, or a related discipline.

The role can be fully remote and we are open to consider candidates located accros Europe (with valid work permit).

Please kindly write your CV in English

Why SGS?

  • Global and very stable company, world leader in the TIC (Testing, Inspection and Certification) industry.
  • Flexible schedule and hybrid model.
  • SGS university and Campus for continuos learning options.
  • Multinational environment where you will work with colleagues from multiple continents.
  • Benefits platform.

Join Us: At SGS we believe in innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We offer a supportive and inclusive work environment that encourages professional growth and personal development.

We are SGS – the world's leading testing, inspection and certification company. We are recognized as the global benchmark for sustainability, quality and integrity. Our 99,600 employees operate a network of 2,600 offices and laboratories, working together to enable a better, safer and more interconnected world.

At SGS, we have an open corporate and international culture. We offer a dynamic work environment in a leading global company. Our high professional standards and our sustainability approach guarantee you a future-oriented work environment. We invest in our employees for the long term and are committed to supporting your development within the company. Our business principles include: Integrity, Health, Safety & Environment, Quality & Professionalism, Respect, Sustainability, and Leadership.

title: Technical Co-founder (CTO)
description: The OpportunityFutureSight is seeking an applied AI builder to co-found and lead the technical direction of a new B2B AI venture from the ground up.

raw.title: Technical Co-founder (CTO)
raw.excerpt: The OpportunityFutureSight is seeking an applied AI builder to co-found and lead the technical direction of a new B2B AI venture from the ground up.
raw.description:
The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking an applied AI builder to co-found and lead the technical direction of a new B2B AI venture from the ground up. This is a co-founder partnership with founder-level equity and founder-level authority, not a salaried executive role.

We are not looking for someone who manages engineers from a distance or adds AI language to a traditional CTO resume. We are looking for someone who can take a vague problem, frame it clearly, design the right system, and turn it into something customers actually use and trust. If you've gone from ambiguity to working product before — and you want to do it again with the backing of an experienced venture building team — this is the opportunity.

This is a full-time, exclusive commitment to building and owning a single B2B AI venture from the ground up.

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You'll co-create with a proven venture building team, including:

  • John Carbrey – 4x founder, bootstrapped to $100M ARR
  • Joshua Auslander – Seasoned CFO and strategic advisor with $200M aggregate exits
  • Alan Smith – Globally recognized early stage validation expert, 24 products launched, an exit, 5M+ books sold
  • Prathna Ramesh – Early-stage investor and capital strategy advisor

The Partnership

  • Founder-level equity with meaningful ownership from inception, aligned across funding rounds
  • Founder-level authority, including co-decision rights on product, technology, hiring, fundraising, and strategy
  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding
  • A proven process and playbook for taking ventures from 0 to 1, informed by our team's prior experience and mistakes
  • Venture building and scaling resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one
  • Investor and advisor network across B2B AI and early-stage capital markets
  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CTO with FutureSight's cross-functional team as your partner — building alongside you.

What you'll own

As Co-Founder & CTO, you will set the venture's technical direction and lead its execution. This is a co-founder role, not a CTO hire.

  • Technical Direction — Own problem framing, architecture, system design, and product judgment from day one, translating rough product intent into structure, context, and specs that both humans and AI systems can execute against
  • Build — Use modern tools and frontier models to move fast without sacrificing quality or maintainability, designing agentic systems with first-principles thinking and knowing when orchestration adds genuine leverage versus when simplicity is the better call
  • Customer & Market — Be the primary technical voice in early customer conversations, understanding real workflows and shaping the right product rather than just shipping quickly
  • Traction Before Scale — Prove there is something worth scaling before thinking about scaling it, focusing on traction first and team-building second
  • Capital — Contribute to fundraising, from investor conversations to due diligence
  • Team — Recruit and grow a technical team when the time is right, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Proven track record of shipping AI products to real users under real-world constraints — not research, experiments, or prototypes
  • Deep practical experience with frontier models, LLM-based systems, and agentic architectures, with strong system design instincts and a bias for simplicity and maintainability
  • Strong translation layer skills — able to turn messy product intent into clear structure, constraints, and specs that both humans and AI systems can act on
  • Close to the customer, comfortable in customer conversations, and able to let real workflows shape what you build
  • Rigorous about verification — feedback loops, evaluation, and systems that can be trusted
  • Prior experience as a technical co-founder or early engineering leader, with fundraising experience a strong plus
  • Founder at heart — energized by ambiguity, able to go far alone, and ready to commit fully

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

raw.excerpt: Come join our team!  At Unlimited Technology, we are committed to our company's core values of Passion, Collaboration, Innovation and Adaptability.
raw.description:
Come join our team! At Unlimited Technology, we are committed to our company's core values of Passion, Collaboration, Innovation and Adaptability. With offices throughout the United States, we are a premier cyber and physical security specialty contractor, and we are growing at a rapid pace. We have a wide range of talented and experienced individuals that deliver cutting edge technology solutions to meet our customers’ ever-changing needs. We secure the facilities and networks of the world’s leading brands and critical infrastructure and are recognized leaders in the physical and IT security, cyber, and managed services industries. UT offers a rewarding career, great benefits, and the chance to learn and work with ground-breaking technology and premier clients.

Project Coordinator

Our growing company is seeking to hire a project coordinator who will be in charge of assisting our project and program managers in organizing our new and ongoing government projects. This task involves monitoring project plans, scheduling service and maintenance visits with clients, handling inquiries ensuing clients receive timely and accurate information. Addressing problems that arise during service delivery. Organizing and participating in stakeholder meetings and ensuring that project deadlines are met in a timely manner.

The Project Coordinator must be able to work on tight deadlines, be competent in using Microsoft Office applications such as Word and Excel, and have exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills. A bachelor's degree in a related field of study and at least three (3) years of relevant experience is required for consideration.

Project Coordinator Responsibilities:

  • Maintaining and monitoring project plans, project schedules and work hours.
  • Ensuring project deadlines are met.
  • Coordinate site service and maintenance visits with clients.
  • Accommodating updates and changes to project schedules.
  • Evaluating performance and preparing project progress reports.
  • Identifying potential project schedule delays and facilitating intervention in a timeous manner.
  • Ensuring projects adhere to frameworks and all documentation is maintained appropriately for each project and in accordance with contract requirements.
  • Developing, implementing, and maintaining an effective scheduling management system.
  • Organizing, attending, and participating in stakeholder meetings.
  • Keeping stakeholders informed of project timelines and deadlines.
  • Ensuring service tickets are properly documented and closed.

Project Coordinator Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in business or related field of study or three years of experience in a related field.
  • A minimum of two years' experience as a project scheduler in a related industry.
  • Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
  • Experience using computers for a variety of tasks.
  • Competency in Microsoft applications including Word, Excel, and Outlook.
  • Ability to work on tight deadlines.
  • Advanced ability to evaluate project progress and facilitate interventions.
  • Ability to keep stakeholders informed of project timelines and changes.
  • Excellent organizational, time-management, and communication skills.
  • Must be eligible to obtain a government clearance if necessary.
Pay Range
$65,000—$80,000 USD

Benefits

  • Health, dental, and vision coverage
  • Life insurance
  • 401 (k) w/company match 100% up to 3% and an additional 50% match of 2%
  • Paid time off
  • 11 Paid Holidays
  • Company Equity after 1 year

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, sex, age, national origin, disability, Veteran status, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Market Development Executive III - Cybersecurity Services & Managed Security Services

Now is the time to bring your expertise to Insight. We are not just a tech company; we are a people-first company. We believe that by unlocking the power of people and technology, we can accelerate transformation and achieve extraordinary results. As a Fortune 500 Solutions Integrator with deep expertise in cloud, data, AI, cybersecurity, and intelligent edge, we guide organizations through complex digital decisions.

About the role

Are you a proven cybersecurity services seller with deep expertise in Zero Trust, cloud security, managed detection and response (MDR), security operations, managed security services (MSS), or enterprise security transformation? Do you have experience guiding enterprise clients through complex security decisions, helping them architect, implement, manage, and secure their critical infrastructure? Are you looking for a remote career opportunity that rewards top performers?

Now is the time to bring your cybersecurity expertise to a consulting sales role for a Fortune 500 Solutions Integrator where success and fulfillment go hand in hand. You will be at the forefront of helping enterprises transform their security posture, strengthen their resilience, achieve compliance objectives, and optimize their security operations in an increasingly complex threat landscape.

The Opportunity
As a Market Development Executive with Insight, you will be the catalyst for identifying new cybersecurity and security services opportunities within our existing enterprise client base. We will count on you to introduce customized security consulting, implementation, managed services, and managed security services solutions to large enterprise clients across a spectrum of industries. You will manage the sales process from the initial security assessment, through solution design, to the final close. Along the way, you will leverage Insight's unique services expertise to provide everything our clients need to progress in one place: a creative vision, executional capabilities, and ongoing solutions management.

Previous enterprise cybersecurity sales experience is required; however, we will consider cloud security, infrastructure security, and application security experience as added benefits.

Qualifications and Responsibilities
We're seeking experienced technical and sales executives with a track record of strategizing & operationalizing cybersecurity and managed security services solutions to solve critical business problems. You should also have a bachelor's degree in business, IT, cybersecurity, or a related field and experience driving enterprise security sales.

Significant Cybersecurity & Managed Security Services Sales Experience
You are known as a trusted advisor to clients in how to deploy enterprise security solutions and have extensive experience in cybersecurity consulting services and managed security services: Zero Trust architecture, managed detection and response (MDR), security operations center (SOC) design and implementation, managed security services (MSS) operations and optimization, cloud security, application security, threat and vulnerability management, and/or security compliance and governance. Your track record in 'hunting' and 'farming' accounts, including new areas of an existing client with cybersecurity consulting and managed security services, will distinguish you as a meaningful addition to the account team. Your skills in multi-stakeholder engagement (CISO, CIO, Security Architects, Board-level executives), channel selling, and formal opportunity/account management methods will help you build a deep and varied set of opportunities. Your proven experience to forge new security vendor partnerships and your ability to quickly build trust with security vendor counterparties will establish new and consistent pipeline opportunities.

Managed Security Services Expertise
You bring hands-on knowledge of managed security services delivery models, including 24/7 monitoring, threat detection, incident response, and security operations optimization. You understand the operational and financial benefits of MSS to enterprise clients, including cost predictability, access to specialized talent, and improved security posture. You can articulate the value of transitioning from reactive security to proactive, managed security operations, and you have experience positioning MSS alongside traditional consulting and implementation services to create comprehensive security transformation programs.

Client Engagement Skills
You share our goal to make meaningful connections each day that positively impact the lives of the people we serve, including our clients, partners, and teammates. You build strong customer relationships with executive-level decision-makers (CISOs, CIOs, security leaders) around their security posture and operational efficiency, providing trusted advisory services to assist them in achieving their security transformation, compliance objectives, and security operations excellence.

Deep Technical Expertise
Your success in this role depends on your ability to help C-Suite & security leaders understand where their security posture sits within their broader IT and cloud infrastructure, and how managed security services can enhance their operational capabilities. Your knowledge of cybersecurity solutions, managed security services delivery, threat landscapes, and compliance requirements allows you to roadmap ideas and turn security challenges into transformation opportunities. Five years minimum of current and proven end-to-end security solutions sales experience. Preferred candidates will have five years minimum of enterprise cybersecurity services sales experience with numerous case study examples of leading complex security transformation deals, including managed security services implementations.

Growth Mindset
Your experience leading large security transformation initiatives as a security principal or consulting services specialist gives you an eye for whitespace within existing accounts. You see new opportunities for specialty security solutions, managed services, and operational improvements; execute technical account growth strategy in partnership with services delivery; and drive efficiency through automation and analytics. You embody our values: Hunger, Heart, and Harmony.

  • Freedom to work from another location—even an international destination—for up to 30 consecutive calendar days per year.

But what really sets us apart are our core values of Hunger, Heart, and Harmony, which guide everything we do, from building relationships with teammates, partners, and clients to making a positive impact in our communities.

Join us today, your ambITious journey starts here.

raw.description:
The Opportunity

Solo practitioners and small law firms still lose work the same way: missed calls, slow callbacks, and intake handled between hearings. Hiring is no answer — payroll, training, and turnover are exactly what these firms cannot absorb.

Problem and solution validation are complete. Multiple live pilots are entering production evaluation. The next phase is proving in-production reliability, delivery economics, and scalability. The teams that ship credible AI workers into trust-sensitive verticals in the next 18 months will define the category. We intend to be one of them.

The Venture

BloomLex is a managed AI staffing platform that delivers AI workers as fully-set-up hires — trained, monitored, and continuously improved by our team. Rather than another self-serve SaaS tool, BloomLex operates as a Role-as-a-Service business: lawyers evaluate us on outcomes — time saved, calls answered, consults booked — not configuration effort.

Our first hire, Ava, is an AI Front Desk that answers calls 24/7, captures structured intake, books consultations, and performs outbound callbacks, without creating new operational burden for the lawyer. The roadmap expands from the front desk into adjacent AI staff roles, all delivered through the same managed model.

The Partnership

The CEO co-founder is in place. The customer thesis is validated, design partners are engaged, and live pilots are running. What remains is to bring on the technical co-founder — a partner who will own product and engineering with the same conviction, urgency, and ownership stake.

This is a co-founder role, not a CTO hire. In return for that level of commitment, you receive founder-level equity, founder-level authority with co-decision rights on product, technology, hiring, fundraising, and strategy, and a genuine partnership with the CEO on every material decision.

What you'll own

As Co-Founder & CTO, you will write the first lines of production code, set the technical direction, and lead execution end-to-end.

  • Architecture & Reliability — Harden Ava's voice and workflow systems for in-production reliability. Establish core architecture, observability, and audit-trail standards
  • RaaS Delivery Layer — Build the internal infrastructure that lets the team configure, monitor, and optimize AI performance without scaling engineering headcount
  • Unit Economics — Own the trade-offs between AI quality and cost-per-call, and lock in unit economics within the $499/month pricing model
  • Customer & Market — Represent the company in front of lawyers, partners, and investors as the technical voice of the venture
  • Roadmap — Convert pilots into paying customers, expand the AI staff beyond the front desk, and begin a path toward custom and self-hosted models where legal and privacy requirements demand it
  • Team — Recruit and lead the founding engineering team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Shipped LLM-powered and voice systems into production environments where incorrect outputs carried real consequences
  • Full-stack confidence across applied LLMs, real-time voice and conversational AI, telephony, human-in-the-loop workflows, observability, and secure multi-tenant SaaS
  • Well-formed convictions about reliability engineering, edge-case management, and the trade-offs between AI quality and cost-per-call
  • Experience building managed and service-heavy platforms, with the discipline to scale delivery without scaling engineering headcount
  • Prepared to operate as a principal — including saying "this won't scale" or "this isn't ready" when the integrity of the product requires it
  • Strongly preferred: prior founder or early-stage technical leadership experience; background in legal tech, healthcare, or another trust-sensitive vertical; capability to self-host custom models to meet legal and privacy needs

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

IPinfo New Business Sales Job Specification

About IPinfo

IPinfo was founded on a simple belief: IP data should be accurate, accessible, and reliable. Today, organizations around the world — from fast-growing startups to global enterprises — rely on our data to reduce risk, stop fraud, and better understand the network traffic that powers both their own operations and their customers’ businesses.

Rather than depending solely on static or third-party sources, we validate and generate our data through weekly, factual internet measurements. This approach delivers industry-leading accurate and reliable IP intelligence, strengthened by billions of weekly lookups and a team of remote data engineers and researchers.

The data supports some of the most respected companies in technology and security, including Anthropic, Cisco, Cloudflare, Datadog, Docker, Google, Mastercard, Microsoft, OpenAI, Snowflake, Censys, and Barracuda — organizations that depend on our scale and precision for mission-critical security, compliance, and operational workflows.

Whether helping a cybersecurity platform block threats, enabling a fintech provider to meet compliance requirements, or assisting an enterprise fraud team in preventing abuse, we provide the clarity needed to make confident, informed decisions.

Key Requirements

We are looking for a U.S.-based New Business Sales Representative with the following capabilities:

  1. Consultative Discovery & Business Understanding
    1. Working closely with prospects to understand their business, operating environment and priorities
    2. Identifying the challenges they want to overcome — and why those challenges matter
    3. Translating complex customer needs into compelling value aligned with IPinfo’s data products.
  2. Identifying Additional Challenges & Expanding Value
    1. Proactively uncover additional or adjacent problems IPinfo can solve — ideally ones where IPinfo is uniquely positioned to provide value.
  3. Ability to Drive Urgency & Deals to a Close
    1. Create and maintain momentum throughout the sales cycle
    2. Be prepared to discuss their approach to creating urgency during the interview, including real examples of how they’ve successfully done this in past roles.
    3. Experience using the MEDPICC sales methodology to qualify, progress and close opportunities.
  4. Proven New Business Hunter
    1. Independently identifying and targeting new accounts
    2. Owning full-cycle new business deals from first conversation to close
    3. Consistently achieving at least 30% of quota through self-generated pipeline, with the drive to exceed expectations.
  5. Thrives in a Fully Remote Company
    1. Work autonomously with high accountability
    2. Manage priorities and pipeline independently
    3. Travel within the U.S and internationally for customer meetings, conferences, and team gatherings.
  6. Contributes to Sales Best Practices
    1. Share practical experience selling IPinfo data and actively contribute to elevating sales best practices
    2. Provide actionable insights from the field to help refine and strengthen our GTM strategy
    3. Strengthen overall sales excellence across the team.

What We Offer

  1. Competitive compensation with uncapped commission potential that rewards high performance and ambition
  2. A leadership team that actively supports your success and a culture built on transparency, momentum and continuous improvement
  3. The opportunity to work with industry-leading IP data trusted by some of the world’s most innovative and high-impact technology and security companies
  4. A welcoming, collaborative culture where surrounding teams — including engineering, product, data, and leadership — are highly supportive of the sales organisation and invested in its success
  5. Meaningful professional development opportunities, with room to grow your impact and responsibilities as the team scales, and shape the future of our commercial organisation
  6. An annual in-person company retreat to connect, collaborate, and build relationships with colleagues from around the world.
  7. Fully remote work environment; flexible hours; unlimited PTO; a $1,000 home office stipend; comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents; optional Health and Dependent Care FSAs; and a 401(k) with company match up to 4%.

Next Steps

If this opportunity aligns with your experience and ambitions, we encourage you to apply. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an initial conversation, followed by a structured interview process focused on discovery skills, sales methodology, alignment with IPinfo’s values and remote-first culture.

Please register your interest by contacting Robert Simmons and Austin Essam, who lead our New Business and Sales teams, using and .

Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

Position Summary

The Principal Data Architect is responsible for designing, governing, and optimizing the enterprise data architecture that supports analytics, operational data needs, AI/ML capabilities, and strategic business objectives. This role ensures data is structured, integrated, secured, and governed in a way that maximizes usability and value across the organization.

As a key contributor within the Data, Analytics & AI Architecture and Strategy Office, you will set architecture direction, create reusable patterns and canonical models, and guide multi‑domain, cross‑platform implementations. You will partner with executives, product leaders, data engineering, analytics, security, and data governance teams to modernize the data ecosystem (e.g., lakehouse, data mesh/fabric, streaming, data products), shorten time‑to‑insight, and enable AI/ML at scale. You will own critical architectural artifacts, proof‑of‑concepts, and reference implementations for mission‑critical initiatives, and mentor architects and engineers across the organization.

This role is instrumental in establishing the building blocks of the organization’s data ecosystem—data domains, data products, semantic layers, metadata frameworks, and data quality controls—while helping evolve the organization toward modern patterns such as data fabric, data mesh, and cloud‑native lakehouse platforms.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities

Data Architecture & Modeling

  • Conduct current‑state assessments and define transition architectures to reach the target state with measurable milestones and risk mitigation.

  • Own conceptual, logical, and physical data models across enterprise domains.

  • Establish standards for data modeling, canonical data definitions, and metadata structures.

  • Define modeling patterns (e.g., 3NF, dimensional/star, Data Vault, wide tables/Delta, semantic/metrics layers) and enforce consistency.

  • Partner with data engineering to implement data models in modern cloud platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery).

  • Ensure lineage, metadata, and data contracts are designed and documented to support interoperability and governed data sharing.

  • Ensure consistent, reusable, and scalable data structures aligned to enterprise data strategy.

Data Platform & Integration Design

  • Architect data ingestion, transformation, storage, and distribution patterns aligned with platform capabilities.

  • Define best practices for data architecture across batch, micro‑batch, and streaming use cases.

  • Evaluate and recommend data platform technologies for lakehouse, data warehouse, data lake, and operational data stores.

  • Optimize data storage and processing for performance, cost, and scalability.

  • Guide implementation teams on data structures, partitioning strategies, indexing, and schema design.

Data Governance, Quality & Security

  • Partner with governance to operationalize data ownership/stewardship, policy enforcement, PII/PHI protection, and compliance.

  • Collaborate with governance teams to define data policies, data contracts, and stewardship models.

  • Define data quality SLAs/SLOs, validation rules, trust scores, and observability practices (schema drift, freshness, lineage, anomaly detection).

  • Architect security-by-design (RBAC/PBAC/ABAC, column/row‑level security, masking, encryption, key management) across cloud and on‑prem environments.

  • Integrate governance tooling (e.g., Collibra, Purview ) with catalogs, lineage, and policy management.

  • Ensure data definitions, lineage, classifications, and business context are documented and visible.

Standards, Patterns & Reuse

  • Publish and maintain architecture patterns, blueprints, guardrails, and decision records (ADRs) to drive consistency and reuse.

  • Lead design reviews and architecture councils, ensuring adherence to standards, NFRs (performance, reliability, security), and cost targets.

  • Curate a library of data product templates, quality checks, and integration accelerators.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Translate complex architectural concepts into clear business narratives and trade‑off analyses for senior stakeholders.

  • Work with business stakeholders to understand data requirements and translate them into data architecture solutions.

  • Provide mentoring and coaching to solution/data architects and senior engineers; develop talent and elevate architecture practices.

  • Influence portfolio planning, platform investments, and prioritization through architecture insights and value cases.

  • Present data architecture decisions, tradeoffs, and recommendations in a clear, business‑friendly manner.

Innovation & Emerging Technology

  • Lead POCs and reference implementations to validate modern patterns (lakehouse, mesh/fabric, streaming, data contracts, metrics layers).

  • Continuously scan market/industry trends and recommend pragmatic adoption plans that reduce complexity and accelerate value.

AI/ML Data Enablement (Supporting Role)

  • Ensure data structures and pipelines support ML feature engineering, training, inference, and MLOps.

  • Collaborate with data scientists by providing well‑curated, governed, high‑quality datasets.

  • Design data architectures that enable the integration of AI/ML outputs back into operational and analytical systems.

EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.

Preferred Certifications

  • CDMP, Data Modeling certifications, or cloud data certifications (Azure, AWS, GCP).

  • TOGAF or related architecture framework experience (desired, not required).

Work Experience

  • 9–12 years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, or data modeling.

  • 5–8 years architecting data structures and data platforms in cloud environments.

  • Strong experience with conceptual/logical/physical data modeling and data integration.

  • Demonstrated impact advancing data governance, quality, and platform modernization.

  • Demonstrated success designing data solutions for analytics, BI, or AI/ML.

Skills & Knowledge

Technical Expertise

  • Data platforms: Databricks (Delta/Lakehouse), Snowflake, BigQuery ; object storage (ADLS/S3/GCS).

  • Integration & orchestration: ADF, IICS, dbt, Airflow; Kafka/event streaming, CDC; APIs and pub/sub.

  • Modeling & semantics: 3NF, dimensional/star, Data Vault, semantic/metrics layers, data product modeling, data contracts.

  • Programming & query:SQL, Python; performance tuning and cost governance.

  • BI & analytics: Power BI, Tableau, Looker; governance of shared semantic models/metrics.

  • Governance & security: Metadata/catalogs (Collibra/Purview), lineage, DQ frameworks, RBAC/ABAC, masking, encryption, KMS.

  • AI/ML enablement: Feature stores, MLflow, model registries, RAG/vector patterns (as enablers, not model authorship).

Leadership & Behavioral Skills

  • Strategic and systems thinking; ability to simplify complex ecosystems.

  • Executive communication, storytelling, and influencing without authority.

  • Mentorship, coaching, and community of practice leadership.

  • Bias for outcomes, pragmatism, and high judgment in trade‑offs.

  • Growth mindset, innovation, and continuous learning.

Work Environment

Quiet office environment with computer‑based work and typical mobility. Ability to handle complex situations and competing demands.

What Cencora offers

We provide compensation, benefits, and resources that enable a highly inclusive culture and support our team members’ ability to live with purpose every day. In addition to traditional offerings like medical, dental, and vision care, we also provide a comprehensive suite of benefits that focus on the physical, emotional, financial, and social aspects of wellness. This encompasses support for working families, which may include backup dependent care, adoption assistance, infertility coverage, family building support, behavioral health solutions, paid parental leave, and paid caregiver leave. To encourage your personal growth, we also offer a variety of training programs, professional development resources, and opportunities to participate in mentorship programs, employee resource groups, volunteer activities, and much more. raw.description:
The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead Weli, a B2B WealthTech venture. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.

Weli is an AI-native operations platform purpose-built for wealth management firms. It plugs directly into the CRM, portfolio management, and custodian systems firms already run, and executes the back-office work behind every account, account opening, money transfer, trade coordination, and compliance routing. Every wealth management firm already staffs an Operations function to do this work, typically at a ratio of roughly one Operations person to every three advisors, and that function is chronically stretched: slow, error-prone, and unable to give any single advisor's book the full attention it deserves. Weli is built for the firm's back office.

Market Context

Weli's customers are independent and hybrid RIAs, firms built around senior advisors who own their own client books and lean on a small, shared operations team to execute everything behind the scenes. It's a large and fast-growing world. There are roughly 300,000 wealth and financial advisors in the US, and the independent channel has been on a two-decade climb, from under a fifth of the industry's assets in 2007 to 27% today, on track for nearly a third by 2028.

Growth is outpacing the operations layer built to support it. The industry's leading benchmarking study found 78% of RIA firms were actively hiring last year just to keep up with capacity constraints, and most firms add a full new hire for every $360,000 of revenue growth, an expensive, linear way to scale a business that should compound. In our own interviews, one managing partner put a number on it directly: his firm could roughly triple its assets under management with its current advisor headcount if operations could keep pace. That gap, real, quantifiable, and largely unaddressed by today's AI tools, is Weli's opportunity.

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven venture building team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

The Partnership

  • Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception
  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding
  • Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one
  • Investor and advisor network across fintech and early-stage capital markets
  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight’s cross-functional team as your partner

What You’ll Own

As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead its execution.

  • Strategy — Refine the ICP, pricing model, and product positioning
  • Customer Development — Lead pilots with RIA and wealth management firms, convert them to paid engagements, and build the go-to-market motion
  • Product — Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 and iterate on user feedback
  • Capital — Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction
  • Team — Recruit and lead a cohesive founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Previous founding experience at a venture-backed company
  • Demonstrated success in B2B SaaS go-to-market, including sales and customer engagement
  • Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital
  • Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent
  • Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company
  • Direct exposure to wealth management, RIA operations, and financial services compliance, with the credibility and relationships to navigate the industry's regulatory landscape and sell into established firms

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

raw.description:
About Axuall

Built with leading healthcare systems, Axuall is a clinical workforce intelligence company built on top of a national real-time practitioner data network. It enables healthcare systems, staffing firms, telehealth organizations, and health plans to accelerate clinician onboarding, improve hiring and workforce planning, and maintain accurate provider data across enterprise systems. By delivering trusted data, AI-powered insights, and seamless data exchange, Axuall empowers healthcare organizations to improve operational efficiency, strengthen clinical coverage, and support revenue capture.

Axuall's investors and the organizations they represent comprise over two dozen of the nation's leading healthcare organizations that recognize the imperative to improve clinical workforce efficiency amid significant economic and staffing challenges.

About the Role

Axuall is building a formal Customer Success function, and this role is foundational to that effort. The Senior Customer Success Manager (Sr. CSM) will partner directly with the SVP of Customer Experience to design, stand up, and operationalize Axuall's customer success program from the ground up — establishing the playbooks, engagement model, and success metrics — while also owning a portfolio of accounts and driving adoption, satisfaction, and retention across the full Axuall platform.

This is a build-and-run role: part program architect, part practitioner. The Sr. CSM will work cross-functionally with Account Management, Client Services, and Implementation to ensure a seamless, connected customer journey across all Axuall solutions (Confirm, Explore, and Sync). An important distinction: renewal and expansion ownership sits with Account Management, while this role fuels those outcomes through adoption and value realization.

Reporting & Team Structure

  • Reports directly to the SVP, Customer Experience.
  • Partners closely with Strategic Account Managers (SAMs), Client Services/Implementation teams, Product, and Solutions/Support to deliver a unified customer experience.

What You'll Do

Program Foundation

  • Co-design Axuall's Customer Success strategy, engagement model, and lifecycle framework alongside the SVP of Customer Experience.
  • Build foundational playbooks, processes, and tools for proactive customer success, including onboarding-to-adoption handoffs, health scoring, QBR cadence, and escalation paths.
  • Better define and optimize current success metrics and reporting (adoption, product usage, health scores, NPS/CSAT) in partnership with CX leadership.
  • Identify and close structural gaps in the current customer journey, particularly proactive adoption ownership.

Adoption & Relationship Management

  • Own a portfolio of customer relationships post-implementation, driving solution adoption and utilization and alleviating pain points across the full Axuall platform (Confirm, Explore, and Sync).
  • Serve as the customer's trusted advisor on how to get maximum value from Axuall's solutions, aligning products to each customer's strategic priorities and workforce data goals.
  • Lead regular operational reviews and health check-ins; proactively flag risk and drive mitigation plans.
  • Develop in-depth knowledge of customer needs, trends, and the competitive landscape to inform account strategy.
  • Surface adoption trends, usage data, and the value narrative to the SAM to support their ownership of renewal and expansion conversations, inclusive of mutual success plans and account specific strategy.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work hand-in-hand with Client Services and Implementation teams to ensure smooth transitions from onboarding into steady-state success.
  • Partner with SAMs to align on account strategy and risk, with clear handoff points between adoption (CSM) and commercial ownership (SAM).
  • Provide consistent feedback to Product and Engineering to help launch new features successfully and share insight into what customers want and need.
  • Represent the voice of the customer in internal planning and cross-functional forums.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years in Customer Success or Account Management in healthcare tech, preferably a SaaS-based product environment.
  • Demonstrated experience building or significantly maturing a Customer Success function, to include examples of playbooks, processes, or programs, not just operating within an existing one.
  • Excellent client service skills and the ability to connect with healthcare professionals across a variety of roles (physicians, departmental leadership, executive leads, etc.).
  • Strong administrative skills and sophistication to manage business processes in complex environments; highly organized and systematic with superb attention to detail.
  • Comfort operating with ambiguity, able to define structure and process where none currently exists.
  • Strong understanding of the client ecosystem and the decision-making processes therein.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to educate, influence, and present to prospective or existing clients.

What You'll Get From Us

We offer a wide range of beneﬁts for our team including:

  • Comprehensive Health Insurance
  • 401(k) with Employer Match
  • Wellness Stipend
  • Professional Development Reimbursement
  • Work From Home Stipend
  • Remote Work Flexibility
  • Flexible PTO
  • Paid parental leave

In addition, Axuall is committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace that reﬂects the communities we serve and empowers every employee to reach their full potential. We encourage DEI through our Diversity in Tech (DiT) Employee Resource Group along with impactful programming that supports and fosters a place of belonging for our team members every day.

Equal Employment Opportunity & Pay Equity Commitment

Axuall is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. Axuall maintains pay-equity practices that prohibit reliance on salary history and require that compensation decisions be supported by legitimate, job-related factors.

Interview Path

  1. Talent Acquisition Interview
  2. Hiring Manager Interview
  3. Team Interviews
  4. Executive Panel
  5. Reference Calls
  6. Hiring Decision

This role may be performed from any U.S. jurisdiction in which Axuall is registered to do business. Please note that certain localities may impose additional employment requirements that will be addressed during the hiring process. Please also note that we are currently unable to sponsor visas. While this role is remote-first, we require employees to attend an in-person orientation at our headquarters in Cleveland, Ohio. There may also be occasional instances where travel to our HQ is needed.

Pay Transparency & Compensation

Base Salary Range (Good-Faith Estimate): $130,000 - $150,000 plus incentive bonus compensation

Classification: Full Time

Additional Compensation: Equity incentive plan participation upon hirePay Frequency: Semi-monthly

The posted range represents Axuall’s reasonable and good-faith estimate of the compensation the Company expects to pay for the position at the time of this posting. Actual compensation will be based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and internal equity.

raw.description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

General Description:

The Senior Director, North America Compliance will serve as the lead Compliance business partner for the U.S. Commercial organization, with particular focus on Market Access. Reporting to the Head of Compliance, Americas, this role will provide strategic, practical, and risk-based compliance guidance that enables business objectives while supporting an effective North America Compliance Program.

The Senior Director will partner closely with senior leaders and teams across Market Access, Sales, Marketing, Patient Services, Trade and Distribution, Legal, and other functions. The role will advise on complex U.S. healthcare compliance matters across payer and customer engagement, pricing and contracting activities, patient support and access programs, field execution, promotional activities, and other evolving commercial models.

The ideal candidate is an experienced, business-minded healthcare compliance leader who understands the U.S. pharmaceutical commercial and market access environment, can anticipate risk, and is comfortable making sound decisions in areas where the path may not be straightforward. This individual will be expected to build trusted relationships, influence at senior levels, and translate legal and regulatory requirements into clear, pragmatic guardrails that support responsible innovation and sustainable growth.

Essential Functions of the Job:

U.S. Commercial & Market Access Compliance Leadership:

  • Serve as the lead Compliance business partner for the U.S. Commercial organization, with primary responsibility for supporting Market Access and related access, reimbursement, and customer-facing activities.
  • Provide strategic, timely, and practical compliance advice to senior Commercial and Market Access leaders on business strategies, product launches, customer engagement models, and new or evolving initiatives.
  • Advise on compliance considerations involving payers, pharmacy benefit managers, group purchasing organizations, health systems, specialty pharmacies, distributors, wholesalers, integrated delivery networks, government accounts, and other market access stakeholders.
  • Provide compliance guidance on pricing and contracting activities, discounts and rebates, formulary and access discussions, value-based or innovative arrangements, patient support and affordability programs, reimbursement activities, and other market access initiatives in partnership with Legal and relevant subject-matter experts.
  • Support U.S. Sales and Marketing teams on key commercial compliance matters, including promotional practices, healthcare professional and customer interactions, speaker programs, advisory boards, sponsorships, field activities, and other external engagements.
  • Develop a deep understanding of business objectives and operating models in order to identify risk early, propose pragmatic solutions, and embed appropriate controls into business processes.

Strategic Risk Management & Compliance Program Execution:

  • Partner with the Head of Compliance, Americas to execute North America compliance strategy and priorities and to continuously enhance a modern, risk-based compliance program.
  • Identify and assess emerging compliance risks arising from changes in the U.S. healthcare, enforcement, reimbursement, and commercial landscape and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies.
  • Lead or support compliance risk assessments, monitoring, auditing, investigations, and remediation activities relating to U.S. Commercial and Market Access activities.
  • Use monitoring results, business data, industry developments, and other risk indicators to identify trends and recommend enhancements to controls, training, policies, and business processes.
  • Support compliance governance and senior leadership reporting, including clear communication of significant risks, trends, decisions, and mitigation plans.

Policies, Training & Business Guidance:

  • Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of policies, procedures, field guidance, training, and other compliance resources relevant to U.S. Commercial and Market Access activities.
  • Design and deliver engaging, risk-based compliance training for Commercial and Market Access teams, including leadership and field-based personnel.
  • Translate complex laws, regulations, enforcement developments, and industry standards into clear, actionable guidance for business partners.
  • Promote a culture of integrity, accountability, thoughtful risk-taking, and speak-up across the U.S. organization.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Leadership:

  • Build strong, trusted relationships with leaders and stakeholders across Commercial, Market Access, Legal, Corporate Affairs, HR, and other functions.
  • Work closely with the Global Compliance Program Office and other regional and global Compliance colleagues to promote consistency, share best practices, and support enterprise initiatives.
  • Lead or participate in cross-functional projects, launch readiness activities, governance forums, and strategic initiatives to ensure compliance considerations are incorporated early in planning and execution.
  • • Serve as a visible Compliance leader who demonstrates sound judgment, constructive challenge, executive presence, and a solutions-oriented approach to complex business issues.

Supervisory Responsibilities: Yes

  • Provides direct leadership, management, coaching, and development to assigned Compliance team members.
  • Sets priorities and expectations, provides ongoing feedback, and supports the professional development and performance of direct reports.
  • Provides functional leadership and mentorship across the North America Compliance team and helps foster a collaborative, high-performing, and business-focused Compliance organization.
  • May lead or oversee the work of contractors, consultants, or other resources supporting Compliance initiatives.

Education Required:

  • BA/BS Degree is required.
  • Advanced degree (JD, PharmD, MBA, MPH, or similar) preferred.

Qualifications:

  • BA/BS Degree with 12 + years of relevant experience in healthcare compliance, legal, regulatory, audit, or related functions within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences industry, including significant experience supporting U.S. commercial activities.
  • Demonstrated experience advising Market Access organizations and strong understanding of the U.S. payer, reimbursement, patient access, trade/distribution, and contracting environment.
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. pharmaceutical compliance requirements and industry standards, including the Anti-Kickback Statute, False Claims Act, federal and state transparency requirements, FDA promotional requirements, PhRMA Code, and OIG/DOJ compliance expectations.
  • Experience providing compliance guidance on market access topics such as payer and customer engagements, discounts and rebates, contracting, formulary discussions, patient support programs, reimbursement support, specialty pharmacy, and other access-related activities.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting or supporting risk assessments, monitoring, auditing, training, policy development, and remediation.
  • Experience supporting product launches and working in a fast-paced, matrixed, and evolving commercial environment strongly preferred.

Computer Skills:

  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and collaboration platforms such as SharePoint and Teams.
  • Experience with compliance, expense, CRM, analytics, or reporting platforms such as Concur, Salesforce, Power BI, or similar tools preferred.

Skills & Competencies:

  • Exceptional judgment and ability to assess complex or ambiguous issues, balance risk and business objectives, and provide clear recommendations.
  • Strong business acumen and ability to understand commercial strategy, market access models, customer dynamics, and operational processes.
  • Ability to translate complex compliance concepts into practical, business-focused guidance and workable solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and build credibility with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders without relying on positional authority.
  • Strong executive presence and excellent written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Proactive, collaborative, and solutions-oriented approach with the ability to challenge constructively and navigate competing priorities.
  • Ability to work independently, exercise discretion, and manage multiple high-priority matters in a dynamic environment.
  • Commitment to integrity, continuous learning, and fostering a strong speak-up and compliance culture.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Is viewed by U.S. Commercial and Market Access leaders as a trusted, strategic advisor who enables responsible business execution.
  • Anticipates emerging risks and provides clear, pragmatic guardrails before issues arise.
  • Strengthens compliance oversight of Market Access and other U.S. Commercial activities through effective guidance, training, monitoring, and risk mitigation.
  • Builds strong cross-functional partnerships and helps teams make thoughtful, well-informed decisions in complex areas.
  • Contributes to a practical, business-focused, and integrity-driven compliance culture aligned with BeOne values.

Travel:

  • Ability to travel domestically approximately 25%

Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

  • Fosters Teamwork
  • Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback
  • Self-Awareness
  • Acts Inclusively
  • Demonstrates Initiative
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset
  • Continuous Learning
  • Embraces Change
  • Results-Oriented
  • Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis
  • Financial Excellence
  • Communicates with Clarity
Salary Range: $231,800.00 - $301,800.00 annually

Actual compensation packages are determined by several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job-related skills, depth of experience, certifications, relevant education or training, and specific work location. Job Title: Experienced Clinical Research Associate- Israel

Job Location: Netanya, Israel

Job Location Type: Home-based

Job Contract Type: Full time

Job Seniority Level:

Job Overview
Perform monitoring and site management work to ensure that sites are conducting the study(ies) and reporting study data as required by the study protocol, applicable regulations and guidelines, and sponsor requirements.

Essential Functions
• Perform site monitoring visits (selection, initiation, monitoring and close-out visits) in accordance with contracted scope of work and regulatory requirements, i.e., Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) guidelines
• Work with sites to adapt, drive, and track subject recruitment plan in line with project needs to enhance predictability.
• Administer protocol and related study training to assigned sites and establish regular lines of communication with sites to manage ongoing project expectations and issues.
• Evaluate the quality and integrity of study site practices related to the proper conduct of the protocol and adherence to applicable regulations. Escalate quality issues as appropriate.
• Manage the progress of assigned studies by tracking regulatory submissions and approvals, recruitment and enrollment, case report form (CRF) completion and submission, and data query generation and resolution. May support start-up phase.
• Ensure copies/originals (as required) site documents are available for filing in the Trial Master File (TMF) and verify that the Investigator's Site File (ISF) is maintained in accordance with GCP and local regulatory requirements.
• Create and maintain appropriate documentation regarding site management, monitoring visit findings and action plans by submitting regular visit reports, generating follow-up letters and other required study documentation.
• Collaborate and liaise with study team members for project execution support as appropriate.
• If applicable, may be accountable for supporting development of project subject recruitment plan on a per site basis.
• If applicable, may be accountable for site financial management according to executed clinical trial agreement and retrieve invoices according to local requirement.

Qualifications
• High School Diploma or equivalent Degree in scientific discipline or health care preferred.
• Requires at least 2 year of on-site monitoring experience.
• Equivalent combination of education, training and experience may be accepted in lieu of degree.
• Good knowledge of, and skill in applying, applicable clinical research regulatory requirements (i.e., Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) guidelines).
• Good therapeutic and protocol knowledge as provided in company training.
• Computer skills including proficiency in use of Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint and use of a laptop computer and iPhone and iPad (where applicable).
• Written and verbal communication skills including good command of English language.
• Organizational and problem-solving skills.
• Effective time and financial management skills.
• Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with coworkers, managers, and clients.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.
