Enterprise Data Center Business Development Director

Department: Sales

Full-time

Remote
On-Target Earnings: $350,000-400,000, dependent on experience, ($150,000 base + uncapped commissions)

Company Description:

DMD Systems Recovery is on a mission to protect the planet – one IT asset at a time. We help companies securely erase data and give technology a second life through reuse, refurbishment, and responsible recycling. As a certified B Corp, we believe business should do more than make money – it should make a difference. Every laptop, server, and device we process helps reduce waste, shrink landfills, and fuel the next generation of technology. If you care about sustainability, real‑world impact, and smart tech solutions, DMD is a place where your work truly matters.

Our headquarters are in Tempe, Arizona, with additional processing facilities in Austin, Texas and Palo Alto, California.

Job Summary:

DMD Systems Recovery LLC, a leader in IT asset disposition (ITAD), is seeking a dynamic, results-driven Enterprise Data Centre Business Development Director to drive strategic growth across enterprise-owned data centers, colocation providers, cloud service providers, and infrastructure organizations.

This is a true hunter role focused primarily on net-new logo acquisition and expansion into large-scale enterprise infrastructure environments. The successful candidate will develop and execute account strategies that create long-term partnerships with organizations undergoing data center migrations, cloud transformations, hardware refreshes, consolidations, divestitures, and infrastructure modernization initiatives. You will identify, develop, and close complex six- and seven-figure IT Asset Disposition (ITAD) and data center lifecycle management opportunities. Working closely with executive stakeholders, operations teams, and strategic partners, you will position DMD as the preferred provider of secure, sustainable, and financially beneficial ITAD solutions.

This role reports to one of the Sales Directors and offers a clear pathway toward future sales leadership opportunities as DMD continues its rapid growth.

Key Responsibilities:

New Business Development (Hunter Focus)

  • New business development. Proactively identify and target potential clients for ITAD services, including companies with large IT infrastructures, government agencies, data centers, and technology firms.

  • Enterprise & data center relationships. Develop and leverage relationships across enterprise-owned data centers, colocation providers, and cloud service providers to identify, pursue, and close new business opportunities.

Consultative & Solution Selling

  • Client relationship management. Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, ensuring exceptional customer service and satisfaction throughout the IT asset disposition process.

  • Consultative sales approach. Understand clients’ IT asset lifecycle and offer solutions tailored to their specific needs, including data security, environmental compliance, and value recovery from retired IT assets.

  • Solution selling. Promote the full range of DMD’s ITAD services, including secure data destruction, equipment remarketing, logistics management, and e-waste recycling.

Proposals, Market Intelligence & Collaboration

  • Proposal development. Create and present customized proposals, RFP responses, and contracts to potential clients, aligning DMD’s services with their operational and compliance requirements.

  • Market research & competitive analysis. Stay informed about industry trends, competitors, and market conditions to develop strategies for expanding the client base and increasing market share.

  • Cross-functional collaboration. Work closely with DMD’s operations, logistics, and technical teams to ensure smooth service delivery and meet client expectations.

Sales Targets & Reporting

  • Sales targets. Meet or exceed individual and team sales quotas and revenue goals, providing regular sales forecasting and reporting to leadership.

  • Records management. Maintain and update sales and customer records.

Education and Experience:

  • B2B sales experience. 8+ years of B2B sales experience, preferably in a new-business account executive role within IT asset disposition, IT services, or related technology industries.

  • Complex deal leadership. Experience leading complex six- and seven-figure sales engagements involving multiple stakeholders, long sales cycles, and executive-level decision makers - including multi-year enterprise contracts and RFP-driven deals.

  • Proven track record. A history of exceeding revenue targets and closing high-value deals. You have led or significantly influenced deals with Fortune 1000/5000-level clients and understand how to navigate long sales cycles, procurement processes, and enterprise RFPs.

  • ITAD & IT hardware knowledge. Knowledge of IT hardware (servers, networking equipment, computers, etc.) and the ITAD process, including data security, e-waste recycling regulations, and equipment remarketing.

  • Communication & presentation. Excellent communication and presentation skills with a focus on customer service and problem-solving.

  • Independence & prioritization. Ability to work independently, manage time efficiently, and prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.

  • Tools. Proficiency with CRM software and MS Office (MS Excel in particular).

Physical Requirements:

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer

  • Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times

Employment Details:

This full-time position reports to the CRO. The role includes salary (commensurate with experience and responsibilities), commission and a benefits package. DMD is an equal opportunity employer. We conduct pre-employment drug screens and background checks.

raw.description:
Habitat Health empowers older adults to experience more good days in their homes and communities. Through the Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE), we provide comprehensive medical care along with support for daily needs such as meals, transportation, and in‑home assistance. We deliver coordinated clinical and social care in our centers and directly in participants’ homes, creating a fully integrated experience that brings peace of mind and a true sense of belonging. As we expand our scalable, affordable PACE model to meet the growing and complex needs of aging populations, our mission‑driven care teams continue to help participants live well on their own terms.

Habitat Health is supported by leading healthcare organizations and investors including New Enterprise Associates, Kaiser Permanente, and Town Hall Ventures. We are entering a period of significant growth and are looking for exceptional teammates to help us scale a better model of care for older adults. To learn more, visit www.habitathealth.com.

Location: Remote; requiring regular travel for onsite go-lives, department rounding and other support activities as needed.

Role Scope:

We are hiring a Product Manager, Strategic Technology Applications to own the product strategy, roadmap, and cross-functional delivery for the technology application portfolio that powers Habitat Health's growing PACE organization. This is a high-impact, cross-functional role sitting within the Strategic Technology Applications team, reporting directly to the Vice President of Product.

As Habitat Health expands into new markets and scales its center operations, the Strategic Technology Applications team functions as the internal “product organization” for the systems that power clinical, operational, growth, and administrative workflows. This role will own the end-to-end product lifecycle — discovery, roadmap prioritization, delivery, adoption, and iteration — for a portfolio of applications spanning call/communications, CRM, core operations, growth, and risk adjustment systems.

The ideal candidate is a product-minded healthcare technology leader who is energized by translating clinical and operational needs into a compelling roadmap, partners naturally with internal developers and vendor teams to ship solutions, and uses data and stakeholder feedback to continuously improve adoption and impact.

Core Responsibilities & Expectations for the Role

Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for a portfolio of strategic technology applications, including but not limited to call/communications platforms (TalkDesk), CRM platform (Salesforce), EHR platform (Epic)
  • Translate operational, clinical, and growth stakeholder needs into a prioritized backlog and roadmap, balancing quick wins against longer-term platform investments
  • Define and track success metrics — adoption, utilization, satisfaction, and operational impact — to measure product performance and guide iteration
  • Maintain a clear view of the application portfolio's health, dependencies, and integration points (e.g., Salesforce and ancillary clinical/communications tools) to ensure data integrity and a cohesive experience across platforms

Discovery, Delivery & Execution

  • Run discovery with clinical, operational, and growth stakeholders to surface pain points, validate requirements, and shape well-scoped product requirements and user stories
  • Partner with internal analysts (e.g., CRM Admin, EHR Support Analyst, etc.) and external vendors to scope, prioritize, and deliver configuration changes, integrations, and new features
  • Own backlog grooming, sprint/release planning, and prioritization decisions using tools like Jira
  • Lead or co-lead technology application implementations for new PACE center launches, including configuration, workflow validation, user acceptance testing, and go-live support
  • Build repeatable implementation and product-launch playbooks that support Habitat Health's continued growth

Vendor & Stakeholder Management

  • Own day-to-day vendor relationships for managed applications, including performance management, escalations, contract oversight support, and roadmap alignment
  • Evaluate and recommend new technology solutions in partnership with the Director of Strategic Technology Applications; support build-vs-buy assessments and vendor selection
  • Serve as a trusted product partner for clinical, operational, and growth teams, translating their needs into the roadmap and communicating trade-offs clearly
  • Represent the Strategic Technology Applications product portfolio in cross-functional forums, governance bodies, and project teams

Adoption, Training & Change Management

  • Partner with training and enablement resources to design rollout, onboarding, and training plans for managed applications across clinical, operational, and administrative end users
  • Track adoption metrics and gather user feedback; feed insights back into the roadmap and configuration priorities
  • Own change management planning for major releases, feature rollouts, and workflow redesigns
  • Maintain clear product documentation, including roadmaps, requirements, release notes, and user-facing support materials

Required Qualifications and Competencies

  • 5+ years of experience in product management, with hands-on ownership of the roadmap and lifecycle for enterprise or B2B SaaS applications; healthcare or health IT experience strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated experience managing or launching SaaS/cloud-based applications (experience with call center platforms, CRM, or clinical ancillary systems a plus)
  • Strong command of product management fundamentals: discovery, prioritization frameworks, roadmapping, backlog management, and agile delivery (Jira or similar)
  • Proven ability to translate business and clinical requirements into clear product requirements, user stories, and workflow improvements
  • Comfortable partnering with both technical teams (developers, vendors) and non-technical clinical/operational stakeholders
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear product documentation, roadmaps, and executive-facing updates
  • Experience supporting multi-site healthcare operations or rapid program expansion preferred
  • Familiarity with PACE, Medicare/Medicaid, or other regulated healthcare environments preferred

Nice to Have

  • Experience with TalkDesk, Salesforce, Abridge, Epic or other contact center / CRM / ambient AI documentation /EHR systems
  • Experience with health plan systems (claims, eligibility, encounter submissions) or risk adjustment platforms
  • Background in product delivery or change management methodology

Compensation:

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $170,000–$194,000 for candidates located in San Francisco, New York City, or Seattle, and $149,000–$185,000 for candidates located elsewhere. This position is also eligible for a target annual bonus of 10% of the base salary and may be eligible for additional incentive compensation, as applicable.

The final compensation offered will be determined based on factors including, but not limited to, the candidate's qualifications, skills, experience, education, certifications, geographical location, and business needs.

In addition, this position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance; paid parental leave, short- and long-term disability coverage; life insurance; flexible spending accounts; a 401(k) savings plan that includes a match; paid time off; and company paid holidays.

At-Will Employment

This means that either the employee or the employer may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause, and with or without notice, subject to applicable law. Nothing in this job posting or any other company document is intended to create a contract of employment, express or implied, or to alter the at-will nature of employment.

As a condition of employment, team members are expected to comply with all applicable infection control protocols, personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements, and vaccination requirements associated with their role and work location, and to the extent required by law and as permitted in the applicable jurisdiction.

Our Commitment to Equal Opportunity and Inclusion

Habitat Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to the principles of equal opportunity and inclusion. Employment decisions at Habitat Health are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, and related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, registered domestic partner status, age, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, military or veteran status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, reproductive health decision-making, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, perform the essential functions of a position, or receive other employment benefits and privileges, please contact us at .

E-Verify Participation Notice

If E-Verify cannot confirm your authorization to work, Habitat Health will provide you with written instructions and an opportunity to contact the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) and/or the Social Security Administration (SSA) to resolve the issue before any adverse employment action is taken, including termination of employment.

Staff Frontier Engineer

Frontier Engineering

Remote - US

Multiple Hires

Overview:

Pax8 is the technology marketplace of the future, linking partners, vendors, and small to midsized businesses (SMBs) through AI-powered insights and comprehensive product support. With a global partner ecosystem of over 35,000 managed service providers, Pax8 empowers SMBs worldwide by providing software and services that unlock their growth potential and enhance their security. Committed to innovating cloud commerce at scale, Pax8 drives customer acquisition and solution consumption across its entire ecosystem.

Our purpose is to help every small business turn their dreams into reality through the power of technology.

Culture is important to us, and at Pax8, it’s business, and it IS personal. We embody Compassionate Candour by aiming to assist others with candid, actionable feedback. We Seek to Understand by being open, curious, and committed to learning. We believe in We Before Me, actively collaborating and seeking out diverse perspectives to ensure a win for Team Pax8. Our team takes pride in Do What You Say, taking ownership, honoring commitments, prioritizing, and delivering on promises. We encourage everyone to Light Up Learning by being brave and trying new ideas, embracing vulnerability, and sharing failures so everyone can learn. Finally, we are Driven by Passion, connecting personal passion to Pax8's mission, and remaining resilient in the face of adversity and uncertainty in pursuit of our goals.

At Pax8, we are passionate, creative, and humorously offbeat. We work hard, keep it fun, and expect the best.

*This is a proactive opportunity posting, allowing us to connect with exceptional talent for anticipated future openings within Pax8.

Position Summary:

The Staff Frontier Engineer role requires depth and reach together: the system is technically hard in its own right, and enough of Product & Engineering builds on it that one engineer getting it right compounds across the entire org. A representative problem is identity and entitlements, where everything depends on it and it is genuinely one of the harder problems in software. On the AI side, it is the eval infrastructure that determines whether what ships is actually prompted well. The Staff Frontier Engineer is individually accountable for building, hardening, and operating a system that the organization depends on without directly touching. They hold the problem space durably, long enough to develop real expertise and innovate within it. They earn the right to set its direction by shipping the system rather than by advising on it.

This role is measured on five dimensions (Craftsmanship, Impact, Mentorship, Safety, and State of the Art). What separates it from Frontier Engineer is that Judgment, Systems Thinking, and Safety now have to hold up against a problem where being wrong is expensive and, often, no one else is positioned to catch it.

Essential Responsibilities (includes, but is not limited to):

  • Own, build, and operate a system that is hard enough to need its own technical strategy and technically deep in its own right, and help drive the technical specs behind it
  • Make consequential calls about what to build, scale, or kill on ambiguous problems where the data does not answer the question, driving them to clarity through iteration and collaboration, and own the outcome
  • Exercise Systems Thinking past your own ownership boundary: see and optimize the whole line end to end, and change your own plan, or push back on someone else's, when the end-to-end view says the locally optimal move is globally wrong. Pursue the real fix, by influencing, contributing, or escalating, even when it lives in a system you don't own
  • Own the work yourself: your domain is yours to run, so address the high-leverage problems in it, scope the solutions, and build them with a workforce of agents behind you
  • Instrument what you ship for adoption and usage from the start, and hold any claim of delivered value to a falsifiable, data-backed standard
  • Scale your own judgment into others: mentor engineers toward owning highly complex systems rather than only reviewing their output
  • Apply a categorically higher bar to safety, security, and irreversible-consequence risk: identify and close it out before it ships, covering both classic engineering risk (data loss, security vulnerabilities) and AI-specific risk (misuse, jailbreaks, unintended capability, data exposure), including deciding what not to ship when everything else is ready
  • Run the full lifecycle for adopting new techniques (discovery, spike, prototype, proof of concept, hardened production) in your problem space
  • Write documentation precise enough that other teams can consume your systems as a service without a standing coordination meeting

Ideal Skills, Experience, and Competencies:

Craftsmanship:

  • Building: Builds and operates a system that is hard enough to need its own technical strategy and technically deep in its own right, and helps drive the technical specs for it. Builds the tool that eliminates a repeated problem.
  • Judgment: Makes high-stakes calls on what to build, scale, or kill when the data runs out, and escalates the ones that belong to product
  • Writing: Documents at a level that sustains other teams consuming the system without a standing meeting, and presents technical direction to engineering and product audiences

Impact:

  • Outcomes: Instruments the system and proves delivered value against a falsifiable, data-backed standard
  • Systems Thinking: Lands fixes across ownership boundaries when the end-to-end view demands it, regardless of who owns the code
  • Mentorship: Grows another engineer's judgment

Safety:

  • Applies a categorically higher bar to irreversible-consequence risk on a system with organization-wide reach

State of the Art:

  • Owns the pipeline for adopting new techniques in the problem space

AI Foundations (All Roles):

  • Understand AI capabilities and limitations and apply that judgment in daily engineering decisions
  • Use enterprise-approved AI tools (Claude) as primary productivity accelerators across the full development lifecycle
  • Apply Pax8 data classification and privacy principles before sharing any data with AI systems
  • Practice responsible AI: recognize and mitigate bias, uphold fairness and transparency requirements
  • Advanced prompting proficiency: multi-turn context setting, chain-of-thought elicitation, structured output enforcement, and iterative refinement

Role-Specific AI Skills:

  • Build and own eval and validation infrastructure for AI-assisted or AI-native systems within your problem space, the layer that determines whether output is correct rather than merely plausible
  • Apply elevated scrutiny to agent-produced code within a highly complex system
  • Track state-of-the-art techniques and AI-specific vulnerability classes as they evolve, and be the one who notices when either changes and the one who ships the response into production

Additional Preferred Qualifications:

  • Track record of being the de facto owner of a problem space that most of the organization depends on, earned by building and running it rather than by advising on it
  • Experience mentoring other Frontier Engineers toward owning highly complex systems
  • Experience taking a technique from a paper or external source through prototype and proof of concept into a hardened, safety-reviewed production rollout

Trust and Hiring:

At Pax8, we care deeply about building genuine, trust based relationships — starting with how we hire.

To protect our business, our teams, and our customers, we use a range of measures throughout the recruitment process to help confirm authenticity and prevent fraud. These safeguards are designed to be fair, respectful, and proportionate, and may evolve as risks change. By applying, you acknowledge that we take steps to verify identity and representation during hiring. If you're applying as your authentic self, you have nothing to worry about — we're excited to meet you.

We also use thoughtfully applied AI-enabled tools to support our hiring process. These tools may assist with tasks such as reviewing or prioritising applications, but hiring decisions are made by our people. More information is available in our Recruitment Privacy Notice. If you have questions about how we hire or would prefer not to have your application supported by these tools, you can opt out at any part of our process.

Everyone Belongs Here:

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet 100% of the criteria. We're committed to diverse perspectives, inclusive hiring and sharing your transferrable skills. To fulfil this role, you must hold valid right to work in United States.

Why You'll Love Working Here:

  • Benefits
  • Competitive compensation package
  • Annual bonus opportunity
  • Employee stock options
  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer match
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Paid volunteer time
  • Wellness initiatives and employee assistance programs
  • Continuous learning and development opportunities
  • Dedicated professional development resources
  • Collaborative remote-first culture
  • Access to innovative technologies and AI-powered learning tools

Compensation Range: $200k - $300k

*This is a proactive opportunity posting, allowing us to connect with exceptional talent for anticipated future openings within Pax8.

Grow With Us:

There's extensive room for a talented individual to grow at pace — whether that's advancing quickly in this role or exploring one of the many opportunities across our global organisation. You'll have access to our internal development hub designed to accelerate your skills and stretch your potential. Alongside specialist Learning & Development trainers, you'll also tap into AI powered tools, "born in the cloud" mentors, and cross continent collaboration that broaden your perspective and sharpen your expertise. We'll give you the space, trust, and the right projects to help you thrive — and full visibility of what it takes to reach your next level.

About Pax8:

Our mission is to build the managed intelligence marketplace and empower small businesses to do more with smarter technology. We are a fast-growing, dynamic, and high-energy organisation with a start-up feel, allowing you to make a meaningful impact on the business. Culture is also important to us, and at Pax8, it's business, and it IS personal. We are passionate, creative, and unconventional. We work hard, keep it fun, and expect the best! We Elev8 each other. We Advoc8 for our partners. We Innov8 continuously. We Celebr8 life.

Background Checks:

As part of our hiring process, we are required to undertake pre-employment checks on all candidates that are successful in their application with Pax8. As part of these checks Pax8 will request ID verification, reference requests and qualification checks (additional checks may be completed for certain countries, such as criminal and financial). All checks are completed by our third-party provider, First Advantage. Once checks have been completed all candidates will receive a copy for their records.

Equal Opportunities:

Pax8 are an equal opportunities employer and welcome individuals who are in possession of the appropriate requirements to work within the country you have applied for. Offered individuals will be asked to undertake identity, security compliance and reference checks. Your privacy is important to us. Your data will be held in accordance with local best practices and processed only in accordance with our recruiting processes. Privacy notice:

To protect our business, our teams, and our customers, we use a range of measures throughout the recruitment process to help confirm authenticity and prevent fraud. These safeguards are designed to be fair, respectful, and proportionate, and may evolve as risks change.
By applying, you acknowledge that we take steps to verify identity and representation during hiring. If you’re applying as your authentic self, you have nothing to worry about — we’re excited to meet you.

Perks:


At Pax8 we believe that your Total Rewards should include a benefits package that shows how much we value our greatest assets. All FTE Pax8 people enjoy the following benefits:

  • 401(k) with Company Match
  • Medical, Dental & Vision Coverage
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

About Cardlytics
Founded in 2008, Cardlytics (NASDAQ: CDLX) is the industry-leading purchase intelligence and incentives platform. We make commerce smarter and more rewarding for everyone by helping businesses attract, understand, and incentivize consumers through our partners' digital reward programs. Join us on our mission to make commerce smarter and more rewarding for everyone!

About the Position

The Industry Lead at Cardlytics is responsible for driving revenue growth within a defined vertical by developing and executing a clear industry strategy. This role leads a team of sellers, builds senior-level client relationships, and partners cross-functionally to deliver solutions that align with market needs. The Industry Lead owns pipeline health, forecasting accuracy, and overall performance within the vertical, while elevating the team’s sales rigor and client impact.

You will

  • Develop and execute a cohesive industry strategy that adds value for our customers

  • Define and communicate a clear industry vision, structure, and go-to-market strategy to the team

  • Build and manage VP+ client relationships with key accounts to drive growth, collaborating with cross-functional teams to expand existing relationships

  • Develop industry thought leadership based on our purchase insights and customer trends

  • Provide regular business reporting to stakeholders

  • Drive consistent and accurate forecasting through disciplined pipeline management to ensure visibility, predictability, and accountability

  • Hire and develop top talent

  • Coach and develop team members through clear performance expectations, regular feedback, and structured growth plans to build leadership capability and drive results

  • Influence the product roadmap by highlighting client needs

  • Foster a collaborative and motivated team environment

You have

  • 10 + years + successfully growing revenue through the development of strategic partnerships within digital advertisers with a heavy focus on retail

  • Leading high performing enterprise sales teams; hiring, coaching, developing and retaining top talent

  • Revenue management experience- building industry plans, quotas, pipeline management and opex to achieve goals

  • Experience in leading cross-functional teams to deliver against client problems (driving internal culture, alignment and accountability)

  • Conducted annual (ideally multi-year) joint business planning & contracts with clients (and has a playbook)

  • Influencing decisions at the highest level with client (VP+) to create win-win outcomes

  • Partnered with Marketing & Product teams to create joint plans to support teams and deliver on client & revenue goals

  • Understand financial metrics and KPIs that drive their clients business, and the pipeline metrics that drives their own business and people

You are

  • A strategic thinker who understands how to translate industry trends into actionable revenue opportunities

  • A confident leader who builds trust quickly with both clients and internal stakeholders

  • Commercially sharp, with strong forecasting discipline and pipeline management rigor

  • A coach who develops high-performing sellers and raises the bar on performance

  • Resilient, adaptable, and energized by ambitious growth targets

Technical Environment

We primarily use macOS and Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides). While our preferred platform is macOS, we support both macOS and Windows. Familiarity with or willingness to work within this environment is required.

Core Values

Our shared values are the driving force behind everything we do. Across all roles, we are looking for teammates who embody these values:

  • Customer and partner first

  • Act with urgency and focus

  • Integrity with our partners and data

  • Accountability even when challenged

  • Empowerment over hierarchy

  • Growth over comfort

Benefits and Perks

  • Flexible paid time off plus company holidays

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance begins on your first day

  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match, plan also includes a student loan debt repayment option

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan

  • Educational assistance for continuing education

  • Lifestyle Spending Account for physical, emotional, and financial wellness (like gym memberships, home down payments, art classes, park passes, and more!)

  • Complimentary Calm app subscriptions to support employee mental health and wellbeing

As an equal opportunity employer, Cardlytics is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our people bring our products and organization to life, and every unique perspective makes us better. If you can do the job and you’re excited about growing with us as we scale our best-in-class advertising platform, we’d love to hear from you. 🚢 Discover OneOcean:
OneOcean is a unified brand born from the integration of OneOcean and Ocean Technologies Group.
Owned by Lloyd’s Register, an organisation with more than 260 years of trust, integrity and leadership at sea, OneOcean combines the agility and ambition of a fast-moving innovator with the strength and stability of one of the world’s most trusted maritime institutions.
At the heart of OneOcean is a portfolio unlike any other in maritime. A comprehensive, integrated portfolio built on years of expertise, trusted by thousands of maritime professionals around the world.
🎯 Our Mission: Our mission is clear. In the race to zero emissions, our research, advisory and technical expertise and industry-firsts are supporting a safe, sustainable maritime energy transition. Today we are a leading provider of classification and compliance services to the marine and offshore industries, helping our clients design, construct and operate their assets to accepted levels of safety and environmental compliance.
🔍 Why Join OneOcean Crew?
  • Legacy & Innovation: We were created more than 260 years ago as the world’s first marine classification society to improve and set standards for the safety of ships.
  • Global Impact: Our digital solutions are relied upon by more than 30,000 vessels, following the acquisition of OneOcean in 2022 and Ocean Technologies Group in 2024.
  • Product Offering: Covering five proven product areas - learning, fleet operations, compliance, voyage planning and performance management - supporting its customers from ship to shore, from training and people operations, to voyage compliance and optimisation.
🧭 Navigating the position: Senior FullStack (.Net/React) Developer

The Senior FullStack (.Net/React) Developer is based in Poland and is fully remote, reporting to Technical Technology Lead.

You will dive deep into the realms of technological marvels, crafting the backbone of an educational revolution. With each line of code, you'll navigate through uncharted waters, shaping a world where learning transcends boundaries. Ready your sails for a journey where your work illuminates the path to discovery and knowledge for learners across the globe. This isn't just a role; it's your mark on the future of digital education.

Key Responsibilities:

Develop and Maintain Software Applications:
  • Design, code, test, debug, and document software applications using .NET, cloud and related technologies.
  • Ensure the performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications.
  • Develop responsive, user-friendly frontend interfaces using React.js
  • Collaborate with the team to define, design, and ship new features.
Collaboration and Support:
  • Work with project leaders, product owners, and developers to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Collaborate with designers to implement visually appealing UI/UX designs
  • Provide ongoing maintenance, support, and enhancements in existing systems.
  • Offer support to end-users of the application, by troubleshooting and problem solving.
Continuous Improvement:
  • Stay up to date with new technology trends and best practices in .NET development.
  • Continuously improve the codebase, fix bugs, and optimize performance.
  • Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality and shared knowledge.
Testing and Documentation:
  • Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for software solutions.
  • Develop and implement unit and functional tests to ensure code quality.
  • Assist in defining test scenarios and in testing the developed functionality

Skills, Knowledge, and Experience Required:

Educational Attainment
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field
  • A commitment to continuous learning and staying current with modern development practices is highly valued
Skills, Knowledge, and Experience Required
  • 8+ years in commercial development.
  • Strong technical expertise in .NET and object-oriented programming.
  • Proven experience in client-side (frontend) development with a strong focus on React.js
  • Practical experience in Test-Driven Development (TDD), unit, integration, and acceptance testing.
  • Solid understanding of Domain-Driven Design (DDD).

raw.description:
Fractional Chief Product Officer (6–8 Hours per Week) – FinTech / Remote

PLEASE READ THE FULL JOB DESCRIPTION BEFORE APPLYING

Location: Remote
Working Pattern: Fractional – approximately 6–8 hours per week
Environment: Early-Stage FinTech

About the Opportunity

Our client is an early-stage FinTech developing technology for businesses operating within an increasingly digital and international financial environment.

As the business progresses from early product development towards greater commercial readiness, it is building out its senior leadership team and is seeking an experienced Fractional Chief Product Officer.

The successful candidate will work closely with the Founder/CEO and engineering leadership to turn an ambitious proposition into a focused, commercially viable product strategy.

This is a build-stage opportunity. You will not be inheriting a large Product organisation, mature roadmap or established Product infrastructure.

The opportunity therefore requires someone capable of combining strategic Product leadership with practical decision-making and execution.

Further details regarding the engagement and participation structure will be discussed directly with candidates progressing through the process.

Application – Mandatory Qualifying Questions

Please submit your CV together with a cover letter answering each of the following:

  1. What senior Product leadership experience do you have within FinTech, financial services or complex B2B technology?
  2. Please provide a specific example of a product you personally helped take from concept, prototype or early development towards commercial deployment.
  3. What experience do you have translating a founder-led or technically complex proposition into a prioritised product roadmap?
  4. What experience do you have with product pricing, packaging and commercialisation?
  5. Do you have experience within trade finance, payments, lending, banking, financial infrastructure, Web3/blockchain or another relevant financial-services environment? Please explain.
  6. This opportunity requires approximately 6–8 hours per week. Can you consistently commit to this alongside your other professional commitments?

All six questions are mandatory. Applications that do not answer every mandatory qualifying question will be automatically disqualified and will not progress further.

What You'll Be Doing

You will help establish and lead the company's Product discipline, including:

  • Owning and refining product strategy and roadmap
  • Translating commercial opportunities into clear product priorities
  • Defining requirements and use cases
  • Working closely with engineering leadership
  • Supporting product positioning, packaging and pricing
  • Prioritising integrations and product opportunities
  • Supporting pilot and proof-of-concept development
  • Bringing customer and institutional requirements into product decision-making
  • Establishing scalable Product-management disciplines
  • Helping leadership distinguish immediate priorities from longer-term opportunities

What We're Looking For

You should bring substantial Product leadership experience, strong commercial instincts and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguity.

Experience within FinTech, payments, lending, trade finance, banking infrastructure, financial APIs, Web3/blockchain or other complex regulated technology environments would be particularly valuable.

We are more interested in evidence of what you have personally built, influenced and commercialised than job title alone.

Engagement Structure

This is a fractional engagement of approximately 6–8 hours per week, designed to operate alongside other compatible professional commitments.

The structure is centred on longer-term participation in the development and growth of an early-stage venture rather than a conventional executive package at this stage.

Full details will be discussed with candidates progressing through the process.

IPinfo is the market leader in delivering comprehensive and precise IP data, empowering businesses with well-defined data that enables actionable insights. Every day, we process more than 1 billion IP data points, offering an unparalleled big-picture view of the internet.

Our unique approach combines ground truth data with data from ProbeNet, our internet measurement platform, to create a detailed, real-time profile of every IP address. By contextualizing each IP with enriched metadata—covering its origin, connections, and circumstances—we provide businesses with the clarity and intelligence needed to make smarter, faster decisions.

Our data enriches applications and services with accurate IP data that can help manage security risks, improve user experiences, optimize content delivery and ensure regulatory compliance. Join a fast-paced, innovative team that’s passionate about data, technology, and customer success.

Job Overview

Are you a connected, results-driven sales leader in the utility space ready to make a meaningful impact?

We’re looking for a Sales Director, Electric Meters to drive growth for Aclara (a Hubbell company) across the Southeast region. This is a high-impact role where you’ll partner with utilities, lead complex deals, and shape the future of advanced metering infrastructure.

The Electric Meter Sales Director will be responsible for achieving overall sales goals and growing the installed base of Aclara electric meter products to utilities within assigned territory. Utilizing both direct and indirect sales approaches, the Sales Director, Electric Meters is responsible for leading customer engagement within the assigned territory and developing winning strategies to assess customer needs, develop market leading solutions, gather/communicate market intelligence, and win business with current and new customers. The Sales Director will be supporting the Southeast US territory and should reside in one of the following states (FL, GA, NC, SC, TN, AL, MS).

A Day In The Life

Sales Activities

  • Achieve current year sales targets and year-on-year growth plans by analyzing territory and customers to develop a specific region plan
  • Develop and maintain a diverse network of contacts within utility management and project teams, key Aclara partners, consultants, and other industry stakeholders.
  • Identify and develop opportunities to grow business with new and existing customers
  • Analyze accounts within the assigned territory and develop actionable sales plans and long-term account engagement strategies to penetrate and grow the installed base of Aclara electric meters with new and existing customers
  • Serve as an expert on electric meters to relevantly and effectively represent our offerings cross-functionally within utility companies.
  • Assess competitor offerings and develop differentiated market approaches
  • Understand regional, state, and national dynamics within their region to promote Aclara as a market leader
  • Perform all activities in the sales cycle around the electric meter offer —generate leads, qualify opportunities, educate customers, quarterback proposal development, and lead sales meetings/presentations.
  • Work closely and cross functionally with other Aclara and Hubbell sales resources within the territory.
  • Maintain positive client relationships to ensure client satisfaction, account growth, new business acquisition, and customer loyalty through cross-selling and upselling.
  • Consolidate and convey market intelligence, competitive feedback, customer requirements, and market direction to Aclara’s product management, partners and development teams to ensure a healthy and relevant product roadmap.
  • Represent the company in a manner consistent with its core values and team-based approach.

Additional Responsibilities:

  • Maintain current account and opportunity information in Salesforce.com.
  • Coordinate closely with Aclara partners for opportunities and deals within the associated territory that include partner components.
  • Deliver effective sales presentations that encompass electric meters equipped with both Aclara-owned and partner technologies.
  • Support Product Management by monitoring and gathering market/product intelligence from existing and prospective customers, competitors, and potential technology partners.
  • Control sales expenses to meet budgets and maintain a proper ratio for the assigned territory
  • Follow all established Sales and Account Management processes, procedures, and methodologies.
  • Adhere to all Hubbell corporate policies.

What will help you thrive in this role?

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education and Experience Requirements

  • Minimum of a bachelor’s degree, preferably in technology-related field. MBA a plus.
  • Minimum 5-10 years’ experience working within the utility industry with well-established relationships at relevant organizational levels. Strong ability to network and establish new and/or expanded relationships.
  • 5 years of experience in sales, commercial, or product management roles.
  • Experience working with and supervising independent sales agents/distributors preferred.

Skills and Knowledge:

  • Should have advanced knowledge of the offers and business cases that support electric meters and advanced metering infrastructure.
  • Knowledge of Hubbell and competitor products and services and their applications in the generation, transmission, and distribution of electric power, and power quality measurement.
  • Must possess the ability to grasp complex selling challenges while formulating strategies to advance business plans across a multitude of accounts.
  • Knowledge of the application of domestic and international electrical standards, such as UL, IEC, ANSI, IEEE and CE, and local laboratory certificate requirements.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Office applications, such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint.
  • Must be highly motivated, goal-oriented, and persistent with experience in driving business opportunities and developing markets.
  • Must be able to effectively communicate a value proposition and to work both independently and as a member of a broader team.

Physical Demands:

  • Ability to travel up to 60% via air or land.
  • Must reside in one of the following states (FL, GA, NC, SC, TN, AL, MS)

LANGUAGE SKILLS: Ability to read, analyze, and interpret common scientific and technical journals, financial reports, and legal documents. Ability to respond to common inquiries or complaints from customers (at all levels), regulatory agencies, or members of the business community with tact and diplomacy. Ability to write speeches and articles for publication that conform to prescribed style and format. Ability to effectively present information to customers, top management, public groups, and/or boards of directors.

Hubbell Incorporated

Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently.

The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses.

We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe.

Hubbell Utility Solutions

Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications. HUS provides the critical components that allow the grid to reliably transmit and distribute energy, as well as the communications and controls technologies to make the grid smarter and more flexible.

The University of Miami Information Technology & Systems Department has an exciting opportunity for a full-time Principal Cyber Threat Intelligence Specialist.

The Principal Cyber Threat Intelligence Specialist serves as the University's senior subject matter expert for enterprise threat intelligence, artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled cybersecurity operations, and security automation. This role leads the development and execution of intelligence-driven cyber defense strategies that enhance threat detection, incident response, vulnerability management, and operational efficiency across the University of Miami and UHealth. The incumbent provides enterprise-wide technical leadership and strategic guidance without direct supervisory responsibility and collaborates with technology, security, clinical, research, and institutional stakeholders to advance cybersecurity capabilities across academic, research, healthcare, and administrative environments.

Core Responsibilities:

  • Leads the University's enterprise threat intelligence program supporting academic, healthcare, research, and administrative environments.

  • Monitors, analyzes, and operationalizes intelligence from internal, external, commercial, government, and industry threat sources to identify emerging cyber threats and risks.

  • Develops intelligence-driven threat detection strategies, threat hunting methodologies, and proactive cyber defense capabilities.

  • Translates threat intelligence into actionable recommendations, detection content, response procedures, and risk mitigation strategies.

  • Leads advanced cyber threat analysis activities during significant security incidents, investigations, and cybersecurity events.

  • Serves as the University's principal subject matter expert for AI-enabled cybersecurity operations, security automation, and intelligence-driven security practices.

  • Designs, implements, and optimizes AI-powered workflows, prompts, playbooks, knowledge repositories, and automation solutions that enhance Security Operations Center (SOC) effectiveness and operational efficiency.

  • Develops, deploys, and manages AI-powered agents and automated processes that support security monitoring, investigations, incident response, and operational decision-making.

  • Establishes standards, governance practices, and security controls for the responsible and secure use of artificial intelligence technologies within cybersecurity operations.

Humana: A Fortune 60 Healthcare Company
Humana is a publicly traded, Fortune 60 health benefits company with a long history of successful innovation and reinvention. The Enterprise Growth Strategy team is a newly created organization supporting growth across Humana’s businesses. The team has a strong dotted-line partnership with the Medicare and Medicaid organization, Humana’s largest, which comprises over 80% of the company’s total revenue and the majority of its earnings. Team members partner with the senior leaders of the business unit, and more broadly with leaders throughout the enterprise, as they deliver strategy projects addressing some of the businesses’ most important opportunities and challenges. These high-profile strategy projects place the team at the forefront of helping to define the future of Humana’s largest businesses.

The Strategy Manager will be responsible for driving the development of deep consumer and competitor insights to inform key strategic choices that support sustainable enterprise growth.

  • Managing analysis and/or work streams within high-profile, high-impact strategy projects

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. raw.description:
Hello, we’re Instrumentl. 👋

Nonprofits do some of the most important work in the world, and most of them are still managing grants in spreadsheets. We're fixing that.

Instrumentl is a profitable, hypergrowth, YC-backed SaaS platform building the operating system for grant-funded organizations. More than 5,500 nonprofits use Instrumentl to discover, track, and win grant funding, from local community organizations to the San Diego Zoo and the University of Alaska. Collectively they’ve moved over $1 billion through our platform.

We're growing quickly, customers love us (check out our G2 reviews!), and we're hiring people who want to build something that matters.

About the role:

    We are hiring a Staff Product Designer reporting to the Head of Design. You'll own GrantOS, the foundational layer every other product area at Instrumentl sits on top of: Platform (the data layer, MCP, BI), Core (Tracker, Tasks, Reports, Integrations), and the enterprise surfaces that connect them. This is the seat where you define how grant professionals experience Instrumentl as a system rather than a set of features, which means the data models, permissions, and interaction patterns you set get inherited by every designer and every pod after you. Much of this area is still being invented, so you will be defining problems rather than receiving specs.

What you'll do:

    Platform & Systems

  • Own end-to-end design for GrantOS across Platform, Core, and enterprise, from discovery through ship and iteration
  • Define the data relationships, permission models, and integration surfaces that hold up across every workflow in the product
  • Set the interaction patterns and design system foundations that every other product area inherits
  • Design how work connects across pods, so a change in one area makes the next one smarter instead of harder

    • Zero to One

  • Drive definition in genuinely greenfield spaces where the right answer is not obvious yet
  • Write your own brief, frame the problem, and set roadmap direction in partnership with your PM
  • Make good calls with incomplete information and sequence the work so the team ships learnings quickly
  • Shape how grant professionals manage tasks, reporting, and integrations across the full grant lifecycle

    • Research & Influence

  • Recruit participants, run the interviews, and synthesize ambiguous user needs into clear product direction
  • Bring a point of view into the room and push back when something is not right for users
  • Align engineering, product, and GTM on direction at any level of the company
  • Raise the quality bar across the design team and coach the designers around you

What we're looking for:

    Required

  • 10+ years of product design experience with meaningful time at staff or principal level, having owned entire product domains rather than features inside them
  • Proven end-to-end ownership of a platform or core product area in complex B2B or enterprise SaaS: data models, permissions, integration surfaces, and patterns that other teams build on top of
  • Shipped net-new product work alongside that platform work, including 0-to-1 areas you helped define rather than received as a finished spec
  • Deep involvement in user research end to end, from planning and recruiting through synthesis into product decisions
  • Experience designing agentic or AI-powered product surfaces

    • Nice to have

  • Design systems experience where you defined the patterns, not only used them
  • Prototyping with AI tools, for example building working prototypes in Claude or Cursor that engineers can build from
  • Exposure to compliance, data integrity, or workflow-heavy domains
  • Startup experience where process was lightweight and you brought your own structure
  • Experience mentoring or coaching other designers
  • Familiarity with the nonprofit or social impact sector

Compensation & Benefits

    For US-based candidates, the target salary range for this role is $200,000 – $230,000 USD, plus equity. Final compensation is determined based on experience, skillset, scope of responsibility, interview performance, and geographic location. We’re committed to paying competitively and equitably.

    For candidates based in Canada, compensation varies by province and will be shared by your recruiter early in the process.

    Benefits

  • 100% covered health, dental, and vision insurance for employees (50% for dependents)
  • Generous PTO, including parental leave
  • 401(k)
  • Company laptop and home-office stipend
  • Bi-annual company retreats

    • Instrumentl is evolving rapidly. You’ll always have new challenges and opportunities to grow here.

Instrumentl is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, or any other legally protected status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.

Overview

Change Business Partner - MRP

Location: US Remote with travels

Employment: 12 month project based role

Role Overview:

The Change Business Partner will lead the people-side implementation of strategic transformation across manufacturing operations. This includes driving the adoption of new systems, processes, and behaviours that enhance efficiency, safety, and growth. A key focus will be supporting the deployment and behavioural integration of standard costing across manufacturing sites, ensuring consistency in cost control, performance tracking, and margin visibility. The role requires a strong understanding of manufacturing, ERP (notably Microsoft D365), and change facilitation to support both people and site-level transitions.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and support change initiatives linked to process improvements and ERP projects, with a particular focus on standard costing.
  • Partner with finance, operations, and systems teams to make sure costing methods are understood, applied consistently, and support effective cost control.
  • Help operational leaders move from legacy costing approaches to standardised cost models, explaining the impact on reporting, performance measurement, and profitability.
  • Work with local teams to build understanding of how standard costs are created and maintained, including bill of materials (BOM) accuracy, labour and machine rates, and overhead allocation.
  • Deliver training and capability-building activities that strengthen cost awareness and accountability across production and planning teams.
  • Act as the link between Global Process Owners, finance teams, and manufacturing sites, turning costing policy into practical day-to-day processes within D365.
  • Support the accuracy and integrity of costing data by identifying gaps in processes, systems, and reporting, and helping teams put the right controls in place.
  • Drive adoption of new ways of working, making sure standard costing becomes embedded in decision-making rather than simply a finance exercise.

Qualifications

Requirements:

  • Experience delivering change management within an industrial or manufacturing environment.
  • Understands and leads for the to-be processes and ways of working.
  • Understanding and advocating good practices in principle and in detail for a range of topics especially standard costing (cost build-up, cost drivers, variance analysis, cost updates) and margin management, but also MRP, planning, and warehousing.
  • Experience supporting or deploying standard costing frameworks within ERP systems (especially Microsoft D365), including training, data validation, and cost centre alignment.
  • Ability to engage both finance and non-finance teams in understanding the operational impact of cost changes, cost performance, and product profitability.
  • Proven ability to build relationships and influence frontline teams, middle management, and senior leaders.
  • Strong communication and facilitation skills, particularly in operational and technical contexts.
  • Experience with ERP systems (JD Edwards, Microsoft D365) is a strong advantage.
  • Comfortable working at different levels of the organisation.
  • Flexible to adapt to the changing business needs of the projects.
  • Serves as best practice/quality resource within Standard costing and ERP Transformations.

Qualifications and Behaviours:

  • Aptitude to learn and adapt, seeing change opportunities and encouraging others to seek positive change.
  • Change Management or Lean Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or higher) is an advantage.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in finance management or transformation, or multi-site general management roles within manufacturing or industrial sectors.

Morgan Advanced Materials is an EEO/AA/M/W/D/V

Morgan Advanced Materials is a business rich in history and innovation. Founded in the UK in 1856, we have grown into a global organisation with 70 sites in 18 countries. Our model to serve our customers where they need us has led to a diversified product range using our unparalleled expertise in ceramic and carbon materials, which we exploit to solve difficult problems for our customers across a diverse range of markets.

We are a purpose driven organisation. Our purpose is to use advanced materials to make the world more sustainable and to improve the quality of life. We deliver on that purpose through the products that we make, and the way that we make them.

We help our customers push the limits of their processes and products to meet the demanding requirements they face, from higher process temperatures to higher product performance to increasing miniaturisation.

Key Figures: Revenue £1,114.7m (2023), ~8,500 employees, manufacturing in 20+ countries, and a global customer portfolio. A UK PLC with head office located in Windsor, Berkshire UK. Listed on London Stock Exchange; Member of the FTSE 250 Index.

Regional Sales Director (West)

Remote | Full-time

Are you a driven, strategic, and results-oriented sales leader with a passion for cybersecurity? At Cloud Range, we’re on a mission to revolutionize cyber readiness with hands-on, real-world simulation training. As our Regional Sales Director, you’ll play a key role in expanding our footprint in the Western territory, driving new business, and building lasting partnerships with enterprise customers. Join us in creating the future of cyber defense, where you’ll lead initiatives to identify new opportunities, manage the sales cycle from start to finish, and empower organizations to face cyber threats with confidence.

About Cloud Range

Cloud Range’s revolutionary platform delivers live-fire, immersive cyber attack defense training that empowers security teams to confidently face today’s cyber threats. Our cyber range solutions help organizations reduce risk, enhance skill sets, and comply with evolving standards. Our Customer Success team is at the heart of this mission, ensuring that every customer not only meets but exceeds their cyber readiness goals while achieving measurable value.

Cloud Range is recognized as an industry leader and has earned numerous awards, including the ASTORS Homeland Security Award for Best Cyber Defense Team Training, the CISO Choice Award for Security Education, and the Top InfoSec Innovator Award. Fortune 500 companies, governments, and major technology companies depend on Cloud Range to ensure their security teams are prepared for cyber attacks.

Job Summary

The Sales Director (West) is responsible for driving revenue growth across the Western territory by identifying, pursuing, and closing new business opportunities. You will serve as a strategic advisor to prospective customers, understanding their unique cyber readiness challenges and demonstrating the value of Cloud Range’s solutions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams—including Marketing, Customer Success, and Technical teams—to execute a territory sales strategy, build a robust pipeline, and exceed revenue targets.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Strategic Territory Management
    • Develop and execute a comprehensive sales strategy for the Western territory to expand Cloud Range’s market presence.
    • Proactively identify and qualify new business opportunities within the Enterprise, Federal, and commercial landscape.
    • Build and maintain a robust pipeline of qualified leads to ensure consistent revenue generation.
  2. Sales Execution & Growth
    • Manage the entire sales cycle, from initial prospecting and discovery to solution demonstration, proposal, negotiation, and closing.
    • Lead high-level sales meetings and executive briefings to articulate Cloud Range’s value proposition to decision-makers, including CISOs and security leaders.
    • Meet or exceed aggressive annual revenue and quota targets for the assigned territory.
  3. Relationship & Partnership Building
    • Cultivate strong, trusted relationships with prospective customers, industry partners, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity ecosystem.
    • Work closely with Channel partners and VARs to leverage their networks and accelerate the sales process.
    • Collaborate with Customer Success to ensure a smooth transition from sales to implementation and identify expansion opportunities in existing accounts.
  4. Market Expertise & Collaboration
    • Act as an industry spokesperson, attending conferences, webinars, and events to showcase Cloud Range and drive brand awareness.
    • Gather market insights, competitor information, and customer feedback to share with Product, Marketing, and Training teams for strategic planning.
    • Monitor and report on sales performance metrics, forecasting accuracy, and pipeline status to leadership.
  5. Product & Sales Expertise
    • Become a subject matter expert on Cloud Range’s platforms and solutions, guiding customers on how to maximize value and meet their cyber readiness goals.
    • Maintain high proficiency in CRM (HubSpot) and other sales tools to ensure accurate data entry, forecasting, and reporting.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years experience in cybersecurity field sales, with a proven track record of selling to enterprise accounts.
  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong strategic planning, communication, and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence C-level stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated success in managing complex sales cycles and hitting or exceeding revenue targets.
  • High degree of self-motivation, discipline, and the ability to work effectively in a remote environment.
  • Strong organizational skills, critical thinking capabilities, and the ability to adapt to changing organizational and market needs.

What You’ll Love About Working at Cloud Range

  • Remote work with a flexible schedule to support your productivity and work-life balance.
  • Unlimited PTO so you can recharge and be your best.
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance to keep you and your family healthy.
  • 401k program to help you save for the future.
  • Opportunities for growth and advancement in a cutting-edge industry.
  • Collaborative, fun, and entrepreneurial culture with in-person gatherings 1–2 times per year.

As an IT Support Analyst, you will be the first point of contact for end-users seeking technical assistance in a remote work environment. Responsibilities

As an IT Support Analyst, you will be the first point of contact for end-users seeking technical assistance in a remote work environment. You will provide front-line support, troubleshoot issues, and ensure a high level of customer satisfaction. Your role is crucial in resolving technical problems, escalating complex issues to Tier 2 or higher support levels, and maintaining the smooth operation of IT services from a remote setting.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Respond promptly to user inquiries via phone, email, or ticketing system. Provide technical support and guidance to end-users in a professional and courteous manner.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve basic hardware, software, and network issues remotely. Perform initial diagnostics and attempt to resolve issues within defined SLAs (Service Level Agreements).
  • Log, categorize, and prioritize support tickets using the company's ticketing system. Track and update the status of issues, ensuring timely resolution and clear communication with end-users.
  • Assist with the setup, configuration, and troubleshooting of IT equipment remotely, including computers, printers, and peripherals. Provide support for common applications and operating systems.
  • Provide support for Office 365 applications, including email setup, configuration, and troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with AWS and Azure is a plus. Assist with basic troubleshooting and user support related to these platforms.
  • Provide support and troubleshooting for Windows 10/11/MacOS, including system configurations, updates, and common issues.
  • Identify and escalate unresolved or complex issues to Tier 2 or higher support levels. Ensure proper handoff and documentation of escalated cases.
  • Maintain accurate and detailed records of support activities, solutions, and procedures. Contribute to the development and maintenance of knowledge base articles and technical documentation.
  • Adhere to company policies, procedures, and IT security protocols. Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry best practices

Qualifications

Education & Experience:

  • Associate’s degree in Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • 1-2 years of experience in IT support or a related customer service role.

Technical Skills:

  • Proficiency with common operating systems, such as Windows 10/11/MacOS and office applications (Microsoft Office 365)
  • Basic understanding of networking concepts (IP addresses, DNS, etc.) and hardware components.
  • Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote support tools is a plus.
  • Good understanding of Active Directory and/or Azure Active Directory, and experience performing basic functions such as password resets and security group changes.
  • Familiarity with AWS and AppStream is a plus.

Soft Skills:

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a remote team.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

Certifications (Preferred):

  • CompTIA A+ or equivalent certification.
  • ITIL Foundation certification is a plus.

Additional Information:

  • Work Environment: This position is fully remote. Candidates must have a reliable internet connection and a suitable home office setup to perform their duties effectively

  • Schedule: Monday through Friday, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM Central Time

    • On-Call Requirement: Participation in a rotating on-call schedule shared among team members.

Base Hourly Rate: $20.50 - $24.00 USD

The base hourly range represents the low and high end of the anticipated hourly range for this position. The actual base hourly offered for this full-time position will be determined by various factors, including but not limited to, location, skills, knowledge, competencies, and experience.

All full-time employees are also eligible for the following benefits: Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401k, Life Insurance, Disability, and other voluntary coverages.

raw.description:
Who Are Massive Rocket?

Massive Rocket is a rapidly scaling Braze and Snowflake agency on a mission to transform how digital marketing, product, and engineering teams connect. In just five years, we’ve grown at speed and are now gearing up for our next big milestone: hitting $100M in revenue. We build human experiences at scale, powered by cutting‑edge web, mobile, cloud, data, and AI technologies. If you’re excited by innovation, love solving complex challenges, and want to help shape the future of digital experiences, you’ll feel right at home here.
Every role at Massive Rocket is entrepreneurial. The people who thrive here don’t just focus on their own remit — they understand the goals of the teams around them and actively contribute to the success of their colleagues, customers, and partners. We’re building a culture of ownership, collaboration, and growth, and we’re looking for people who want to make a real impact.

Who Are We Looking to Add to Our Team?

As a CRM Strategist at Massive Rocket, you’ll work hand‑in‑hand with our Principal CRM Strategist to shape and deliver CRM strategies that move the needle for our clients. You’ll help build strategic plans, translate them into clear, actionable initiatives, and ensure they’re handed over smoothly to the execution team so they can drive KPIs, performance, and measurable ROI.
You’ll play a key role in turning complex frameworks into simple, compelling narratives — the kind that teams can execute confidently and clients can rally behind. You’ll join client sessions throughout the Delivery Sales Lifecycle, helping uncover core challenges and contributing to data‑driven marketing strategies that make a real impact.
You’ll also support the creation of pitches that tell powerful stories through strategy, data, and insight. And you’ll run strategy sessions grounded in lifecycle thinking, best practices, and proven principles to help clients unlock long‑term success.

What Will You Do?

  • Turn complex frameworks into simple, compelling narratives that teams can execute confidently
  • Join client sessions throughout the Delivery Sales Lifecycle to uncover challenges and shape data‑driven strategies
  • Support the creation of pitches that tell powerful stories through strategy, data, and insight
  • Run strategy sessions grounded in lifecycle thinking, best practices, and proven CRM principles
  • Translate strategic recommendations into clear, actionable plans for execution teams
  • Contribute to measurable client success by aligning strategy with KPIs and ROI goals

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • 6+ years of hands‑on CRM experience, including at least 2 years in a dedicated CRM Strategy role within an agency, consultancy, or client‑side team
  • Strong working knowledge of leading CRM platforms such as Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or HubSpot
  • Confident presenting complex strategies and turning insights into clear value propositions and achievable activation plans
  • Data‑driven mindset, with experience analysing customer communications and using insights to shape future campaigns — from audience selection to next‑best actions, content, and timing
  • Deep understanding of CRM ecosystems and Martech, with expertise across platforms like Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, HubSpot, and similar tools

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Rocket‑Fuelled Growth – Big challenges, fast learning, and the chance to level up quicker than anywhere else
  • A Culture That Actually Gives a Damn – Supportive, positive, and built around people who want to see you win
  • A Global Crew – Collaborate with brilliant teammates across Europe, the US, and beyond
  • Remote‑First for Life – Work from wherever you feel your best
  • Real Career Momentum – Clear progression, real ownership, and space to grow into your next chapter
  • Moments That Matter – Meetups, events, and team experiences that make the journey unforgettable

A Few Things to Know Before We Get Started

Bring Your Own Device – We operate a BYOD policy, so you’ll use your own kit for work
Right to Work – You’ll need a valid work visa; we’re not able to offer sponsorship at the moment
ID Checks – We may ask for proof of identity (passport, ID card, or a recent utility bill)
References – We may request two references, so have names, relationships, and contact details ready
For Contractors – Proof of incorporation and up‑to‑date insurance is required

A Quick Note on Applications

We receive a high volume of applications, and while we’d love to reply to everyone personally, it’s not always possible. If you haven’t heard from us within two weeks, it sadly means you haven’t been successful this time. But don’t let that stop you—we’re growing fast, and new opportunities open up all the time.
