This role is focused on acquiring new brand partners and building long-term relationships with both emerging and established brands, using strong judgment to prioritize brands/products that align with our platform and what design professionals need most. You will bring industry credibility, established relationships, and a consultative mindset to communicate how Material Bank delivers value throughout the material selection journey, through brand visibility, seamless sampling, and data-driven insights.

This is a senior, external facing role for someone who knows the A&D landscape, understands how brands sell into the design community, and values that many lasting partnerships are built in person. You thrive in face-to-face conversations, on-site meetings, and industry events, doing whatever it takes to earn trust, build credibility, and move opportunities forward. This position is remote (East Coast) and will require at least 50% travel.

What you’ll do

  • Own new brand partner acquisition, building a strong pipeline and managing the sales process from initial conversation through contract execution.
  • Lead consultative sales conversations that align brand goals with Material Bank’s capabilities, tailoring pitches to each partner’s business objectives.
  • Develop deep, trusted relationships with brands, executives, and decision-makers across the A&D ecosystem.
  • Maintain ongoing engagement with new and existing partners, working closely with internal teams to ensure a strong onboarding experience and long-term success.
  • Contribute feedback and insights from the field to help shape sales strategy, messaging, and future platform enhancements, ensuring a high-quality brand partner experience.
  • Partner closely with internal teams to understand member needs, category gaps, and strategic priorities, and use that input to continuously refine targeting strategy and pipeline.
  • Stay informed on industry trends, competitive dynamics, and market shifts to bring insight and perspective into partner conversations.

What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years of experience in the Architect & Design industry, ideally within a material manufacturer, design-focused organization, trade association, or adjacent sales role.
  • An established network and strong reputation within the A&D and brand manufacturing community.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to communicate confidently and effectively with senior leaders.
  • Proven success in relationship-driven, consultative selling and new business development with mid-market and enterprise-level organizations.
  • Experience owning a full sales cycle, from prospecting through close, with a consistent track record of meeting or exceeding quota.
  • Excellent negotiation, influencing, and relationship-building skills.
  • Highly organized, self-motivated, and comfortable operating independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Willingness to travel at least 50% of the time.
  • A genuine passion for the A&D community and a customer-first mindset.

What you’ll get from us:

  • Our people: We are a growth-driven team that values efficiency, builds smart automation, operates in small empowered teams, and moves quickly from idea to execution.
  • Relaxation and Celebrations: Flexible PTO, Sick Days, Paid National Holidays, and even more (ask us about this when we connect).
  • Health Benefits: We contribute to your medical, dental, vision and short-term/long-term disability plans and have a strong employee assistance program.
  • Plan for your Retirement: 401(k) eligible after your first 90 day's employed!
  • Giving Back: We sponsor multiple events throughout the year to help out our communities.
  • Growth: We’ll help you take your career to the next level. We want you to be creative and take initiative which will allow you to grow and create within the company. Most importantly, be the best at what matters!
  • Flexible Work Schedules: With business units and employees across the globe, Material Technologies has embraced a hybrid  working model allowing department leaders to decide on the best approach for their respective teams, whether that be remote, in person, or a little of both.

Material Bank is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity, and all applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran or disability status or other status protected under any applicable federal, state or local law.

raw.description:
We are a technology-enabled financial operations partner, dedicated to helping retail suppliers and vendors drive value through deep expertise, ensure transaction accuracy using cutting-edge technology, and strengthen their financial operations with a white-glove approach. Our vision is to empower the world’s leading brands to elevate profitability through operational precision, innovative financial solutions, and a workplace culture that inspires our people and partners to achieve excellence.

Our culture thrives on collaboration, inclusivity, and connection. We believe the best results happen when every team member feels empowered to lead, contribute, and bring their unique perspective to the table. As a remotely distributed company, we make it a priority to stay closely connected by celebrating milestones, birthdays, and big wins together no matter where we are.

At STAT, you’ll find a team that works hard, has fun, and supports one another every step of the way. We’re ambitious, driven, and passionate about the work we do, but just as importantly, we’re kind, approachable, and genuinely excited to grow together.

What You'll Do

STAT is expanding its Amazon practice and we are looking for a rare combination: someone who understands Amazon deeply, not just the industry around it, who can both execute the work and win new business independently. This role is the engine for growing STAT's network of Amazon agency partners.

This is not a role for someone who understands recovery or deductions generically. The Amazon marketplace is its own world, 1P Vendor Central dynamics, co-op structures, chargeback mechanics, and you need to navigate that world fluently on day one.

This role is structured as a doer + seller combined: you'll pitch the partnership, close it, and get into the work alongside the client. That model is the norm in this space and is not as rare or daunting as it might sound in other retail verticals.

Strategic Partnership Management

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive partnership strategy targeting Amazon-focused agencies, with an initial emphasis on agencies where STAT can establish deep, embedded relationships.
  • Identify key agency partners, understand their client mix and pain points, and align STAT's Amazon services to create mutually beneficial partnerships.
  • Continuously assess market trends, to identify gaps where STAT's expertise is most defensible and valuable.
  • Work to displace incumbent providers at larger enterprise agencies through demonstrating superior 1P depth and outcomes.

Relationship Building

  • Establish and maintain strong, lasting relationships with key stakeholders within Amazon agencies.
  • Serve as STAT's primary point of contact and ambassador in all Amazon agency partnership discussions.
  • Foster ongoing collaboration between agency teams and STAT's internal Amazon delivery team to ensure client outcomes exceed expectations and deepen the partnership.

Business Development

  • Source, pitch, and close new agency partnership agreements, owning the full sales cycle from first contact through signed partnership.
  • Develop joint business plans with agency partners that clearly articulate growth opportunities for both parties.
  • Monitor the performance of active partnerships and proactively suggest service improvements, expansions, or new use cases.
  • Leverage STAT's existing client pipeline to supplement outbound efforts and provide warm introductions into new agency relationships.

Amazon Delivery & Execution

  • Roll up your sleeves and contribute directly to Amazon account work, auditing, deduction recovery, Vendor Central issue resolution, so you can speak credibly about what STAT does and represent it accurately in every pitch.
  • Stay current on Amazon's evolving vendor and seller policies, co-op agreements, chargeback categories, and platform changes that affect STAT's clients and agency partners.

Who You Are

  • You have hands-on Amazon expertise, specifically Vendor Central (1P) and can hold a sophisticated conversation about co-op, chargebacks, shortages, and margin recovery without needing a subject matter expert beside you
  • You have worked at or extensively with Amazon agencies, giving you a working understanding of how agencies are structured, how they serve brand clients, and what problems they are trying to solve for those clients
  • You have an existing network within the Amazon agency ecosystem and can walk in with warm relationships rather than starting from zero
  • You are comfortable being a doer and a seller simultaneously, closing the deal and then doing some of the work is the norm in this world, and you thrive in that model
  • You are highly self-motivated, independent, and results-driven with a verifiable track record of building and closing new partnerships or accounts
  • You are comfortable operating remotely in a fast-moving environment and do not require a hub location (NWA, Minneapolis, or otherwise) to be effective, your network and your calendar are your office
  • If your background is from a large brand rather than an agency, you compensate with an exceptional sales pitch, a strong professional network, and the ability to tap into STAT's existing client pipeline to generate early momentum
  • You reflect STAT's values: Strategic, Nimble, Inquisitive, Proactive, Empathetic, and Straightforward

Ideal Background

  • 8+ years of experience working directly in or alongside Amazon agencies (account management, business development, or a senior-level delivery role)
  • Deep, working knowledge of Amazon Vendor Central: co-op agreements, deduction and chargeback categories, operational compliance, and 1P vs. 3P tradeoffs
  • Demonstrated success building and maintaining agency or channel partnerships—not just managing accounts, but growing them
  • Familiarity with the competitive landscape of Amazon service providers and a clear point of view on where STAT's differentiation is strongest

Benefits

  • Generous 401k match
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and eligible dependents
  • Disability and life insurance coverage
  • Access to virtual healthcare resources
  • Flexible paid time off policy
  • Paid parental leave

EEO Statement

We are committed to hiring the best people for the job, regardless of race, religion, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification document form upon hire.

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

The responsibilities of our Platform team include building and maintaining all backend services, including, but not limited to, payments, analytics, subscriptions, new products, text to speech, and external APIs.

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, is passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust APIs including public TTS API, internal APIs like Payment, Subscription, Auth and Consumption Tracking, ensuring they meet business and scalability requirements
  • Oversee the full backend API landscape, enhancing and optimizing for performance and maintainability
  • Collaborate on B2B solutions, focusing on customization and integration needs for enterprise clients
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to align backend architecture with overall product strategy and user experience

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • Proven experience in backend development: TS/Node (required)
  • Direct experience with GCP and knowledge of AWS, Azure, or other cloud providers
  • Efficiency in ideation and implementation, prioritizing tasks based on urgency and impact
  • Preferred: Experience with Docker and containerized deployments
  • Preferred: Proficiency in deploying high availability applications on Kubernetes

What We Offer

  • A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products
  • A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive
  • Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity
  • The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry
  • Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture
  • The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more
  • An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

Google Ads Senior Account Manager – PPC Leadership | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST
Reports To: Chief Operating Officer

Compensation: $85,000 Base Salary | $120,000 OTE

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Google Ads Senior Account Manager to lead a team of Google Ads Account Managers while personally managing a reduced portfolio of high-value PPC clients.

This is a player-coach role. You’ll remain hands-on with Google Ads while coaching your team, reviewing campaign quality, managing escalations, improving processes, and driving client retention.

Your goal: deliver excellent PPC performance, develop stronger Account Managers, and keep great clients longer.

What You’ll Own

Google Ads Strategy & Client Management

  • Own a reduced portfolio of high-value Google Ads/PPC accounts
  • Develop and optimize strategies based on performance data and business objectives
  • Analyze campaign results and provide actionable recommendations
  • Serve as a senior strategic advisor and escalation point
  • Identify account risks before they impact retention
  • Manage high-stakes client conversations
  • Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities

Team Leadership & Coaching

Lead a pod of up to 7 Google Ads Account Managers.

  • Run weekly 1:1s, coaching sessions, and role plays
  • Review campaign strategy, client calls, and deliverable quality
  • QA Account Manager work and maintain PPC standards
  • Coach team members on Google Ads and Local Services Ads (LSA)
  • Onboard and train new Account Managers
  • Support hiring and performance evaluations
  • Allocate accounts and balance team capacity
  • Identify and address performance gaps

You won’t build campaigns for your Account Managers—you’ll set the standard, QA their work, unblock issues, and develop their skills.

Client Retention & Escalations

  • Act as the first escalation point for Account Managers
  • Handle complex client, payment, and technical issues
  • Monitor client health and identify churn risks
  • Coach team members through difficult client conversations
  • Maintain strong communication and service standards across the pod

Systems, QA & Process Improvement

  • Ensure adherence to company SOPs and quality standards
  • Audit communication, calls, campaigns, and deliverables
  • Identify broken or inefficient processes
  • Document and improve SOPs
  • Lead adoption of new workflows and tools
  • Track and report pod-level performance metrics

Requirements

  • 3–5 years of hands-on Google Ads experience
  • Proven ability to build, optimize, and scale profitable PPC campaigns
  • Strong ability to audit and QA Google Ads accounts
  • Previous experience leading, mentoring, or coaching Account Managers or client-facing teams
  • Demonstrated ability to improve team performance
  • Strong client communication and escalation-management skills
  • Experience building repeatable processes, SOPs, and QA systems
  • Strong analytical and strategic decision-making skills

This is not a first-time management role. Previous leadership experience is required.

Preferred Experience

Experience managing Google Ads for home service businesses, such as:

  • HVAC
  • Plumbing
  • Roofing
  • Electrical
  • Landscaping
  • Cleaning
  • Pest control
  • Moving services

Experience with local lead generation, call-driven businesses, seasonality, PPC, and LSA is highly preferred.

What Success Looks Like

  • Strong Google Ads performance across client accounts
  • High client retention and satisfaction
  • Improved Account Manager performance through coaching
  • Consistent campaign quality across the pod
  • Early identification and resolution of client risks
  • Strong adherence to processes and quality standards
  • Improved team efficiency and accountability

Interview Process

  1. Initial Screening Call
  2. Spark Hire Video Interview
  3. Recruiter Interview
  4. Client Interview
  5. Final Interview
  6. Offer & Onboarding

Apply Now

If you have deep Google Ads expertise, strong client management skills, and proven experience leading and developing PPC professionals, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now to lead a high-performing Google Ads team while continuing to own strategy and results for high-value client accounts.

Job Description:

About SEKO

SEKO started out in business in 1976, operating out of a single Chicago office. Since then, we have built a solid reputation throughout the world as an innovative and flexible provider of first-class logistics services. We provide complete Supply Chain Solutions, specializing in transportation, logistics, forwarding and warehousing. We also lead the industry with innovative and customizable IT solutions, which provide a seamless flow of information and give our growing customer base true supply chain visibility. With over 120 offices in 40 countries worldwide, our unique shareholder management model enables you to benefit from Global implementation experience and expertise across all industry sectors, coupled with vital in-country knowledge and service at the local level.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES INCLUDE:

  • Communicates with customers via phone, email, and company web portal.
  • Manages time specific pickups and provides best import routing by Ocean and Air.
  • Manages breakbulk operations for import shipments. This includes working with overseas offices to quote, route, handling destination services. It also includes collating export documents and turning them over to our brokerage department for customs clearance.
  • Handles operations system data entry and interacts with customer web portal communications.
  • Tracks all shipments and provides updates for customers Provide a monthly service departure schedule.
  • Close out consolidations.
  • Send daily agent settlements per consolidation (invoicing).
  • Monitor and relay discrepancies to the field and overseas.
  • Assist stations with Import documentation, review/advise as needed.
  • Assist stations and sales with all air import quotes.
  • Keep sales abreast of any major lane developments.
  • Build pallets when necessary to maximize space while reducing costs.
  • Produce all necessary documents for overseas and U.S. Customs, including Mawb, manifest, SED, labels etc.
  • Act as the last line of defense to ensure all documentation is provided by origins.
  • Ensure all origins freight and documents are ready for carriage.
  • Rate and enter costs against master job.
  • Book all shipments with carriers.
  • Research and respond to any foreign agent requests.
  • Determine routings for overseas and origins.
  • Run monthly reports i.e., gateway, carrier performance, lane analysis, etc…
  • Maintain an orderly workplace.
  • Comply with SEKO’s C-TPAT Security Profile.
  • Expected to uphold SEKO’s Core Values: respect, customer focus, integrity, teamwork and work hard, play hard
  • Participate in the development of a safe and healthy workplace. Comply with instructions given for their own safety and health and that of others, in adhering to safe work procedures. Co-operate with management in its fulfilment of its legislative obligations.
  • Other duties as assigned by management.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Excellent Communications Skills and Strong Sense of Urgency.
  • Ability to prioritize heavy workloads.
  • Excellent time management skills and ability to multi-task and prioritize work.
  • Attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, with aptitude to learn new software and systems.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

Minimum:

  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • 2-5 years related experience.

Preferred:

  • None

SPECIALIST CERTIFICATIONS:

  • None

Compensation and Benefits

Base salary range and benefits information for this position are being included in accordance with requirements of various state/local pay transparency legislation. Please note that base salaries may vary for different individuals in the same role based on several factors, including but not limited to location of the role, individual competencies, education/professional certifications, qualifications/experience, performance in the role and potential for revenue generation (Producer roles only).

Compensation

The base salary compensation range being offer for this role is $65,500 - $93,600 USD per year. This role is also eligible for an annual incentive bonus.

SEKO Logistics is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.

Benefits Designed with You in Mind:
At SEKO Logistics, we are committed to supporting your well-being, professional growth, and financial stability (eligibility requirements apply). Our comprehensive benefits package includes:

  • Health and Welfare Benefits: Medical (including prescription coverage), Dental, Vision, Health Savings Account, Commuter Account (IL only), Flexible Spendings Account, Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Group Accident, Group Accident, Critical Illness and hospital indemnity program, Life Insurance, AD&D, Wellbeing Program and Work/Life Resources (including Employee Assistance Program)

  • Leave Benefits: Paid Holidays, Annual Paid Time Off (includes paid state/local paid leave where required), Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, Other Leaves (e.g., Bereavement, FMLA, ADA, Jury Duty, Military Leave, and Parental and Adoption Leave)

  • Retirement Benefits: Contributory Savings Plan (401k).

SEKO Worldwide is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

B2B CFO® is seeking experienced financial executives who want greater control over their careers by building an independent Fractional CFO consulting practice and becoming an Entrepreneurial CFO®.

raw.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD100532

Position Overview
The Enterprise Business Support and Operations (EBSO) organization is responsible for the operational stability, scalability, and performance of Autodesk’s enterprise business applications. We are seeking a Support Analyst with strong technical depth to support AWS, JAVA and Salesforce platforms, including upstream and downstream integrations across enterprise systems.

This role focuses on production support, incident management, system analysis, and release readiness, as well as active participation in projects delivering new functionality. The Support Analyst ensures operational excellence by meeting defined service level objectives (SLOs), improving system reliability, and enabling effective post-launch support.

Responsibilities

  • Understand, and maintain enterprise applications using Java and Spring Boot

  • Build scalable and secure RESTful APIs and microservices if needed

  • Develop cloud-native applications using AWS services such as EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS, API Gateway, and CloudWatch

  • Design and implement highly available and fault-tolerant solutions on AWS

  • Work with relational and NoSQL databases and optimize queries and application performance

  • Understand containerized applications using Docker and deploy using Kubernetes/EKS or ECS

  • Implement CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or AWS CodePipeline

  • Have knowledge of application security using OAuth2, JWT, IAM, and secure coding practices

  • Write unit, integration, and automated tests using JUnit, Mockito, and related frameworks

  • Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and improve application reliability

  • Collaborate with architects, product managers, QA, DevOps, and other engineering teams

  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering standards and best practice

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience

  • 5+ years of hands-on AWS experience

  • 2+ years of Salesforce platform experience

  • 2+ years of experience working with SAP services in an enterprise environment

  • Strong understanding of enterprise application architecture, integrations, and data flows

  • Ability to analyze logs, system metrics, and transactional data to diagnose issues

  • Experience working in ITIL-aligned or incident/problem management environments

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate technical issues for business stakeholders

  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, production environment

  • High attention to detail with a structured, analytical approach to problem solving

  • Self-directed, adaptable, and able to support critical activities outside normal business hours when required

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing or troubleshooting Java-based applications or services

  • Experience writing, reviewing, or debugging code

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, version control, and automated deployments

  • Exposure to monitoring, logging, and alerting tools
